source: unite-db.com /pokemon.json "skills" (primary); serebii.net per-Pokémon attack tables for Pokémon missing from unite-db
notes: Structure per Pokémon: passives[], basicAttack (with boosted-attack formula components), slots[] (slot 1 and 2: base move learned at baseMoveLevels, then 2 options learned at learnLevel and upgraded "+" at upgradeLevel), uniteMoves[].
details[] are unite-db "rsb" blocks: detailedDescription (long text), notes, damage[] formula components, upgraded* (values after the "+" upgrade).
A damage component with formulaApplies=false is a textual exception (e.g. "30% of the full damage"); read its description.
Unite Move cooldownS is unite-db's "cd" field for Unite Moves; unite-db does not define it further (it is not the gauge charge rate, which is driven by gaugeEnergy).
Some Pokémon have a single option per slot (fixed upgrade path, e.g. Zapdos, Typhlosion, Mega forms): options[] then has 1 entry; Scizor/Scyther have 2 options on slot 2 only.
Pokémon only on Serebii use a reduced shape (serebiiMoves) with L15 base damage text and cooldowns, no formulas.
damageFormula: damage = floor(ratioPct/100 × scalingStat) + perLevel × (level − 1) + base, where scalingStat is the user's Attack ("Atk") or Sp. Atk ("SpAtk") at its current level. Formula as implemented by unite-db's front-end (damageCalc); it is the raw value before the target's Defense / Sp. Def mitigation, which no source used here documents.

units.gaugeEnergy: Unite gauge requirement, unite-db internal units (e.g. 80000, 100000)

passives.name: Super Luck
passives.description: Increased Critical-Hit rate by 15%.

details.detailedDescription: This Pokémon's critical-hit rate is increased by an additional 15%.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies and lowering their Defense by 15% for 2s when it hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, and decreasing their Defense by 15% for 2s when the attack hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals bonus damage.

base.name: Feint
base.description: Dash in an arc, attacking enemies that come in contact with Absol. This move ignores the defense stat and shield effects of enemies.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes in an arc forward, damaging Pokémon in the path and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 60% for 0.5s when this move hits. This move ignores the Defense and shield effects of Pokémon hit.
details.notes: Each use alternates between a rightward and leftward arc.

options.name: Night Slash
options.description: Dash in an outward arc, dealing damage to enemies. If this first attack hits, a second attack can also be performed. The second attack has the user dash straight ahead, dealing damage to enemies and increasing the user's critical-hit rate. The lower the enemies HP, the more the user's critical-hit rate is increased.
options.upgradeDescription: Using this move again will restore the user's HP.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes in a leftward arc forward, damaging non-allied Pokémon in its path and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 60% for 0.5s when this dash hits. If this dash hits, the move can be used again within 6s. This second use has the user dash straight ahead, repeating the effects of the first dash when it hits. The critical-hit rate of this move is increased by 0.8% for every 1% missing HP of opposing Pokémon hit, up to 30% increased critical-hit rate at 38% missing HP or more.
details.notes: The first use is a rightward arc forward from the perspective of the orange team (right-side team, which has the map flipped horizontally when in battle).
details.upgradedDescription: Restores the user's HP for 50% of damage dealt with the second dash hit.

options.name: Pursuit
options.description: Dash to the designated location and quickly charge an enemy with the next basic attack. (Basic attack range is doubled while this effect is active). If the basic attack lands from behind, its damage is increased and this move's cooldown is reduced.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased movement speed.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes forward, empowering the next auto attack for 3s. With this empowered attack, the user leaps to a non-allied Pokémon and attacks. This damage is increased against targets hit in the back. If this empowered attack hits any target in the back, this move's cooldown is reduced by 70%.
details.notes: When the user has an empowered attack readied, nearby non-allied Pokémon have their backs highlighted.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the user's movement speed by 35% for 2s after using this move and before using the empowered attack.

base.name: Slash
base.description: Slash with sharp claws in front of the user, increasing this move's critical-hit rate.

details.detailedDescription: The user slashes in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit.
details.notes: This move's critical-hit rate is increased by 15%.

options.name: Psycho Cut
options.description: Attack with blades formed by psychic power that decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits. Also increases basic attack damage dealt to the affected enemy for up to 3 attacks after this move hits.
options.upgradeDescription: Also increases movement speed for a short time when the user gets close to the enemy that this move hit.

details.detailedDescription: The user throws a psychic slash in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and decreasing their movement speed by 90% for 2s (decaying by 25% every 0.5s). 3 marks are applied to opposing Pokémon hit by the psychic slash for 5s. When the user deals damage to a marked target, 1 mark is consumed, dealing additional damage. The third mark deals increased damage when consumed.
details.notes: The critical-hit rate of the psychic slash and consumed marks is increased by 15%. The marks can be cleansed.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the user's movement speed by 20% when an opposing Pokémon is marked by this move.

options.name: Sucker Punch
options.description: Look for an opening to attack an enemy, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target enemy for the duration. After a short time, charge forward to attack the enemy. However, if the user receives damage or gets attacked before it charges, attack immediately and shove the enemy.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases basic attack speed for a short time when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and targets an opposing Pokémon and enters a counter stance for 1s, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target by 50% for the duration. After 1s, the user leaves the counter stance to counterattack, charging behind the target and damaging the target and other opposing Pokémon. If the user is attacked or the target attacks during the counter stance, however, the user dodges the damage and effects of the first hit and immediately counterattacks, shoving the target and dealing increased damage to the target and other opposing Pokémon.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the user's basic attack speed by 40% for 3s after using this move.

uniteMoves.name: Midnight Slash
uniteMoves.buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Unleashes a flurry of slashes in front of the user. This move ends by unleashing powerful blades of energy, dealing increased damage to enemies and shoves them.

details.detailedDescription: The user briefly becomes unstoppable before becoming untargetable and invulnerable for 1.15s while unleashing a flurry of 5 slashes in front of themself in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The user then becomes unstoppable again and unleashes a final slash in front of them with 3 blades of energy, shoving opposing Pokémon and dealing damage, up to 4 times at close range and down to 1 time at maximum range.
details.notes: The damage of the flurry of 5 slashes is divided by the number of targets hit. The first hit from the final slash deals full damage to each target hit; subsequent hits deal 30% of the full damage to the same target.

passives.name: No Guard
passives.description: Honedge and Doublade do not gain the stat benefits of Stance Change. However, their boosted attack functions like Aegislash's Sword Stance boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Honedge and Doublade do not gain the stat benefits of Stance Change; their auto attacks act like Aegislash's Sword Forme auto attacks.

passives.name: Stance Change
passives.description: Aegislash can switch between Sword Stance and Shield Stance. Using a blade move switches stance to Sword Stance; which increases Attack, movement speed by 5%, and Attack Speed by 15%. Using a shield move switches stance to Shield Stance; which increases Defense and Sp. Defense and reduces Attack Speed by 20%. After switching stances, movement speed and basic attack speed are further increased by 15% for 3.5s.

details.detailedDescription: Changes to Sword Forme when using blade moves (Shadow Sneak, Sacred Sword, or Shadow Claw, and Coup de Grace); increasing Attack, increasing movement speed by 5%, and increasing auto attack speed by 15%. Changes to Shield Forme when using shield moves (Iron Defense, Wide Guard, or Iron Head), increasing Defense and Sp. Def, and decreasing auto attack speed by 20%.
details.notes: Increases movement speed and auto attack speed by an additional 15% for 3.5s when changing stances.

damage.description: Stat change applications require a forme change to come into effect after evolution.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Slash at enemies in front of Aegislash, dealing damage to them. If the boost count is one or more, basic attacks become a boosted attack. When in Blade Stance: pierce through enemies, dealing damage. When in Shield Stance: ram enemies, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for a short time, restore HP, and reduce the cooldown of Sacred Sword and Shadow Claw when this attack hits. Every boosted attack consumes one boost count. Up to 4 boosted boosted attacks can be stored.

details.detailedDescription: When in Sword Forme: slashes at opposing Pokémon, damaging those hit. When in Shield Forme: rams at opposing Pokémon, damaging those hit. Becomes a boosted attack if the boost count is at 1 or more, consuming 1 boost count; the boosted attack changes based on the current Forme. The boost count caps at 4, and boosted attacks remain readied until used.
details.notes: As a boosted attack in Sword Forme: pierces through the target, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. As a boosted attack in Shield Forme: slams into the target, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and stunning them for 0.1s; restores HP, and reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sword or Shadow Claw by 1s when it hits.

damage.label: Damage - Boosted (Additional) (Sword Stance)
damage.description: Deals an additional 8.5% of the enemies Max HP as damage.
damage.notes: Against Wild Pokemon: The additional damage from maximum HP is capped at 1000.

base.name: Shadow Sneak
base.description: Cast a shadow in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. After the shadow hits an enemy or travels its maximum distance, Aegislash warps to the shadow’s location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and increase boost count by 1.

details.detailedDescription: Casts a shadow toward the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. After hitting an opposing Pokémon or traveling maximum distance; warps to the shadow’s location, damaging opposing Pokémon at the location.
details.notes: Increases the boost count by 1 if the warp hits an opposing Pokémon.

options.name: Sacred Sword
options.description: Aegislash thrusts its blade into the ground, creating a triangular zone. This zone erupts with a hidden power, dealing damage to enemies in the area and throws them. Also increases boost count by 1 for each enemy hit (capped at 2 for wilds, 4 for players). At the same time as the eruption, Aegislash slashes forward, dealing additional damage to enemies hit. For a short time after this slash hits, damage dealt by Aegislash partially ignores the Defense of all enemies.
options.upgradeDescription: Increase Attack for a short time after hitting enemies with this move.

details.detailedDescription: Thrusts their blade into the ground and creates a triangular zone that erupts with a hidden power, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 0.6s. At the same time as the eruption, slashes forward, dealing more damage to opposing Pokémon hit; and increasing Defense penetration by 25% for 3s if the slash hits.
details.notes: Increases the boost count by 1 for each target hit by the triangular zone erupting (up to 2 from hitting wild Pokémon).
details.upgradedDescription: Increases Attack by 50 for 3s after the triangular zone hits.

options.name: Shadow Claw
options.description: Aegislash slashes with its blade twice in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. Follow up with a final rising slash that deals damage to enemies hit and throw them. Boost count increases by 1 when at least one of the three slashes hits.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases Critical-Hit Rate with all attacks and moves except for Coup de Grace for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Slashes forward with their blade twice, damaging opposing Pokémon with each attack, then follows up with a final rising slash, damaging opposing Pokémon and throwing them for 0.75s when the rising slash hits.
details.notes: Increases the boost count by 1 if this move hits.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases critical-hit rate by 20% for 1s after the final slash.

base.name: Iron Defense
base.description: Envelops Aegislash in a powerful protective force for 1s. The protection disappears after blocking one attack or after 1s and then increases boost count by 1.

details.detailedDescription: Envelops the user in a powerful protective force for up to 3s, blocking the next attack.
details.notes: Increases the boost count by 1 when this move blocks an attack.

options.name: Wide Guard
options.description: Focus in place for a short time to create a great shield on Aegislash. When this shield appears, boost count increases by 1, granting a shield to Aegislash and shoves enemies in front. While this shield is active, enemy player attacks increase boost count by 1 for each different enemy player (capping at 4). When this move ends, shove enemies in front of Aegislash once again.
options.upgradeDescription: Cooldown reduced by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Focuses in place, becomes unstoppable and grants a shield effect for up to 1.2s; and shoves opposing Pokémon in front for 0.6s. This move can be used again to end the move early. When the shield effect is depleted or the move ends; shoves opposing Pokémon in front for 0.6s and decreases their movement speed by 45% for 2s.
details.notes: Increases the boost count by 1 unconditionally when granting the shield effect. Increases the boost count by 1 more for each instance of damage received by the shield effect (up to 2 times). Increases boost count by 1 more if an opposing Pokémon is shoved at the end or unconditionally when the shield effect is depleted before it can end normally.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

options.name: Iron Head
options.description: Dash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. Also increases boost count by 1, and protects Aegislash with a special shield for a short time afterward. This shield doesn’t protect from hindrances, but it can nullify damage. When the shield blocks an attack, it disappears and boost count is increased by 1.
options.upgradeDescription: Increase Attack for a short time after blocking an attack.

details.detailedDescription: Dashes barreling forward, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. Protects the user with a special shield for 1s afterward; this shield blocks the damage of the next attack then disappears; reducing this move's cooldown by 3s after a successful block.
details.notes: Increases the boost count by 1 unconditionally after barreling forward. Increases the boost count by 1 more if the shield blocks an attack.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases Attack by 10% for 3s when the special shield blocks an attack.

uniteMoves.name: Coup de Grace
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Unleash a ground-splitting slash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The lower their remaining HP, the more damage this move deals. If this slash knocks out an enemy, boost count increases by 1.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes unstoppable and unleashes a ground-splitting slash in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the line area of effect, dealing additional missing HP damage to those hit.
details.notes: Increases the boost count by 2 if this Unite Move knocks out an opposing Pokémon.

damage.label: Damage - Execute
damage.notes: Against Wild Pokémon: The additional damage from missing HP is capped at 1000.

details.detailedDescription: When an ally is under the effect of one of Alcremie's shields or buffs, remove any hindrances that are applied or are currently affecting that ally. This ability will go on cooldown for 10s after removing a hindrance. This ability can also work on Alcremie as well.
details.notes: When Milcery evolves into Alcremie, gain a Sweet Gauge. When the Sweet Gauge is filled at 15 stacks, the cooldown of one charge of Recover and Decorate will be reset. These moves will also be empowered.

details.detailedDescription: Attacks by throwing whip cream.
details.notes: Milcery and Alcremie do not have a boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Grant a designated ally Pokémon or yourself a shield for 3s, in addition to increasing the recipients Attack by 40 and Special Attack by 25 for 3s

Grant a designated ally Pokémon or yourself a shield for 4s. If the shield is granted to an ally Pokémon, Alcremie receives an extra shield of the same value. Basic and boosted attacks by the shielded Pokémon will deal additional damage and increase Alcremie's Sweet Gauge by 1 for 6s. The extra shield Alcremie receives when using Decorate on an ally does not apply additional damage to Alcremie's attacks. Alcremie's basic attacks will also increase the Sweet Gauge by 1. When empowered by a full Sweet Gauge, the attacks deal even more additional damage.
details.notes: The additional damage depends on the shielded Pokémon's level. Only one main Decorate shield can be active at a time.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the strength of the shield.

details.detailedDescription: Place a dollop of whipped cream at a designated location for up to 20s. When an ally Pokémon picks up the whipped cream, their HP is restored and their movement speed is increased by 15% for 2s. When whipped cream is consumed by ally Pokémon, the Sweet Gauge is also increased by 3. When the Sweet Gauge is full, the next dollop becomes sweeter, restoring more HP and increasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s instead and increases the Sweet Gauge by 5. Two dollops may be kept in reserve.
details.notes: An ally Snorlax will heal additional HP from the dollops.
details.upgradedDescription: The maximum number of uses that can be kept in reserve is increased to 3.

details.detailedDescription: Charm a target Pokémon with your cute voice, dealing damage to the first Pokémon hit. Pokémon hit by the charm have their Attack reduced by 30 and Special Attack reduced by 20 and movement speed reduced by 30% for 2s. Additionally, increases the sweet gauge by 2.

Release a conal ray of light in a designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon, stunning them for 0.4s and increasing the Sweet Gauge by 4 for every opposing Pokémon hit. If an ally Pokémon has been affected by Decorate, the decorated Pokémon will also release a conal ray of light.
details.notes: Alcremie can move around while casting this move, but is slowed by 20%.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

details.detailedDescription: Launch a sweet scent at a designated location, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area and lowering their movement speed by 30%, decaying by 10% every 0.5s. The outer ring of the scent remains for 3s, dealing damage, applying a 100% slow lasting 0.5s to oppposing Pokémon who touch the ring. Both the intial area and outer ring can hit at the same time. Increases the Sweet Gauge by 2 for every hit.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the duration of the outer ring slow to 1.5s.

uniteMoves.name: Fluffy Cream Supreme
uniteMoves.buffs: 40% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield (Applied when the move ends)

details.detailedDescription: Create a giant cake and stand atop it becoming unstoppable and gaining a shield for 6s. Then throw whipped cream at allies. Allies who receive whipped cream are healed and have their maximum HP buffed for 8s. This move ends early if this move's shield is lost, Alcremie becomes bound, or if the move is manually cancelled.
details.notes: The shield is 60% of Alcremie's max HP

damage.label: Max HP Increase - per Cream (48 max)

details.detailedDescription: When this Pokémon takes Sp. Atk-based damage from opposing Pokémon, the damage this Pokémon takes is reduced by 20% for 3s, and their next auto attack deals additional damage. This Ability goes on a 10s cooldown after it ends.

basicAttack.name: Attack - Charcadet
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.

variants.name: Attack - Armarouge
variants.description: Every time the user hits an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, the user's cannon gauge increases, up to 5 times. When the cannon gauge is full, the user's next basic attack consumes the entire cannon gauge, hitting in a large area of effect with the basic attack damage and additionally in a second close range area of effect with the boosted attack damage.

variants.name: variant 3
variants.description: When the user hits an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, a blazing mark is applied to them for 7s. Up to 3 marks can be applied, with subsequent marks refreshing the duration. If the user hits an opposing Pokémon with 3 blazing marks using Fire Spin or Armor Cannon, all the marks are consumed and additional damage is dealt to the opposing Pokémon, equal to 10% of their max HP, capped to 1000 damage. There is a 6s cooldown after consuming the marks before the user can apply blazing marks on the same opposing Pokémon again.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user attack the designated opposing Pokémon with a flame, setting them ablaze and dealing damage over time for 4s. When a Pokémon on the opposing team that's ablaze picks up a Berry, the Berry's effects are halved.

Has the user generate a fierce vortex of fire around themself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit every 0.5s. Each time Armarouge deals damage while Fire Spin is active, gain a shield. This shield can stack up to six times.
details.notes: Gain 20% movement speed while the vortex is active. The vortex lasts 3s, and its duration is increased by 1s if the user hits opposing Pokémon with an auto attack. This extended duration can stack up to 3 times, to a total vortex duration of 6s. Moving towards an enemy will additionally increase movement speed by 10%.
details.upgradedDescription: Upon using Fire Spin+, gain 3 stacks of shields.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user combine their shoulder armor and start charging power. When charged past a minimum duration, the user then fires a blazing ball of flame. The user releases a shock wave in front of themself when firing, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in close range.
details.notes: The fired ball of flame explodes when it hits an opposing Pokémon or after it travels a set distance, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and leaving them unable to act for 0.45s. The user's Defense and Sp. Def are decreased by 5% while this move is on cooldown.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the range of this move and auto attacks.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user shoot a flame in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit, leaving them burned and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s. After using this move, the user's next auto attack becomes a boosted attack.

Has the user cloak themself in flame and charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon the user hits and shoving them for 0.45s. When this move hits an opposing Pokémon, the user is granted a shield for 3s and this move's cooldown is reduced by 20%.
details.notes: For 3s after using this move, the cannon gauge becomes full and will not decrease after boosted attacks are used.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces the damage the user receives by 20% for 3s after this move hits an opposing Pokémon.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user materialize odd psychic waves to attack in three areas of effect in front of themself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit while ignoring 35% of their Sp. Def. The third attack throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.7s. Multiple of the areas of effect can hit the same opposing Pokémon but the second damage instance will be reduced by 25% and the third by 50%.
details.notes: For 3s after using this move, the cannon gauge becomes full and will not decrease after boosted attacks are used.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases this move's area of effect for the third area blast.

uniteMoves.name: Psykaboom
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Has the user jump up, becoming unstoppable for 1.85s, and charge psychic power for 1s, then create an area that leaves opposing Pokémon unable to act. While the user is charging psychic power, the Unite Move can be used again to adjust the position of the area. The user then fires a ball of flame towards the center of the area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and throwing them away from the center of the area.

After Ice Shard or Ice Beam is used, the user gains 10% damage resistance for 4s; after Icy Wind, Blizzard, or Unite Move is used the user gains 20% damage resistance for 5s. If move 1 or Unite Move is used after move 2 activated the ability, then the effect is dynamically upgraded to the improved version. Afterwards the ability goes on cooldown for 10s.
details.notes: Icy Wind, Blizzard, and Ice Wing Whiteout apply a freeze counter on opposing Pokémon when they hit. This freeze counter goes up to 5 stacks, lasts for 3s and refreshes when another stack is applied, and applies a stacking 12% slow based on the amount of stacks of the freeze counter. Once the freeze counter reaches 5 stacks, that Pokémon gets frozen for 1.1s.

details.detailedDescription: The user hurls a shard of ice at the designated target, applying a 30% slow for 0.3s.
details.notes: Articuno has no boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: The user blasts a gust of chilled air in a cone, in the designated direction dealing damage and freezing the ground for a short while.
details.notes: Opposing Pokémon standing on the frozen ground will have their freeze counter increased over time.

details.detailedDescription: The user summons a howling blizzard dealing damage and increasing the freeze counter on enemies hit.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the amount of hits to 8.

details.detailedDescription: The user hurls a chunk of ice in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and slowing them by 40% for 2.5s.
details.notes: If the target has at least 1 stack of the freeze counter, they will become frozen consuming the counter. If the target is already frozen the move instead deals increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: The user fires a slow traveling beam of icy cold energy in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and slowing them by 40% for 2.5s.
details.notes: If the target has at least 1 stack of the freeze counter, they will become frozen consuming the counter. If the target is already frozen the move instead deals increased damage.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the freeze duration to 2s when opponents are frozen by the move.

uniteMoves.name: Ice Wing Whiteout
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable and immobile, summoning a raging blizzard centered on themself, dealing damage in 5 waves. The second wave deals 5% more damage, third 10%, fourth 15%, and the fifth deals 100% more damage.
details.notes: If the move hits an ally goal zone, a chunk of ice forms on the zone, blocking movement and scoring. The goal zone still provides healing and shielding by standing at the edge of it. This chunk of ice will remain until it is destroyed.

damage.label: Ice Chunk
damage.description: 10,000 HP, 0 Def and SpDef. Unaffected by some status effects and damage over time.

passives.name: Huge Power
passives.description: When this Pokémon hits only a single enemy with a basic attack, a move, or their Unite Move, the hit is always a critical hit. However, when hitting two or more enemies at once with a basic attack, a move, or its Unite Move, the hits are never critical hits.

details.detailedDescription: When this Pokémon hits only a single enemy with an auto attack, a move, or their Unite Move, the hit is always a critical hit. However, when hitting two or more enemies at once with an auto attack, a move, or its Unite Move, the hits are never critical hits.
details.notes: Critical hits deal 170% rather than 200%.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage to enemies within a cone area of effect in front of this Pokémon.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage to enemies within a cone area of effect in front of this Pokémon.

base.name: Tackle
base.description: Charge forward, dealing damage to any enemy hit and leave them unable to act for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Charge forward; dealing damage to any enemy hit and leave them unable to act for 0.5s.

options.name: Play Rough
options.description: Increases movement speed for a short time and changes the next basic attack. When Azumarill performs their next basic attack, lunge at one enemy in range and deliver repeated blows; dealing damage to that target and leave it unable to act for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Further increases movement speed when this move is used, and also reduces this move’s cooldown.

details.detailedDescription: Increase movement speed by 30% for 4s and change the next auto attack. When performing the next auto attack, lunge at one enemy in range and deliver repeated blows dealing damage to that target and leave it unable to act for .75s.
details.notes: Using Play Rough will overwrite any active Aqua Tail attack change. Play Rough attacks count as auto attacks for the purpose of items, lifesteal and other benefits.
details.upgradedDescription: Further increases movement speed to 35% when this move is used, and also reduces this move’s cooldown by 1s.

options.name: Water Pulse
options.description: Shoot a pulsing blast of water in front of Azumarill. When the blast of water hits an enemy, decrease that Pokémon’s movement speed and deal damage to all enemies in an area of effect around the initial target hit. The blast of water then automatically bounces to another target if one is available. Including the first target, the blast of water can bounce between up to 3 targets consecutively, and each hit behaves in the same way as the first. While the blast of water is traveling, Azumarill can perform a short rolling dash in a designated direction.
options.upgradeDescription: Increase the maximum number of targets that the blast of water can bounce between by 2.

details.detailedDescription: Shoot a pulsing blast of water in front of Azumarill. When shooting the blast, Azumarill may perform a short rolling dash in a designated direction. When the blast of water hits an enemy, decrease their movement speed by 40% for 2s and deal damage to all enemies in an area of effect around the initial target. The blast of water then automatically bounces to another target if one is available. Including the first target, the blast of water can bounce between up to three targets consecutively, and each hit behaves in the same way as the first.

base.name: Bubble
base.description: Spray bubbles in a cone; dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed for a short time. This move can be used while moving.

details.detailedDescription: Spray bubbles in a cone dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. This move can be used while moving.

damage.label: Damage - Subsequent Hits
damage.description: Subsequent hits on the same target deal 25% damage.

options.name: Whirlpool
options.description: For a short time, four small whirlpools appear that swirl around Azumarill as they move. If a whirlpool hits an enemy, the whirlpool deals damage and restores Azumarill's HP. If a whirlpool hits an enemy player, an increased amount of HP is restored.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduce this move’s cooldown and increases the amount of HP it restored.

details.detailedDescription: For 5s, four small whirlpools appear that swirl around Azumarill as it moves. If a whirlpool hits a wild Pokémon, the whirlpool deals damage to them and restores Azumarill's HP. If a whirlpool hits an enemy player, an increased amount of HP is restored.
details.notes: Moving clockwise against your target will grant more hits against that target, and counter-clockwise will reduce the number of hits.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move’s cooldown by 2s and increases the amount of HP restored.

options.name: Aqua Tail
options.description: Increases the speed and area of effect of Azumarill's next 3 basic attacks. If these basic attacks hit from a distance, they also deal increased damage, restore Azumarill's HP, and can ignore the Defense stat and shield effects of enemies hit.
options.upgradeDescription: After activating this move, Azumarill's next 3 basic attacks will also reduce the cooldown of all moves when they hit an enemy from a distance.

details.detailedDescription: Increase area-of-effect and attack speed for the next three auto attacks by 20% for 6s. If these auto attacks hit from a distance, they also deal increased damage and restore HP. Using Aqua Tail will overwrite any active Play Rough attack change.
details.notes: Aqua Tail attacks count as auto attacks for the purpose of items, lifesteal and other benefits.
details.upgradedDescription: Aqua Tail attacks that hit from a distance reduce the cooldown of all moves by 0.8s.

uniteMoves.name: Belly Bash
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Azumarill pounds their belly 3 times, granting a shield. With each pound, Azumarill loses HP in exchange for increased Attack. Azumarill can move while pounding their belly. Afterward, target an enemy and then charge at the target; dealing damage to them and throwing all enemies hit while charging.

details.detailedDescription: Azumarill targets an enemy player and then pounds their belly three times; losing 5% remaining HP with each pound in exchange for a 6.5% max HP shield that stacks with each pound and lasts 6s. Azumarill gains increased attack for 8s and can move while pounding their belly. Azumarill then charges at the target damaging and throwing all Pokémon hit while charging and Pokémon within the area effect around the target. Azumarill is unstoppable during this move.

passives.name: Torrent
passives.description: When the Pokémon is at half HP or less, its Attack and Sp. Attack are increased.

details.detailedDescription: While at 50% max HP or below: increases Attack and Sp. Atk by 20%.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Blastoise’s third auto attack is empowered - dealing 3 instances of damage, slowing enemies hit and reducing Blastoise’s move cooldowns by 1 second each.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, reducing the cooldowns of the user's moves by 1s; damaging opposing Pokémon 3 times over 0.2s, and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1s when hit.
details.notes: Boosted attacks used during Rapid Spin hit 3 times over 0.5s, do not reduce the cooldowns of the user's moves, nor decrease the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit.

damage.label: Damage - Basic [Fully Evolved] (2x)
damage.description: When evolving into Blastoise, basic attacks hit once, but deals damage as 2 instances of 50% Attack.

base.name: Water Gun
base.description: Attacks with a shot of water, shoving enemies and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Shoots a jet of water in the designated direction after 0.2s, damaging opposing Pokémon hit, shoving them for 0.6s and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s when hit. Opposing Pokémon hit before the jet of water reaches halfway are shoved the full distance; those hit beyond halfway are shoved a short distance instead.

options.name: Hydro Pump
options.description: Has the user attack by blasing out a huge volume of water, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and shoving them when it hits.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases damage dealt by this move.

details.detailedDescription: Blasts out a huge amount of water in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit 3 times in 0.1s, shoving them and stunning them for 0.6s when hit. Opposing Pokémon hit before the blast of water reaches halfway are shoved the full distance; those hit beyond halfway are shoved a short distance instead.
details.notes: When used during Rapid Spin: Blastoise unleashes a large burst of water in a radius around themself, damaging enemies, knocking them back and stunning those hit for 0.75s. Blastoise also gains a 30% movement speed bonus for the duration of this move.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased move damage.

options.name: Water Spout
options.description: Spouts water toward the designated location, decreasing the movement speed of opposing Pokémon in the area of effect for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases damage dealt by this move.

details.detailedDescription: Casts down a barrage of water at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s over 3s (up to 6 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s when hit.
details.notes: When used during Rapid Spin: increases movement speed by 30%, and rapidly spouts bursts of water in different directions around themself, damaging opposing over time when held for the duration of Rapid Spin (up to a possible 17 times). The first hit of Water Spout during Rapid Spin on an opposing Pokémon decreases the target's movement speed; subsequent hits will not.

damage.label: Damage - Area (17 Hits) During Rapid Spin

details.upgradedDescription: Increased move damage.

upgradedDamage.label: Damage - Area (17 Hits) During Rapid Spin

base.name: Skull Bash
base.description: Fiercely rams an opposing Pokémon and leaves it unable to act.

details.detailedDescription: Tucks in their head then dashes forward after 0.5s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and stunning them for 0.5s when it hits.

options.name: Surf
options.description: Has the user charge forward on a wave, shoving enemies and leaving them unable to act. The user becomes immune to hindrances while using this move and can jump in a designated direction once this move ends.
options.upgradeDescription: Also grants a shield when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: Blastoise rides a wave of water, becoming Unstoppable for 1.6s. Blastoise can then jump off the wave in the designated direction, while the wave continues to travel. Blastoise gains a shield if the wave damages a Pokemon. Enemy Pokemon that make contact with the wave take damage and are stunned and shoved for 1.6s. The wave can be stopped by walls, and will deal no damage once Blastoise has jumped off.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the strength of the shield.

options.name: Rapid Spin
options.description: Has the user spin rapidly, changing the mechanics of its basic attacks as well as its Hydro Pump and Water Spout moves.
options.upgradeDescription: Also reduces the damage the user receives while using this move.

details.detailedDescription: Withdraws into their shell, resetting the cooldown of Hydro Pump or Water Spout and gaining hindrance resistance for the duration of this move; then starts rapidly spinning while moving freely for up to 5s or when used again to stop spinning and end this move. Damages opposing Pokémon in contact with the user every 0.5s while spinning (up to 10 times).
details.notes: While spinning: changes the mechanics of auto attacks and Hydro Pump or Water Spout. When this move ends: comes out of their shell and readies a boosted attack. The user cannot perform any actions for 0.45s while withdrawing or coming out of their shell.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases Defense and Sp. Def while using this move.

uniteMoves.name: Hydro Typhoon
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Has the user spout water to attack while spinning, throwing enemies in a large area. This also grants the user a shield.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes unstoppable for 2s and gains a shield for 4s; shoots immense jets of water in a large circle around themself after 1.1s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 1.5s when it hits.

When this Pokémon hits an enemy with an auto attack or move, that enemy receives a fire fragment for 4s and the duration of all other fire fragments on that enemy are refreshed. When an enemy has 5 fire fragments, all 5 are consumed to deal additional damage to the enemy and restore the user's HP. When this Pokémon's HP is at half or lower, more HP is restored.
Deals damage to nearby enemies. While in Kick Style, basic attacks have a higher area-of-effect and reach. While in Punch Style, attack speed is increased by 40%.
details.notes: For the purpose of auto attacks, Torchic is treated as punch style while Combusken is treated as kick style. Once Blaziken has access to their Unite move, they can swap between styles.

details.detailedDescription: Dash in a designated direction, dealing damage to enemies that come in contact with the dash. If this move hits an enemy, this move may be used again once within 4 seconds before being put on cooldown.

Unleash 2 flaming punches in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The designated direction can be changed during this move. When the user hits an enemy with this move, for a short time, this move can be used once more.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases damage dealt.

details.detailedDescription: Become Hindrance Resistant, reduce incoming damage by 25%, and charge power in place in a designated direction. If used again, unleash a flaming kick in the designed direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The longer the duration the charge is held for, the more damage this move deals. If the user charges a certain amount of power (when the gauge reaches the line indicator), this move also shoves enemies hit.
details.alert: Kick Style: This move must be taken at level 7.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases damage dealt.

details.detailedDescription: Release a small ball of fire in the designated direction, dealing damage in a small area around the first enemy hit and decreases their movement speed by 50% for 1s.

Fire a ball of focused energy in the designated direction. The ball of focused energy explodes upon hitting an enemy or after traveling a set distance, dealing damage to enemies  in the explosion's area-of-effect and decreasing their movement speed by 35% for 2s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the movement speed decrease to 60%.

details.detailedDescription: Jump backwards then kick while leaping towards a designated location, becoming Unstoppable during the jump and kick animation. Deal damage to enemies hit by the kick and shove them. The shoved enemies will have their movement speed decreased by 30% for 2s. If the shoved enemies come in contact with a wall, they will be stunned instead for 1s. Blaze Kick cannot go over walls.
details.alert: Kick Style: This move must be taken at level 5.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the movement speed decrease to 50%. Increases the stun duration to 1.5s if hitting a wall.

uniteMoves.name: Spinning Flame Fist
uniteMoves.buffs: 9% Max HP Shield. The cooldown of Energy Amplifier is increased to 30s, and the cooldown of Buddy Barrier is increased to 60s.

details.detailedDescription: Perform a flaming punch around itself, dealing damage to nearby enemies hit and increase the user's movement speed by 20% for 4s. After using this move, the user switches to Punch Style and all Punch Style cooldowns are reset.

uniteMoves.name: Spinning Flame Kick
uniteMoves.buffs: 9% Max HP Shield. The cooldown of Energy Amplifier is increased to 30s, and the cooldown of Buddy Barrier is increased to 60s.

details.detailedDescription: Perform a flaming kick around itself, dealing damage to nearby enemies hit and increase the user's Attack stat by 30% for a 4s. After using this move, the user switches to Kick Style and all Kick Style cooldowns are reset.

passives.name: Natural Cure
passives.description: Removes all status condition from the Pokémon. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

details.detailedDescription: Automatically cleanses this Pokémon every 6s, even if there are no effects to cleanse.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack after a set amount of time passes, dealing increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack after 6s, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack remains readied until used.

base.name: Pound
base.description: Has the user attack by pounding in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user pounds in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s.

options.name: Egg Bomb
options.description: Hurls an egg at the designated location. The egg then explodes, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throwing them.
options.upgradeDescription: Also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when they are thrown by this move.

details.detailedDescription: The user hurls an egg at the designated location that explodes, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them away from the center of impact for 0.8s. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move, and there is a 2s cooldown between uses.
details.notes: If the user learns both Soft-Boiled and Egg Bomb, the uses kept in reserve for Egg Bomb is added to Soft-Boiled's reserve pool; this reserve pool is shared between both moves. The base cooldown for both moves becomes 5s. The cooldown between using the same move remains at 2s.
details.upgradedDescription: Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 40% for 2s.

options.name: Helping Hand
options.description: For a short time, greatly increases the user's and nearby allies movement speed and basic attack speed. While this move's effects last, all of the user's basic attacks become boosted attacks.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the damage of basic attacks while this move's effects last.

details.detailedDescription: The user increases the movement speed and basic attack speed of themself and nearby teammates by 30% for 4s. When buffed, the user's auto attacks also become boosted attacks.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the auto attack damage of all teammates buffed by this move by 15% for 4s.

base.name: Heal Pulse
base.description: Continually restores the user's and designated ally HP for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: The user restores the HP of themself and a designated teammate every 0.5s over 2s.

options.name: Soft-Boiled
options.description: Throws an egg to an ally, restoring its HP as well as the user's HP. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move and cannot be used more than once every 2s.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the maximum number of uses that can be kept in reserve.

details.detailedDescription: The user throws an egg to a designated teammate, restoring the HP of themself and the designated teammate. The user and the designated teammate restore HP over time every 1s over 2s afterward. Subsequent uses of this move overwrites any HP over time the user and the designated teammate is yet to restore from previous uses. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move, and there is a 2s cooldown between uses.
details.upgradedDescription: Gains 1 additional use kept in reserve.

options.name: Safeguard
options.description: Blissey grants both the targeted ally and themself a shield, purging hindrances and making both immune to hindrances as long as the shield lasts.
options.upgradeDescription: Shield value increased.

details.detailedDescription: The user cleanses themself and a designated teammate, and grants the user and the teammate a shield that makes them unstoppable for 4s.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the value of the shield effect.

uniteMoves.name: Bliss Assistance
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Has the user dash to the designated ally to give it an egg, granting that ally a shield and increasing its Attack and Sp. Attack for a short time. The user also intercepts a portion of the damage received by that ally for a short time. While dashing, the user throws nearby enemies and those it comes in contact with.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and dashes to the designated ally Pokémon to give it an egg, granting that ally a shield and increasing their Attack and Sp. Atk by 20% for 6s. The user also intercepts 50% of the post-mitigation damage received by that ally as unmitigated damage for 6s. While dashing, opposing Pokémon hit are damaged and thrown into the air for 0.8s. When reaching the target ally, nearby opposing Pokémon are damaged again.

When Buzzwole knocks out an enemy player, movement speed is increased by 100% and basic attack speed increased by 50% for 3s. When Buzzwole assists in knocking out an enemy player, movement speed is increased by 50% and basic attack speed increased by 25% for 3s. Each time Buzzwole hits an enemy with basic attacks, Mega Punch, Lunge, or Smack Down - muscle gauge increases. Conversely, when Buzzwole has been out of combat for 10s, muscle gauge depletes by 1 increment every 5s. Up to 6 muscle gauge increments can be stored.

Each time a basic attack hits an enemy, increase muscle gauge by 1 increment. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, throwing two consecutive punches while restoring Buzzwole's HP and increasing muscle gauge by 1 increment for each hit.

Jump in the designated direction before slamming the ground with a powerful punch. The shock from the punch deals damage to enemies in the area. Muscle gauge increases by 1 increment for each target hit.

Lunge in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies, decreasing their Attack by 30% for 2.5s and slowing them by 30% for 1s. If this move deals damage, muscle gauge increases by 1 increment for each enemy hit. After this move is used, Buzzwole's basic attack speed is increased by 30% for 2s. Holds 2 uses in reserve and cannot be used more than once every 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: Whenever this move hits enemy players, Buzzwole's Attack increases by 10% for 2s for each player hit (up to a max of 5 stacks).

details.detailedDescription: Deliver an uppercut punch in the designated direction. The first Pokémon hit takes damage and is thrown into the air, ending with a slam on the ground that deals damage to all enemies in an area centered on the previously airborne enemy. Muscle gauge increases by 1 increment for each enemy damaged by the initial hit and slam.
details.notes: For a time after the initial hit, buzzwole can activate this move again to teleport to the target and slam them into the ground at their current position, ending the airborne travel instantly.
details.upgradedDescription: Widens the area-of-effect in which damage is dealt when the grappled enemy slams the ground. Additionally, muscle gauge will now increase by 2 increments for each enemy player hit from the slam.

details.detailedDescription: Consumes the entire muscle gauge and has the user deal damage to an enemy in the designated direction, briefly shoving and stunning them for .2s. The damage dealt by this move increases for each muscle gauge increment consumed at a rate of 12.5% per increment. If this move knocks out any Pokémon, the user recovers 10% of maximum HP.

Grab and restrain an enemy in the designated direction, becoming unstoppable and dealing damage-over-time while restoring Buzzwole's HP. When this move is used, consume the user's entire muscle gauge. The number of hits and the amount of damage dealt per hit increases for each muscle gauge increment consumed. Number of hits starts at 4 and increases by 1 per 2 increments of muscle gauge consumed. Initial damage increases by 1.5% per muscle gauge increment. This move ends if Buzzwole becomes unable to act for any reason or if the restrained enemy escapes by using an Eject Button or through some other means.
details.notes: Against Unstoppable Targets: Only 1 instance of increased damage and healing will occur.

damage.label: Healing - Percentage of Damage Dealt (per hit)

details.upgradedDescription: Also causes each instance of damage dealt by this move to be stronger than the last by 5% additively.

details.detailedDescription: Consumes the entire muscle gauge and has the user run in the designated direction and grab an enemy. The user then slams the target down on the ground at full strength, dealing damage to all enemies in the area. If Buzzwole is successful in grabbing a target, Buzzwole receives a shield that lasts for 2s. Buzzwole is unstoppable during this move.
details.notes: The damage dealt by this move is increased at a rate of 12.5% per muscle gauge increment.

damage.label: Shield
damage.description: 20% Max HP + 2% Max HP * Muscle Gauge

details.upgradedDescription: Reduces the cooldown of this move by 3s when the user's muscle gauge reaches maximum.

uniteMoves.name: Ultra Swole Slam
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Buzzwole flies at high speed, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. Afterward, the user targets the enemy with the lowest percentage of HP remaining among those hit and charges down at them from the sky, dealing area damage once again and additional damage to the targeted enemy based on their missing HP. Buzzwole is Unstoppable during this move.
details.notes: Against Wild Pokemon: Missing HP damage is not dealt.

details.detailedDescription: When Charcadet hits an enemy with an auto attack, Charcadet deals damage around themself with flames. This ability goes on a 4s cd after it's triggered.

When the user takes Attack-based damage, Ceruledge's movement speed is increased by 10% for 3s. This effect can stack up to 2 times. If Ceruledge deals damage to enemies with basic attacks or moves, the enemy hit receives a wound. Life energy leaks out of these wounds for 3s, causing damage on hit and then every 0.5s. This effect can stack up to 6 times, each stack after the first adding 50% of the first stack's damage and refreshing the duration of the damage over time. If the effect stacks 6 times on an enemy, that Pokémon takes 15% increased damage from Ceruledge.

basicAttack.name: Attack - Charcadet
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.

variants.name: Attack - Ceruledge
variants.description: Becomes a boosted attack every 4 attacks, dealing damage twice. The next basic attack after using a move becomes a boosted attack, lunging Ceruledge towards the target. After evolving to Ceruledge, basic and boosted attacks have an additional 20% lifesteal.

details.detailedDescription: Torch the area around the user with an inferno of scarlet flames, dealing damage to enemies hit. The user's next basic attack deals 15% increased damage.

Ceruledge focuses bitter feelings towards the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user recovers HP equals to 50% of the damage dealt with this move. Damage dealt to wild Pokémon only heals for half of the normal amount. Any leftover healing from the move that exceeds the user's max HP is converted into a shield (effects that alter healing directly are ignored). The shield lasts 2s, the duration is refreshed with each application, and can stack up to 10x. The maximum capacity of the shield is determined by the healing value of the most recent application.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the amount of HP recovered to 70% of damage dealt.

details.detailedDescription: Ceruledge launches a blade formed by psychic power in the designated direction, dealing damage and slowing enemies hit by 30% for 3s, and reducing their Defense for 4s. If Ceruledge hits enemies with a basic attack, this move's cooldown is reduced by 0.5s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the Defense reduction of enemies hit by this move.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user charge recklessly in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The user's basic attack speed is increased by 20% for 3s.

Dash and disappear into darkness, where Ceruledge hides for 1s. While hiding, Ceruledge cannot move. When this move is used again or after 1s has passed, the user appears in the designated direction while slashing around themself, dealing damage that ignores Defense and shields of enemies and applies a 60% slow for 1s to them. If this move hits an enemy, this move's cooldown is reduced by 40% of the max cooldown.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Ceruledge cloaks themself in flame and charges in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. Ceruledge's basic attack speed is increased by 30% for 3s after using this move. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move.
details.notes: There is a 1 second cooldown between each use, which is reduced with cooldown reduction.
details.upgradedDescription: Ceruledge's basic attack speed is instead increased for 5s after using this move.

uniteMoves.name: Revenant Rend
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Ceruledge charges both of their arm blades gaining unstoppable and 70% Damage reduction for 0.5s before slashing through to the designated location, leaving Ceruledge unable to act for 0.7s. Ceruledge also leaves enemies hit unable to act for 0.7s and applies a mark to them. After 0.7s, marked enemies are dealt damage with three slashing blows.
details.notes: The mark can be cleansed, preventing the damage.

details.detailedDescription: When this Pokémon deals damage, receive a stacking buff that makes Special damage dealt by this Pokémon ignore 5% of Special Defense per stack. This buff lasts 4s, can stack up to 6 times, and the duration refreshes when gaining a new stack.
Gains a Boosted Attack every 5s, dealing increased damage, slowing enemies by 30% for 2s and burning enemies hit for 2.5s.

boosted.detailedDescription: Burns tick every 0.5s and on application for 6 damage ticks.
boosted.notes: Burns tick every 0.5s for 5 damage ticks.

details.detailedDescription: Shoot out a small flame, dealing damage to Pokémon it hits, slowing them by 30% for 2s and leaving them burned for 2.5s. After the first cast, this move may be used again within 5s before going on full cooldown.
details.notes: Burns tick every 0.5s for 5 damage ticks.

details.detailedDescription: Shoot an intense blast of fire in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon and leaving them burned for 2.5s. The end of the blast explodes, dealing increased damage. If the explosion hits a Pokémon, this move's cooldown is reduced by 65% of its current cooldown.
details.notes: Burns tick every 0.5s for 5 damage ticks.
details.upgradedDescription: If the explosion hits a Pokémon, Chandelure deals 20% increased damage for 3s. This effect also applies to the triggering explosion itself.

details.detailedDescription: Throws consecutive flames in an arc into designated areas up to 3 times by holding the move input down. Pokémon in the area are hit and are left burned. The area may be aimed and changed during the use of this move. When one of the flames hits a Pokémon, the user gains one heat energy. If this move is used again, an exploding flame is shot out, dealing damage to Pokémon based on the heat energy and leaves them burned. The exploding flame hitting with 0, 1 or 2 heat energy reduces the cooldown of this move by 75%, 50% or 30% respectively. After the follow-up attack, the user cannot use basic attacks for a short time.
details.notes: Burns tick every 0.5s for 5 damage ticks.
details.upgradedDescription: This move's cooldown is reduced by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Makes Pokémon in the area of effect see a frightening mirage, dealing damage to them and marking them. When Chandelure deals damage again to the marked Pokémon, the marked Pokémon are stunned for 1s.

Create a zone of mysterious power and mirages of floating furniture.  Pokémon that come in contact with a mirage take damage.  Pokémon that come in contact with a mirage or the edge of the zone are slowed by 65% decaying to a 40% slow over 1s. Then the 40% slow lingers for an additional second.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the slow to 80% for 1s decaying to 50% for 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Creates a zone in front of itself lasting 4s. The first enemy caught in the zone will be immobilized for 0.7s. Furthermore, all enemy Pokémon in the zone or enter the zone become imprisoned and cannot use Moves.
details.upgradedDescription: Changes the Imprison to briefly immobilize all Pokémon caught in the zone on creation.

uniteMoves.name: Ignite Midnight
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Reduce the vision of enemies around itself by 30% for 3s. If this Unite Move is used again, Chandelure continuously fires a beam of fire in a designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon it hits. The beam may be redirected while firing and its final blast deals increased damage. Ignite Midnight can be cancelled early.

passives.name: Blaze
passives.description: While at half HP or less, critical-hit rate is increased.

details.detailedDescription: While at 50% max HP or below, this Pokémon's critical-hit rate is increased by 30%.

Breathes fire at opposing Pokémon, dealing damage 4 times per basic attack. Charizard may move while attacking but is slowed by 5% while breathing fire. Charizard deals additional damage to opposing Pokémon that have been burned by the user's moves. This additional damage cannot land critical hits; additional damage benefits from regular lifesteal. Basic attacks gain increased range upon evolving into Charmeleon and into Charizard.
details.notes: Against wild Pokémon: total damage is capped at 250 per hit. CHARIZARD'S BASIC ATTACKS ARE A SET ANIMATION LENGTH. ATTACK SPEED HAS NO EFFECT ON THIS POKÉMON. DO NOT USE RAPID FIRE SCARF ON CHARIZARD.

boosted.notes: Lifesteal will account for this damage.

base.name: Flame Burst
base.description: Attack with a bursting flame. When this move hits, it leaves enemies burned and increases the user's movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: The user attacks with a flame in the designated direction which bursts on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and burning them for 4s (dealing damage 5 times). When this move hits, the user's movement speed is increased by 20% for 3s.
details.notes: The Attack of opposing Pokémon burned by this move is decreased by 5%.

options.name: Flamethrower
options.description: Attack with an intense blast of fire. When this move hits, it leaves enemies burned and increases the user's movement speed for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage and the damage caused by burning.

details.detailedDescription: The user attacks with a blast of fire in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in a line and burning them for 4s (dealing damage 5 times). When this move hits, the user's movement speed is increased by 40% for 3s. The user is able to move freely when using this move.
details.notes: The Attack of opposing Pokémon burned by this move is decreased by 5%.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move and its burns.

options.name: Fire Punch
options.description: Punch with a fiery fist, dealing damage and shoving enemies when it hits. Also leaves the enemies it shoves burned.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduced cooldown every time a basic attack hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes with a fiery fist forward, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and shoving them, and burning the first opposing Pokémon hit for 4s (dealing damage 5 times).
details.notes: The Attack of the target burned by this move is decreased by 5%.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 0.4s per target hit every time the user's basic attack hits an opposing Pokémon. (1.6s total for an entire basic attack animation on a single target).

base.name: Fire Spin
base.description: Encircles enemies in the area of effect in a vortex of fire. After this move hits, it deals damage over time and decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: The user shoots fire in the designated direction which bursts into a vortex of fire on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The vortex of fire remains for 5s, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s (up to 10 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 25% for 1s when hit.

While flying in the air, the user is able to use basic attacks and move freely over obstacles. Unite Move basic attacks burn opposing Pokémon for 1s (dealing damage 2 times). The user restores HP for 60% of the damage dealt with Unite Move basic attacks (excluding burns or additional damage). Damage dealt by burns from Unite Move basic attacks also benefit from regular lifesteal.

Charizard's passive ability changes to Tough Claws when it Mega Evolves, increasing Defense and Special Defense by 30%, and increasing the additional damage on moves without any conditions or drawbacks. Gain a boost counter each time a move hits opposing Pokémon (maximum of 3). Whenever an autoattack is performed, 1 boost counter is consumed (if available) to make all ticks of the basic attack, critically strike. When the user deals damage with a basic attack to opposing Pokémon that have been burned by its moves, the user restores 4% of its missing HP.

Charizard deals additional damage to opposing Pokémon that have been burned by the user's moves. This additional damage cannot land critical hits; additional damage benefits from regular lifesteal. options.upgradeDescription: Widens the area-of-effect and increases the duration of its effects.

passives.description: When Cramorant uses a move, it catches some form of prey in its mouth. Afterward, when Cramorant receives damage, it spits the prey out as a counterattack at an enemy. The type of prey and effect differ based on the user's HP.

details.detailedDescription: This Pokémon can catch some form of prey in their mouth while moving through Whirlpool, Surf, or Dive. When receiving damage, counterattacks by spitting the prey in their mouth at an opposing Pokémon, damaging them and bouncing to 1 other opposing Pokémon nearby.
details.notes: When above 50% max HP, catches Arrokuda as prey, which also decrease opposing Pokémon's Defense by 20% and Sp. Def by 5% for 3s. When below 50% max HP, instead catches Pikachu as prey, which decrease opposing Pokémon's movement speed by 50% and attack speed by 10% for 1s.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every fourth attack. This boosted attack spits Arrokuda or other Pokémon at the enemy and deals area damage near the target when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every fourth attack, catching some form of prey. This boosted attack spits prey at an opposing Pokémon, damaging them and bouncing to 1 other opposing Pokémon nearby.

base.name: Whirlpool
base.description: Creates a whirlpool that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. The area of effect slowly shrinks, but the damage dealt slowly increases. Just before the whirlpool disappears, it decreases the movement speed of enemies in the area of effect for a short time. The user can also catch Arrokuda or other prey by entering the whirlpool.

details.detailedDescription: The user creates a whirlpool at a designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect over 1.8s (up to 10 times). The area of effect shrinks in size over the duration; opposing Pokémon standing at the outer edge of the whirlpool are hit only up to 3 times. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon in the area of effect is decreased by 50% for 0.2s when hit.
details.notes: The user can enter the whirlpool to catch prey for Gulp Missile (up to 2 times).

options.name: Surf
options.description: Attacks with a wave that deals damage to enemies. Once the wave has traveled its full distance, it returns the way it came, dealing damage to enemies once again and pulling them back with the wave. The user can also catch Arrokuda or other prey by entering the wave.
options.upgradeDescription: When the first wave hits enemies, it also decreases their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: The user sends a wave in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the wave. The wave reaches its maximum distance after 0.8s, then returns to its starting point at the same speed, damaging opposing Pokémon and pulling them with the returning wave, stunning them for 0.4s during the pull.
details.notes: The user catches prey with the first wave, and can enter the returning wave to catch more prey for Gulp Missile.
details.upgradedDescription: The first wave decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 40% for 3s.

options.name: Dive

The user also catches Arrokuda or other wild Pokémon as they emerge from the puddle. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move.

The next boosted attack within 5s deals additional damage; boosted attacks after 5s have passed become regular boosted attacks. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move, and there is a 2s cooldown between uses.
details.notes: The user catches prey for Gulp Missile as they emerge from the puddle.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of the dive.

base.name: Feather Dance
base.description: Decreases the Attack and movement speed of enemies for a short time.

details.upgradedDescription: Increases the user's movement speed by 20% for 3s.

options.name: Air Slash

passives.name: Sturdy
passives.description: Gains a stacking Def/SpDef buff for every 7% HP missing. Stacks up to 10 times.

details.detailedDescription: For every 7% missing HP, this Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def are increased (up to 10 times; maximum at 70% missing HP or more).

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s.

base.name: Rock Slide
base.description: Drops large rocks on the designated area. When this move hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaves them unable to act for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: The user drops large rocks at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and stunning them for 1s.

options.name: Rock Tomb
options.description: Splits open the ground toward the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and creating a barricade of rock. Activating this move again removes the barricade.
options.upgradeDescription: Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user splits open the ground in a line towards the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and decreasing their movement speed by 60% for 2s. A curved wall of rock is then created at the designated location that remains for up to 3s. When the wall of rock is created or destroyed, opposing Pokémon near the wall are damaged and their movement speed is decreased by 60% for 3s.
details.notes: The user can use this move again to destroy the wall of rock early.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the movement speed decrease from this move to 80%.

options.name: Shell Smash
options.description: Convert a set percentage of Defense and Sp. Defense into Attack and Sp. Attack and increase movement speed for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased conversion rate.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable as they smash their shell over 0.8s, reducing their base Defense and Sp. Def stats to 0 and converting 40% of the value lost to bonus Attack and Sp. Atk respectively for 4.5s. The user's movement speed is increased by 75% for the duration of the buff (decaying by 5% every 1s; minimum 55% increased movement speed before the buff ends).
details.notes: All modifiers (except emblem color bonuses) work with 0 base Defense and Sp. Def for the duration of this buff.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the conversion rate from lost Defense and Sp. Def to bonus Attack and Sp. Atk to 50%.

base.name: Fury Cutter
base.description: Slashes enemies with claws, dealing damage to them. Hitting the same enemy multiple times in succession with this move increases the damage dealt.

details.detailedDescription: The user slashes once with their claw while dashing slightly in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. Targets hit by Fury Cutter receive a mark for 9s that stacks with subsequent Fury Cutter hits (up to 3 times). Subsequent hits of this move on marked targets have 20% increased damage (maximum 40% increased damage on the third and subsequent hits from this move).
details.notes: Additional stacking damage from this move is always rounded up.

options.name: Stealth Rock
options.description: Throws many small rocks. When a rock hits an enemy or when the rocks have flown their full distance, a zone of many levitating rocks is created dealing slowly-increasing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the duration of this move's effects and decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user launches a cluster of rocks in the designated direction which expands into a trap of levitating rocks on the first opposing Pokémon or wall hit, or after traveling their max distance. This trap deals damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s over 4s (up to 8 times). Subsequent hits on targets hit by the trap within 1.5s have 15% increased damage; this damage increase stacks with subsequent hits from that trap (maximum 105% increased damage on the eighth hit).
details.notes: Additional stacking damage from subsequent hits for each trap is always rounded up.
details.upgradedDescription: The trap of levitating rocks remains for 1s longer; this move can hit up to 10 times (maximum 135% increased damage on the tenth hit). Also decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 35% for 1s.

options.name: X-Scissor
options.description: Dash forward with crossed claws, dealing damage to enemies multiple times and shoving them. Leaves enemies unable to act if they hit an object when shoved.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduced cooldown.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes and attacks with crossed claws three times in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon and shoving them for 0.2s with each attack. The third hit stuns opposing Pokémon for 1.5s if they are shoved into a wall.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

uniteMoves.name: Rubble Rouser
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Gain a shield for a short time and leave nearby enemies unable to act, dealing damage over time to them. If the user receives damage while this move is in effect, the move deals additional hits to nearby enemies.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable as they summon a whirlwind of rocks around them, gaining a shield, and stunning nearby enemies for 1s. For 10s after, the whirlwind of rocks damage nearby opposing Pokémon every 1s. If the user receives damage during Rubble Rouser, the user deals additional revenge damage to nearby opposing Pokémon (2s CD).
details.notes: The value of the shield gained from Rubble Rouser is equal to 40% max HP + 600.

details.detailedDescription: When an enemy is forcibly put to sleep near Darkrai, Darkrai deals damage to the target and gains a boosted attack. When Darkrai uses this boosted, every enemy that has been marked with bad dreams in the last 2.7s is attacked simultaneously.  Sleeping enemies near Darkrai take damage over time, and Darkrai deals 10% more damage to them while they remain asleep. Damage from this Ability doesn't wake up sleeping enemies.

Basic attacks made against sleeping enemies will become boosted attacks with greatly increased range. Boosted attacks deal damage to enemies with an attack from a void and restore Darkrai's HP. Darkrai does not require vision to perform a boosted attack against a sleeping target.
Send a hypnotic suggestion in the designated direction, dealing damage to the first enemy it hits. After 1s, the enemy will fall asleep for 2s.

Fire a ball of darkness at an enemy. Additional balls of darkness will be thrown at each enemy within in the area of effect. Enemies hit will be dealt damage and marked. The mark lasts 5s. When Darkrai deals damage to marked enemy, the marks are removed and the Enemy falls asleep for 2s.
details.upgradedDescription: Applies a 40% slow for 3s when applying a mark to an enemy.
