details.detailedDescription: Slash in a designated direction with sharp claws made from shadows, dealing damage in a line, applying a 40% slow for 3s and marking enemies hit. When the user deals damage twice to marked enemies, that marked enemy falls asleep for 2s and has their mark removed. When this move hits, this move can be used again. The second use of this move hits a designated target with huge claws, dealing damage. If there are any opposing Pokémon suffering from Bad Dreams, the second use of this move will deal increased damage.

damage.label: Damage - Huge Claw (A Pokémon has Bad Dreams)
Damage - Huge Claw In Dark Pulse
Damage - Huge Claw In Dark Pulse (A Pokémon has Bad Dreams)

details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage dealt by this move.

upgradedDamage.label: Damage - Huge Claw (A Pokémon has Bad Dreams)
Damage - Huge Claw In Dark Pulse
Damage - Huge Claw In Dark Pulse (A Pokémon has Bad Dreams)

details.detailedDescription: The user focuses their mind, increasing their Special Attack and Special Defense by 30% for 3s and Movement Speed by 50% for 3s, decaying by 10% every 0.5 seconds to a minimum of 10%.

Dash a short distance, gaining a Nasty Plot counter for 7s and refreshing the duration of all current counters. Upon using a basic attack, consume all nasty plot counters to deal damage to one of the targets hit. Upon using a boosted attack, turn the boosted and all nasty plot counters into a series of projectiles, hitting every target of Darkrai's boosted.
details.notes: A maximum of two counters may be held. Nasty Plot has no cooldown between dashes.
details.upgradedDescription: Gain one charge of this move in reserve when an enemy falls asleep.

details.detailedDescription: Hide in a shadow and create additional shadows around the hiding spot. Darkrai may freely move between the shadows. When this move is used again and held, the move ends and Darkrai appears from the shadow it dealt damage from. When this move is used again but is not held or after 4s elapses, Darkrai appears from the shadow they are currently hiding in, deals damage to enemies hit, then returns to the original shadow. Dark Pulse may then be used one more time if the move was only tapped. Darkrai will leave the shadow after 4s, dealing damage to all enemies in the shadow that Darkrai appears from.
details.notes: While hiding, Shadow Claw may be used to attack from the shadow that is being hidden in. Shadow Claws used this way will not apply the Shadow Claw mark to targets hit and deals reduced damage.
details.upgradedDescription: Dealing damage with this move causes Darkrai to gain a shield for 2.5 seconds.

uniteMoves.name: Worst Nightmare
uniteMoves.buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and casts a sleeping spell on the designated Pokémon from the opposing team. If the target is successfully put to sleep, the user's moves' cooldowns are reset, the target is marked to receive 3% max HP damage over time every 0.5s over 10s (up to 21 times; maximum 63% max HP damage as Sp. Atk-based damage), and the user sends that target into a nightmare realm centered on their initial location for up to 8s. The user follows the target into the nightmare realm. While inside the nightmare realm, Darkrai and the target are unaffected by goal zones, jump pads, and Berries. Other Pokémon outside of the nightmare realm cannot target Darkrai or their target while they're inside.
details.notes: If the designated Pokémon from the opposing team cannot be put to sleep, this Unite Move is canceled and 90% of the Unite Move gauge is refunded. This energy regeneration is affected by Energy Amplifier.

passives.name: Long Reach
passives.description: Deals increased damage to distant enemies.

details.detailedDescription: Increases Decidueye's auto attack and move damage by 20% to distant enemies.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Increases the speed of basic attacks by 3% for a short time after one hits. This effect can stack up to 4 times, and with every third activation of this effect, basic attacks become boosted attacks for a short time. These boosted attacks fire more quills, but the damage dealt by each quill is decreased.

details.detailedDescription: Increases the speed of auto attacks by 3% for 2.5s after one hits. This effect can stack up to 4 times, and with every third activation of this effect, auto attacks become boosted attacks for a short time. These boosted attacks fire more quills, but the damage dealt by each quill is decreased.

base.name: Leafage
base.description: Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. For a short time after using this move, Decidueye’s Attack and basic attack speed are increased.

details.detailedDescription: Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage in a cone to enemies hit (only hits once). For a short time after using this move, Decidueye’s Attack is increased by 10% (this also affects Leafage) and auto attack speed is increased by 25% for 3s.

options.name: Razor Leaf
options.description: Summons whirling razor leaves. For a short time after using this move, Decidueye’s Attack and basic attack speed are increased, and basic attacks can target multiple enemies for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the basic attack damage the higher the enemies remaining HP is.

details.detailedDescription: Summons whirling razor leaves.  While active, Decidueye's auto attack is replaced by a new auto attack that targets up to 2 additional enemies in range, as well as increasing Attack by 10% and auto attack speed. This buff lasts for 5.5s.
details.upgradedNotes: Adds one tick of additional damage: 2% of the main target's remaining HP and 1% for secondary targets.

upgradedDamage.label: Damage
upgradedDamage.info: Against All Enemies: The additional damage from remaining HP is capped at 240 on the main target and 120 on secondary targets.

options.name: Spirit Shackle
options.description: Charges power before firing quills in the designated direction. Damage dealt increases the longer power is charged, but movement speed is decreased while charging. If this move hits after power is charged to the maximum, it can stitch enemies to the ground. The affected Pokémon receives damage upon moving a set distance from that location, and their movement speed is decreased for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Deals increased damage to enemies with low remaining HP.

details.detailedDescription: Charges power before firing a large arrow in the designated direction. Damage dealt increases the longer power is charged (with 6 breakpoints and a max-charge at 1.3s), but movement speed is decreased by 25% while charging. If this move hits after power is charged to the maximum, it can stitch enemies to the ground. The affected enemy has their movement speed decreased by 80% for a short time when exiting the area, and receives damage upon leaving the area. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 2s cooldown between uses.
details.upgradedDescription: Deals 15% increased damage to enemies with less than 50% remaining HP.

base.name: Astonish
base.description: Deals damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Deals damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed by 80% for a short time.

options.name: Leaf Storm
options.description: Creates a tempest of sharp leaves, dealing damage to enemies it hits and decreases their movement speed for a short time. At point-blank range, it also shoves enemies hit.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the length of time that the movement speed of enemies is decreased.

details.detailedDescription: Creates a tempest of sharp leaves, dealing damage to enemies it hits and decreases their movement speed by 60% for 2.5s. The slow decays at 10% per 0.5s up to four times. At point-blank range, it also shoves and stuns enemies hit for 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: Movement speed decrease now lasts 3.5s but still decaying up to four times at 10% per 0.5s.

options.name: Shadow Sneak
options.description: Creates a shadow that takes hold of one enemy in the area of effect, dealing damage and decreasing their movement speed and Defense for a short time. Also increases Decidueye’s movement speed for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Further decreases Defense.

details.detailedDescription: Decidueye creates a shadow that lasts for up to 5s, increasing Decidueye's movement speed by 70% for 2s, decaying by 20% every 0.5s, and reveals all opposing Pokémon in range temporarily. Pokémon that are sneaking remain invisible but can be targeted by the shadow giving away their position if they were within the initial cast range. Afterwards the shadow will automatically target an enemy player that is visible to Decidueye, inflicting damage, lowering their movement speed by 30% for 1s, and decreasing their Defense by 40% for 1.5s. Wild Pokémon that are currently aggressive can also be targeted but are otherwise ignored.
details.upgradedDescription: Defense reduction of enemies is increased to 60%.

uniteMoves.name: Nock Nock
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Max HP Shield granted at the start of the Move, 30% Movement Speed granted at the end of the turret
uniteMoves.description: Fires quills in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. The move ends by unleashing a particularly large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits. This move deals increased damage if the enemies remaining HP is low. While using this move, Decidueye becomes immune to hindrances but is unable to move.

details.detailedDescription: Fires quills in the designated direction for 5s, dealing damage to enemies but does not pierce through them. The move ends by unleashing a large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits (30% more damage if the target is below 50% HP) but Nock Nock can be cancelled early. While using this move, Decidueye becomes unstoppable but is unable to move.

passives.name: Blaze
passives.description: When using a move while at low remaining HP, deal additional damage with a fireball to enemies. This Ability goes on cooldown after it’s triggered.

details.detailedDescription: When using a move when below 50% max HP, that move deals additional damage with a fireball to enemies (15s CD).

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits.

base.name: Ember
base.description: Shoot a small flame in front of itself, dealing damage to enemies hit.

details.detailedDescription: Shoot a small flame in front of itself, dealing damage to enemies hit.

options.name: Fire Blast
options.description: Launch an intense, all-consuming fire in a forward direction; dealing damage to enemies hit. As the fire travels, it leaves behind a zone of flames in which a delayed explosion will occur, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Delphox launches an intense, all-consuming fire in a forward direction; dealing damage to enemies hit. As the fire travels, it leaves behind a zone of flames in which a delayed explosion will occur; dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect.
details.upgradedDescription: Damage increased.

options.name: Mystical Fire
options.description: Unleash a special, hot ball of fire in a forward direction. If it hits an enemy, the fire will explode; dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect.
options.upgradeDescription: Also reduces cooldowns of all moves if this move hits. If it hits an enemy from the opposing team, cooldowns are reduced even further.

details.detailedDescription: Delphox unleashes a special, hot ball of fire in a forward direction. If it hits an enemy, the fire will explode; dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect.
details.upgradedDescription: Also reduces cooldowns of all moves if this move hits by 1s. If it hits an enemy player, cooldowns are reduced even further (1.5s).

base.name: Will-o-Wisp
base.description: Conjure up three sinister flames and launch them toward the designated area. These flames then explode; dealing damage to enemies hit by the explosion and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s.

details.detailedDescription: Conjure up sinister flames and launch them toward the designated area. These flames then explode, dealing damage to enemies hit by the explosion and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. An enemy will only be counted as being hit by one flame and one explosion, even if all 3 flames visually hit.

options.name: Fire Spin
options.description: Create a vortex of fire in the designated area. The vortex automatically moves toward the nearest enemy, dealing damage-over-time to all enemies caught in the area for a short time and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 5s. After 4.5s passes or an enemy is caught in the center of the vortex; the flames increase in intensity. This increases the rate at which the flames deal damage and also leaves the enemies unable to act for 1s. This trapped damage ticks four times total. The Fire Spin will otherwise deal damage as it travels. Move placement on top of enemies will apply a "searching" tick and then apply "trapped" damage. A maximum of 9 ticks is possible.
options.upgradeDescription: Applies a debuff on trap activation that increases all damage dealt by Delphox by 15% while enemies are trapped. Debuff is only cleansable after the first tick of trap damage and does not re-apply the debuff.

details.detailedDescription: Create a vortex of fire in the designated area. The vortex automatically moves toward the nearest enemy, dealing damage-over-time to all enemies caught in the area for a short time and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 4s. After 3.5s passes or an enemy is caught in the center of the vortex; the flames increase in intensity causing a trap activation. This increases the rate at which the flames deal damage and also leaves the enemies unable to act for 1s. This trapped damage ticks four times total. The Fire Spin will otherwise deal damage as it travels. Move placement on top of enemies will apply a 'searching' tick and then apply 'trapped' damage. A maximum of 9 ticks is possible.
details.upgradedDescription: Applies a debuff on trap activation that increases all damage dealt by Delphox by 15% for 3s. Debuff is only cleansable after the first tick of trap damage and does not re-apply the debuff.

options.name: Flame Charge
options.description: Charge forward in the designated direction. If there are any enemies in range when the charge ends, summon three flames to attack. The flames deal damage and decrease enemy movement speed for a short time. This move can be used while also using Fire Blast or Mystical Fire.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases Delphox's movement speed for a short time when this move is used.

details.detailedDescription: Delphox charges forward in the designated direction. If there are any enemies within auto attack range when the charge ends, summon three flames to attack. These flames deal damage and decrease enemy movement speed by 30% for 2s. This move can be used while also using Fire Blast or Mystical Fire. Each subsequent flame that hits deals 70% less.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases Delphox's movement speed by 30% for 2s when this move is used.

uniteMoves.name: Fanciful Fireworks
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Deals damage-over-time to enemies in the designated area-of-effect. Enemies that are hit have decreased movement speed and weakened HP recovery effects for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Deals damage-over-time to enemies in the designated area for 8s. Enemies that are hit have 50% decreased movement speed and 50% reduced HP recovery effects for 1.75s. Recovery effects are weakened within the zone and cannot be cleansed while in the zone. Leaving the zone will have the weakened HP recovery effects linger for 1.75s and may be cleansed after leaving the zone. 8s duration (ticks at 0.5s intervals).

Dhelmise is granted a shield whenever one of the user's moves deals damage to Pokémon from the opposing team (5s cd). Each time this Ability or other effects grant the Pokémon a shield, the Pokémon's next basic attack deals increased damage. This effect can stack up to 3 times. When the shield granted by this ability expires after 3s, HP proportional to the amount of remaining shields is restored.

damage.label: Healing
damage.description: 20% of the remaining shield value granted from Steelworker.

details.detailedDescription: The user attacks by slamming their body.
details.notes: Dhelmise has no boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user swing their anchor, dealing damage and applying a 30% slow for 2s to opposing Pokémon hit. The user deals increased damage if Dhelmise was hit with an attack while this move is being used.

Has the user slash their anchor horizontally in front of themself, dealing damage, applying a 40% slow for 2s, and granting the user a shield for 3s. The edge of the anchor deals additional damage and leaves the opposing Pokémon it hits unable to act for 0.5s instead of slowing them.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the duration opposing Pokémon are left unable to act to 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Dhelmise swings their anchor diagonally, dealing damage and applying a 40% slow for 2s to opposing Pokémon hit. Every third time this move is used, it generates a whirlpool centered on the user for 2s, continuously pulling in nearby opposing Pokémon every tick. This move's cooldown is reduced by 0.8s every time Dhelmise hits with a basic attack.
details.notes: Dhelmise can auto attack and cast moves while the whirlpool is active.
details.upgradedDescription: Further reduces this move's cooldown by 1.5s every time the user hits with a basic attack.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user shake the ground by slamming their anchor, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and throwing them for 0.5s.
Has the user throw their anchor in a designated direction catching the first opposing Pokémon hit, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act. The user then pulls the target toward Dhelmise.
details.notes: Stun duration is 0.6s from close range, and 0.8s at max range.
details.upgradedDescription: Debuffs the targeted opposing Pokémon, increasing the amount of damage they receive from all sources by 50% for 0.8s or for as long as the target is being incapacitated.

details.detailedDescription: The user lobs their anchor in a designated direction dealing damage to opposing Pokémon at the central point of impact and leaving them unable to act for 0.5s. Opposing Pokémon near the point of impact take damage and are slowed by 40% for 2s. The user then slams their heavy body down at the anchor's point of impact, dealing damage and applying an additional 40% slow for 2s to opposing Pokémon hit.
details.upgradedDescription: When the user slams their heavy body down, opposing Pokémon at the center of the point of impact are left unable to act for 0.5s.

uniteMoves.name: Seaweed Snare
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Has the user throw their anchor and ensnare a designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage and leaving the target unable to act for 0.45s. The user then charges at the target, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for 0.45s. If other Pokémon from the opposing team are hit by the anchor or the charge, they take damage and are shoved for 0.7s.
details.notes: Applies a cleansable damage over time effect to Pokémon on the opposing team that deals damage on hit and every 0.5s up to 9 times, healing Dhelmise with each tick based on damage dealt. The duration of the DoT is refreshed with each hit of the Unite Move.

passives.name: Run Away
passives.description: Movement speed is increased when enemies are nearby. While the Pokémon is moving, their sprint gauge charges. While the sprint gauge is full, movement speed is increased. If the Pokémon's movement speed decreases below a set speed, the sprint gauge will rapidly deplete. When this Pokémon scores a goal, the amount of Aeos energy deposited is evenly divided into equal portions for each head the Pokémon has.

details.detailedDescription: This Pokémon receives 10% increased movement speed when within a radius of enemy Pokémon. While moving, the sprint gauge charges from 0 to 10 (2% increased movement speed per increment). At full, Dodrio runs at 20% increased movement speed. If movement speed is decreased below a threshold, the sprint gauge will rapidly deplete. When Doduo scores a goal, it evenly divides its collected Aeos energy into two portions and deposits them into the goal one at a time. As Dodrio, this is split into three portions to deposit in the goal one at a time. Only goals made by a full emptying of the Aeos Ball will count towards stacking items.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing consecutive blows with each of the user's heads. When the sprint gauage is full, basic attacks will cause the Pokémon to charge in the direction they're facing and consume all of the sprint gauge. If this charging attack hits an enemy, all of the user's move cooldowns are reduced.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. Attacking with a full sprint gauge turns the attack into a charge in the facing direction. If the sprint gauged attack hits an enemy, all cooldowns are reduced by 1s.

base.name: Peck
base.description: Move forward while jabbing with beaks. When the sprint gauge is full, instead charge forward while jabbing with beaks. Using this move fully consumes the sprint gauge.

details.detailedDescription: Jabs forward with Doduo's beaks. When using the move, Doduo stops moving and loses sprint gauge due to dropping below the sprint gauge gaining threshold. When the sprint gauge is full, Doduo charges forward to jab the in the facing direction and fully consumes the sprint gauge.

options.name: Tri Attack
options.description: Dodrio attacks with their beaks in a cone in front of themself, dealing damage to enemies and applying one of the following random effects to enemies hit: decrease Attack and deal damage-over-time for a set amount of time, deacrease auto attack speed, or decrease movement speed. When the sprint gauge is full, Dodrio instead shoots out 3 projectiles in a designated direction. If a projectile hits an enemy, the project deals damage and applies one of the aforementioned effects based on its color. After this move is used, Dodrio's next auto attack deals additional damage and restores HP. Holds 2 uses in reserve and cannot be used more than once every 1s.
options.upgradeDescription: When the sprint gauge is full, this move's cooldown is reduced.

details.detailedDescription: Dodrio attacks with their beaks in a cone in front of themself, dealing damage to enemies and applying one of the following random effects to enemies hit: Burn, Paralyze, or Freeze. When the sprint gauge is full, Dodrio instead shoots out 3 projectiles in the facing direction. If a projectile hits an enemy, the projectile deals damage but only the first projectile of random colour/type applies one of the following enhanced random effects to enemies hit: Burn, Paralyze, or Freeze corresponding to the colour/type. After this move is used, Dodrio's next basic attack deals additional damage and restores HP. Holds 2 uses in reserve and cannot be used more than once every 1s.
details.notes: Burn: 8% Attack decrease for 2s, 12% Attack decrease if Sprint empowered. Paralyze: 8% Attack Speed decrease and 10% Movement speeed decrease for 2s, 12% Attack Speed decrease and 15% Movement speed decrease if Sprint empowered. Freeze: 20% Movement speed decrease for 2s, 40% if Sprint empowered.

damage.label: Damage - Basic
damage.description: Also heals Dodrio for 7% max HP.

details.upgradedDescription: The next auto attack gains additional healing by 3% of max HP. When using full sprint gauge attack the charge time for this move is additionally reduced by 1s.

options.name: Drill Peck
options.description: Dodrio moves forward while striking with their sharp beaks multiple times, dealing damage to enemies hit. When the sprint gauge is full, Dodrio instead dashes forward while striking with their sharp beaks multiple times, dealing damage to enemies hit and shoving them. Using this move fully consumes the sprint gauge.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown. Also, when this move hits enemies, restore a portion of Dodrio's HP based on the amount of damage dealt.

details.detailedDescription: Dodrio strikes forward with their sharp beaks multiple times, dealing damage to enemies hit. If used with a full sprint gauge, consume the sprint gauge and dash forward while striking with their sharp beaks multiple times, dealing damage to enemies hit and shoving them. During this dash, Dodrio receives 20% reduced damage.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces base cd by 2s and restores a portion of Dodrio's HP equal to 30% of damage dealt by the flat damage (percent damage excluded).

base.name: Quick Attack
base.description: Dash forward, increasing the user's movement speed for a short time and deal damage to enemies hit. This move's cooldown is reduced if it hits an enemy.

details.detailedDescription: Dash forward, increasing the user's movement speed by 30% for 2s and dealing damage to enemies hit. This move's cooldown is reduced by 1.5s if it hits an enemy.

options.name: Agility
options.description: Become immune to hindrances for a short time and fully charge the sprint gauge. Afterward, movement speed is increased for a short time, and the sprint gauge charges faster.
options.upgradeDescription: After this move is used, the sprint gauge becomes fully charged.

details.detailedDescription: Become immune to hindrances for 0.5s and adds to the sprint gauge. Afterward, movement speed is increased by 20% for 4s, and the sprint gauge charges faster.
details.upgradedDescription: Fully charges the sprint gauge on use.

options.name: Jump Kick
options.description: Dodrio leaps forward while kicking. If this move makes contact with an enemy or obstacle, Dodrio leaps over it and stomps the ground when landing, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time and the sprint gauge charges. If this move makes contact with an enemy, this move's cooldown is reduced.
options.upgradeDescription: When stomping the ground after leaping, enemies in the area are also left unable to act.

details.detailedDescription: Dodrio leaps forward while kicking. If this move makes contact with an enemy or obstacle, Dodrio leaps over it, stunning enemies by 0.5s, and stomps the ground when landing, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect, slowing by 25% for 2s, and the sprint gauge charges by 75%. If this move makes contact with an enemy, that enemy is stunned briefly from getting kicked in the head and this move's cooldown is reduced by 3s.
details.upgradedDescription: Enemies in the area of the landing are also stunned for 0.6s.

uniteMoves.name: Triple Trample
uniteMoves.buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Dodrio runs to a designated location. While running, Dodrio is immune to hindrances. If Dodrio makes contact with an enemy while running, they are dealt damage and thrown into the air. When Dodrio arrives at the designated location, Dodrio gains increased Attack for a short time, is granted a shield, and the sprint gauge charges faster for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Dodrio runs to a designated location. If Dodrio makes contact with an enemy while running, they are dealt damage and thrown into the air for 1s. When Dodrio arrives at the designated location, Dodrio gains 25% increased Attack and loses 5% Sp. Attack for 3s, is granted a 10% Max HP shield for 3s, and the sprint gauge charges faster for 6s. Damage dealt at the designated location is affected by the Attack bonus. Dodrio is unstoppable during this move.

passives.name: Clear Body
passives.description: Reduces the duration of debuff effects inflicted on Dragapult by 50%

details.detailedDescription: Reduces the duration of debuffs inflicted on this Pokémon by 50%.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Each time damage is dealt to enemies, boosted basic attack gauge increases. When the boosted basic attack gauge is full (after 8 instances of damage), the Pokémon's basic attacks become boosted attacks.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes boosted attacks when the boosted attack gauge is full, dealing increased damage in an area of effect centered on the opposing Pokémon they hit.
details.notes: Each time the user deals damage to opposing Pokémon, the boosted attack gauge increases by 1, becoming full when the user deals damage 8 times. After not dealing damage for 3s, the boosted attack gauge decreases by 2 every 0.5s.

base.name: Astonish
base.description: Lets out a sound blast in a forward direction. The shout explodes when it hits an enemy or after traveling a set distance, dealing damage in the area and decreasing their movement speed for a short time

details.detailedDescription: Lets out a sound blast in a forward direction. The shout explodes when it hits an enemy or after traveling a set distance, dealing damage in an area and decreasing enemy movement speed by 30% for 2s.

options.name: Dragon Breath
options.description: Exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed. The gust also leaves the ground burning for a set amount of time. Pokémon in this area of effect take damage over tim and have their movement speed decreased for a short time. If this move is used while the uesr is flying with Dragon Dance, the mighty gust is exhaled along Dragon Dance's flight path, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and the decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Deals increased damage and further decreases their movement speed

details.detailedDescription: The user exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. The gust leaves the ground burning for 3s, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s (up to 7 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s.
details.notes: If this move is used while the user is flying with Dragon Dance, the mighty gust is exhaled along Dragon Dance's flight path instead, with the same effects; the burning ground can hit up to 9 times.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move and the burning ground; strengthens the movement speed decrease to 45%.

options.name: Shadow Ball
options.description: Hurls a shadowy blob in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon it touches and applying a mark to them. When marked Pokémon are hit by Dragapult, they receive additional damage. The fourth time the marked Pokémon is hit, the mark is removed, but the damage dealt by the attack is further increased and the user recovers HP. After using this move, the user moves a short distance in a designated direction.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased Damage

details.detailedDescription: The user hurls a shadowy blob in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and applying a marker with 4 parts to them for 5s; then dashes in the chosen direction forward. When the user hits a marked target, one part of the marker is consumed to deal additional damage. The fourth part of the mark deals increased additional damage and removes the mark when consumed, and the user restores 20% max HP.

damage.label: Damage - Final Mark Proc Additional Damage

details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move and the additional damage from marks.

upgradedDamage.label: Damage - Final Mark Proc Additional Damage

base.name: Quick Attack
base.description: Dashes in the designated direction, increasing its basic attack speed for a short time

details.detailedDescription: Dashes in the designated direction, increasing basic attack speed by 40% for 2s.

options.name: Dragon Dance
options.description: Flies in a circular pattern in the designated direction. While flying, it continuously deals damage to nearby enemies with basic attacks that deal less damage but have increased attack speed. If this move is used again while the user is flying, the user stops flying and moves a short distance in the designated direction. If the user knocks out an enemy, this move's cooldown is reset. If the user assists in a knock out, this move's cooldown is reduced by half. When this move is used, Dragon's Breath's cooldown is reset
options.upgradeDescription: While the user is flying, its attacks also restores HP when they hit

details.detailedDescription: The user prepares a circular flight path in the designated direction, then moves into a direction either side to fly on the path; the flight path takes 3.5s to complete. While flying, the user increases their basic attack speed by 200% and they continuously use auto attacks, dealing 10% reduced damage to opposing Pokémon hit. If this move is used again while the user is flying, the user stops flying, becomes briefly invincible and dashes a short distance forward. If the user knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team, this move's cooldown is reset. If the user assists in knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team instead, this move's cooldown is reduced by 50%.
details.notes: When this move is used, Dragon Breath's cooldown is reset.
details.upgradedDescription: While the user is flying, auto attacks restore the user's HP for an additional 25% of damage dealt.

options.name: Phantom Force
options.description: For a short time, increases the user's movement speed and enters stealth. While the user is in stealth, the boosted basic attakck gauge increases. When stealth ends, Dragapult's basic attack speed is increased for a short time. After this move is learned, if the user knocks out an enemy, this move's cooldown is reset and Dragapult's Attack is increased by 6 until the end of battle. This Attack increase can stack up to 8 times.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 0.5s when the user deals damage to enemies with basic attacks.

details.detailedDescription: The user enters stealth for up to 6s or until using an attack, increasing their movement speed by 30% and increasing the boosted basic attack gauge by 1 every 1s. When the user exits stealth, the user's basic attack speed is increased by 85% for 3s.
details.notes: When this move is learned, if the user knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team, this move's cooldown is reset and the user's Attack is increased by 8 until the end of the battle (up to 10 times; maximum 80 bonus Attack).
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 0.5s per opposing Pokémon hit by the user's auto attacks.

uniteMoves.name: Dreep and Destroy
uniteMoves.buffs: 10% Max HP Shield, 10% Movement Speed for 3s. The cooldown of Energy Amplifier is increased to 30s, and the cooldown of Buddy Barrier is increased to 60s.
uniteMoves.description: Launches two Dreepy and each deals damage to different Pokémon in the area of effect. The lower the opposing Pokémon's remaining HP is, the more damage the Dreepy deal. If there is only one target in the area of effect, both Dreepy target that Pokémon and deal damage to it. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. Dreepy may be fired once every 2 seconds. Neither Cooldown Reduction nor gaining Aeos Energy reduce the cooldown of Dreep and Destroy.

details.detailedDescription: The user launches two Dreepy at up to 2 different opposing Pokémon in range, damaging them and dealing additional missing HP damage to each target. If there is only one target in range, the second Dreepy deals 30% of the full damage to the target. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this Unite Move; there is a 2s cooldown between uses for this move, and this move benefits from cooldown reduction.
details.notes: Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1200.

damage.label: Damage
damage.notes: Also deals 10% of enemy missing HP.

passives.name: Marvel Scale
passives.description: Increases Defense by 100 for 1.5s when afflicted by a status condition (Dratini and Dragonair only).

passives.name: Multiscale
passives.description: When damaged by an enemy player, gain a buff that reduces damage taken by 30% for 2.5 seconds. This ability has a 15 second cooldown.

basicAttack.name: Attack - Dratini
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, blasting water in front of Dratini, dealing increased damage, reducing the cooldown of Dratini's moves by 1s, and recover 5% max HP when this hits.

variants.name: Attack - Dragonair
variants.description: The boosted attack alternates between water and electric with every use of a boosted attack. If the water attack hits, it triggers the same effects as Dratini's boosted attack. If the electric attack hits, it leaves enemies unable to act for 0.5s and reduces the cooldown of Dragonair's moves by 1s when this hits.

variants.name: Attack - Dragonite
variants.description: The boosted attack alternates between water, electric, and fire with every use of a boosted attack. If the water or electric attack hits, it triggers the same effects as Dragonair's boosted attack. If the fire attack hits, it deals additional damage equal to 10% of the enemy's remaining HP (capped at 1200 dmg against wilds) and reduces the cooldown of Dragonite's moves by 1s when this hits.

base.name: Twister
base.description: Creates a twister and releases it in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Creates a twister and releases it in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed by 50% for 1s.

options.name: Dragon Dance
options.description: Dash in a designated direction, in one of three cycling patterns. After using this move, grant a buff increasing attack speed, movement speed, Attack by 8% (capping at 24%), as well as increasing the stage of Hyper Beam. This buff stacks up to 3 times, and the duration is reset to full on reuse. All stacks are removed after a few seconds. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of this ability by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Dash in a designated direction, alternating each use between a left arc, right arc and a direct dash. After using this move, grant a buff increasing attack speed of the next 3 auto attacks by 80% for 4.5s, increasing movement speed by 30% for 1s, increasing Attack by 10% (capping at 30%), as well as increasing the stage of Hyper Beam. This buff stacks up to 3 times, and the duration is reset to full on reuse. All stacks are removed after a few seconds. Auto attacks reduce the cooldown of this ability by 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: Further increases Dragonite's movement speed by 10% for 4.5s if there are enemies nearby when the dance ends.

options.name: Extreme Speed
options.description: Dash toward the designated location stopping upon contact with an enemy, dealing damage and throwing them.

details.detailedDescription: Dash toward the designated enemy, damaging and slowing all enemies in a small radius around the target upon impact by 50% for 2s, throwing the primary target and shoving others away.  Using this move resets the cooldown of Multiscale.
details.upgradedDescription: If Dragonite's movement speed is currently decreased when this move is used, that movement speed decrease is negated before the move is used.

base.name: Dragon Breath
base.description: Exhale a mighty gust in the designated direction. If this move hits an enemy, the user's next attack becomes a boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Exhale a mighty gust in the designated direction. If this move hits an enemy, Dragonite's next attack becomes a boosted attack.

options.name: Hyper Beam
options.description: Fires a beam of energy toward the targeted enemy after a delay, dealing damage to all enemies that it hits, as well as additional damage based on their Max HP. The move changes Stages based on the number of stacks of Dragon Dance that Dragonite has, from 0 to 3. The Max HP damage is 5%/10%/15%/20%, determined by the current Stage.  Dragonite cannot act during the duration of this move.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduces damage taken by 50% while charging this move.

details.detailedDescription: Fires a beam of energy toward the targeted enemy after a delay, dealing damage to all enemies that it hits, as well as additional damage based on their Max HP. The move changes Stages based on the number of stacks of Dragon Dance that Dragonite has, from 0 to 3. The max HP damage is 0%/6%/12%/18%, determined by the current Stage. Dragonite cannot act while releasing the beam.
details.notes: Against Wild Pokémon: The additional damage from max HP is capped at 600/1200/1800/2400 depending on the stage.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces damage taken by 50% while charging this move.

options.name: Outrage
options.description: Dragonite begins rampaging for 5s. This move starts with a ground stomp, dealing damage to enemies in an area around Dragonite. While rampaging, all of Dragonite's basic attacks become a melee boosted attack, alternating through the water, electric, and fire boosted attack types. When the rampage ends, Dragonite is left briefly unable to act.

details.detailedDescription: Dragonite stomps the ground, dealing damage to enemies in an area around Dragonite with the bonus effect of the last Boosted Attack that was used. Additionally, Dragonite gains a buff for 5.5s, increasing auto attack speed by 35% for 5.5s, converting all attacks during the duration of Outrage into melee Boosted Attacks, and alternating through the water, electric, and fire Boosted Attacks in order. When the buff ends, Dragonite is stunned for .7s.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduce the duration of hindrances inflicted on Dragonite while rampaging by 40% for 5.5s.

uniteMoves.name: Draco Impact
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Briefly fly up in the air before crashing down with several comets on a designated area, dealing damage and throwing enemies in the area. The farther Dragonite flies, the more the Unite guage is consumed (25% at min disatance and 100% at max). Dragonite is unstoppable while using this move.

details.detailedDescription: Briefly fly up in the air, becoming untargetable, before crashing down, approximately 2s after activating, with several comets on a designated area, dealing damage and throwing enemies in the area for 0.5s. The farther Dragonite flies, the more the Unite gauge is consumed (50% at min distance and 100% at max). Dragonite is unstoppable while using this move.

passives.name: Heavy Metal
passives.description: Prevents Duraludon from being thrown or shoved by the first attempt to shove or throw them. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered (50s cd).

details.detailedDescription: Prevents Duraludon from being thrown or shoved by the first attempt to throw or shove them. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered (50s cd).

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, shooting a long beam that deals a large amount of damage to all enemies hit.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, shooting a long beam that deals a large amount of damage to all enemies hit.

damage.label: Damage - Boosted (Additional)
damage.description: Deals 1.5% enemy max HP damage and can critically strike.
damage.notes: Against Wild Pokemon: This damage is capped at 500.

base.name: Laser Focus
base.description: Reduces damage received for a short time. Afterward, Duraludon's basic attacks deal additional damage to enemies hit. This buff expires after 8s or after 3 basic attacks.

details.detailedDescription: Reduces damage received by 20% for .6s. Afterward, Duraludon's auto attacks deal additional damage to enemies hit. This buff expires after 8s or after 3 auto attacks.

options.name: Flash Cannon
options.description: Duraludon ruptures the ground around themself and in a designated direction; dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1s. Afterward, go into "Cannon Mode" rooting Duraludon for 6s or if a basic attack is not made for 2.5s or this move can be cancelled early. While in Cannon Mode, basic attacks have longer range, attack speed is increased by 100% but decays by 20% per second over 5 seconds, dealing increased damage and splash damage. Exiting "Cannon mode" will prematurely remove the attack speed buff. Metal Claw, Stealth Rock, Dragon Tail, and boosted attacks can be used while in this mode and boosted attacks decrease the movement speed of enemies hit by 60% for 1s and also pierce.
options.upgradeDescription: Enemies in the ruptured ground's area of effect are also unable to act for 1s.

damage.label: Damage - Cannon Boosted (Additional) [3 hits]
damage.notes: This damage can critcally strike. Against wild Pokémon: This damage is capped at 500 per hit.

details.upgradedDescription: Enemies in the ruptured ground's area of effect are also unable to act for 1s.

options.name: Dragon Pulse
options.description: Charges power before dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Duraludon's movement speed is decreased while charging, but the longer power is charged, the wider the move's area of effect becomes and the more damage it deals. After learning this move, a damage marker will be attached to any enemy Duraludon damages. When Dragon Pulse hits a marked enemy, it deals additional damage to that target for each damage marker attached to it, then removes all of the damage markers. In addition, if this move knocks out an enemy, the cooldown is reduced by 50% and the next 3 basic attacks will each deal additional damage and further reduce this move's cooldown when they hit.
options.upgradeDescription: Also restores Duraludon's HP if this move knocks out an enemy player.

details.detailedDescription: Duraludon begins charging power, slowing itself by 30%. The longer the move is charged the greater the damage and area of effect. After learning this move a mark will be applied to any enemy Duraludon damages with auto attacks and moves. Each tick of damage from Duraludon (boosted attack counts as 1 instance) will apply 1 mark up to a maximum of 5 orbs and 1 ring. This mark lasts for 5s, is refreshed when Duraludon deals damage to the marked enemy and can be cleansed. When Dragon Pulse hits a marked enemy, the marks are consumed and additional damage is dealt for each mark. Opposing Duraludon's can consume the user's marks but will not gain the additional damage. Furthermore, if this move knocks out an enemy, the cooldown is reduced by 30% and Duraludon receives a buff for 8s or 3 auto attacks. While this buff is active, auto attacks deal additional damage and reduce this moves cooldown by 1.5s each.
details.upgradedDescription: Also restores 8% of Duraludon's max HP if this move knocks out an enemy player.

base.name: Metal Claw
base.description: Strike with sharp claws; dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. After this move is used, Duraludon's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Send sharp claws forward; dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. After this move is used, Duraludon's next auto attack becomes a boosted attack.

options.name: Dragon Tail
options.description: Duraludon shoves enemies and moves itself backward a short distance. The next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. A maximum of two uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 1.1s cooldown between uses. This move can penetrate through walls.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Duraludon shoves enemies for 0.5s and moves itself backward a short distance. The next auto attack becomes a boosted attack. This move ignores obstacles. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 2.5s cooldown between uses.
details.upgradedDescription: Apply a mark for 5s that is consumed the next time Duraludon damages them, dealing additional damage.

options.name: Stealth Rock
options.description: Hurl a stone at the designated area, creating an invisible field of stones. The field deals damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time. If the hurled stone hits an enemy before the designated area, the area of effect will instead be centered on where the stone hit that Pokémon. Once an enemy takes damage from the field, it will become visible to enemies.  If an enemy takes damage from this move 4 times, that enemy becomes unable to move for a short time. After this move is used, Duraludon's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. A maximum of two uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 1.1s cooldown between uses.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the maximum number of uses that can be kept in reserve for this move.

details.detailedDescription: Hurl a stone at the designated area, creating an invisible field of stones for 60s or until triggered. The field deals damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed by 25% for 2s, stacking up to 4 times. If the hurled stone hits an enemy before the designated area, the field will instead be centered on where the stone hit that Pokémon. Once an enemy takes damage from the field, it will become visible to all enemies. When the field becomes visible this way, Duraludon is granted a shield for 3s, can stack a maximum of 5 times, and the duration is refreshed upon gaining a stack. If an enemy takes damage from this move 2 times, that enemy becomes unable to move for 1s. After this move is used, Duraludon's next auto attack becomes a boosted attack. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 1s cooldown between uses.
details.notes: A maximum of 2 Stealth Rocks may be on the game field at one time, but 2 more can still be kept in reserve.
details.upgradedDescription: Stores 3 uses in reserve instead.
details.upgradedNotes: A maximum of 2 Stealth Rocks may be on the game field at one time, but 3 can be kept in reserve.

uniteMoves.name: Revolving Ruin
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Fire a beam of light at the ground in a sweeping circle around Duraludon. If this beam hits an enemy, it deals damage to them, grants Duraludon a shield and increases their Attack by 8% for a short time. Both the shield effect and the Attack increase are strengthened for each enemy that is hit by the beam. Damage is dealt to any enemy in the area of effect after the beam of light is fired. A burning ring is also left where the beam of light touched the ground, and enemies that touch this ring take additional damage and have their movement speed decreased by 50% for 1s refreshing as damage continus to be taken from the burning ground.

details.detailedDescription: Fire a beam of light at the ground in a sweeping circle around Duraludon, becoming unstoppable during the rotation. If this beam hits an enemy, it deals damage to them, grants Duraludon a shield and increases Attack by 8% for 8s. Both the shield effect and the Attack increase are strengthened for each enemy that is hit by the beam, stacking up to 5 times. Damage is dealt to any enemy in the area of effect after the beam of light is fired and enemies are shoved for 0.5s. A burning ring is also left where the beam of light touched the ground for 10s; enemies that touch this ring take additional damage every 0.5s and have their movement speed decreased by 50% for 1s. Subsequent hits after the first have the Attack stat bonus from this move applied to them.

passives.name: Cotton Down
passives.description: Damages an enemy and decreases its movement speed for a short time after receiving a certain amount of damage. When that happens, also recover HP and gain increased movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: When at least 5% max HP damage is received in a single attack, restores this Pokémon's HP and increases their movement speed by 15% for 1.5s; deals revenge damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and decreases their movement speed by 30% for 1.5s (10s CD).

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, attaching a bit of cotton fluff to the enemy. The user's basic attacks against an enemy with cotton fluff on it deal increased damage and decreases the enemies movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, attaching a bit of cotton fluff to opposing Pokémon for 3s and then damaging them. The user and their teammates' auto attacks against targets with cotton fluff on them deal additional damage and decrease their movement speed by 20% for 1s.
details.notes: Each teammate uses their own Sp. Atk to deal additional damage on targets with cotton fluff. This additional damage has an internal cooldown of 0.35s for each teammate.

base.name: Leafage
base.description: Pelt the target with leaves, decreasing the movement speed of enemies for a short time when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user shoots a bundle of leaves in the designated direction which explodes on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s.

options.name: Pollen Puff
options.description: Throws a Pollen Puff, which attaches to an enemy. The Pollen Puff restores HP for allies and deals damage to enemies.
options.upgradeDescription: If a Pollen Puff attaches to enemies, it also deals them damage over time. If a Pollen Puff attaches to an ally, it also reduces the damage they receive.

details.detailedDescription: The user throws a Pollen Puff at the designated location which attaches to the nearest Pokémon within 0.5s. The Pollen Puff explodes 2s after attaching to a Pokémon, restoring the HP of the user's teammates and damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.
details.notes: The Pollen Puff explodes on its own after 1s with the same effects if it doesn't attach to any Pokémon within the first 0.5s of landing.
details.upgradedDescription: If the Pollen Puff attaches to a teammate, it reduces the damage that teammate receives by 20% for 2s before it explodes. If the Pollen Puff attaches to any Pokémon, opposing Pokémon that come in contact with the target receive damage over time every 0.5s before the Pollen Puff explodes.

options.name: Leaf Tornado
options.description: Attack with a tornado of sharp leaves, leaving a path in its wake that increases ally movement speed for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Also decreases the accuracy of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user launches a tornado of sharp leaves in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit by the tornado and creating a path in its wake that lasts for 4s. Teammates on the path have their movement speed increased by 60%, lingering for 2s after leaving the path. When the tornado reaches max distance, the tornado damages opposing Pokémon a second time.

damage.label: Damage - Second Hit
damage.description: 25% of the damage of the first hit.

details.upgradedDescription: Applies a debuff to opposing Pokémon hit by the tornado that causes auto attacks to deal no damage for 2.5s.
details.upgradedNotes: Effects that only depend on auto attacks hitting and not on auto attacks dealing damage still occur.

base.name: Synthesis
base.description: Restores the HP of the user and nearby allies.

details.detailedDescription: The user uses sunlight to heal themself and teammates in the area of effect.

options.name: Cotton Guard
options.description: Protects the user and nearby allies with cotton. The cotton absorbs damage and when the move ends, the cotton restores some HP.
options.upgradeDescription: Also increases the user's movement speed while using this move.

details.detailedDescription: The user grants teammates in the area of effect cotton shields for 3s. After 3s, any cotton leftover is used to restore the HP of teammates with cotton shields for 15% of the remaining shield value.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the movement speed of teammates in the area of effect by 30% for 2s.

options.name: Cotton Spore
options.description: Gathers spores around the user, increasing the user's movement speed while this move is in effect. The spores burst after a short time, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect, throwing them, and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduced damage taken while using this move.

details.detailedDescription: The user gathers spores around them for 2s, increasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s. The spores burst at the end, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, throwing them for 0.5s and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s when it hits.
details.notes: Cotton Cloud Crash can be used during this move, ending the move early and making the spores burst immediately.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 50% for 2s.

uniteMoves.name: Cotton Cloud Crash
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Float into the air and become invincible. If used again, pound the ground, attacking and shoving enemies and restoring HP to allies in the area of effect.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes invincible as they float into the air for up to 3s, moving freely over obstacles and increasing their movement speed by 10% while in the air. If used again or after 3s, the user pounds the ground, restoring the HP of the user and teammates in the area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and shoving opposing Pokémon hit for 0.7s.

When this Pokémon deals damage to opposing Pokémon, or as time passes, the Torrent gauge increases to a max of 100. If a move is used when the Torrent gauge exceeds 50, 50 points of the gauge is consumed and the move becomes boosted.
details.notes: The rate at which the Torrent gauge increases depends on your current HP with thresholds at: above 66% HP, below 66% HP, and below 33% HP. Every second gain 1/2/3 Torrent gauge.

details.detailedDescription: Piplup shoots a blast of water, becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage. Basic and Boosted attacks increase Torrent gauge by 2/3/4.
details.notes: When evolved into Prinplup or Empoleon, basic attacks become melee ranged. The user slices with their wings, becoming a boosted attack with every third attack dealing increased damage. Boosted attack increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20. This Pokémon heals 15% of damage dealt with basic and boosted attacks.

details.detailedDescription: The user blasts a forceful shot of water in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge.
details.notes: When empowered by Torrent, this move deals increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: The user launches a watery blast in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and stunning them for 0.5s. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge.
details.notes: When empowered by Torrent, this move leaves behind a whirlpool for 3s which deals damage to opposing Pokémon, and heals the user when they stand in it, every 0.5s.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this moves cooldown by 30% of the remaining cooldown when it hits Pokémon from the opposing team.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable for 1s as they create a violent swirling whirlpool around themself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon every 0.25s up to 4 hits. The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt against Pokémon on the opposing team (this healing is halved against wild Pokémon). Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge.
details.notes: When empowered by Torrent, this move will throw opposing Pokémon for 0.6s and the user will slash once at the end of the move in the designated direction extending the unstoppable duration to 1.33s. The healing of the move is increased to 60% of the damage dealt against Pokémon on the opposing team, and 30% against wild Pokémon.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased damage and increased healing to 60% of the damage dealt (this healing is halved against wild Pokémon).

details.detailedDescription: The user jabs its sharply pointed beak in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge.
details.notes: When empowered by Torrent, this move applies a 40% slow for 2s.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user charge towards a designated target, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon with wings of steel and shoving them for 0.25s. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge.
details.notes: When empowered by Torrent, this move grants the user a shield for 3s. This shield will not stack with itself.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased the shield from Torrent.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user lunge at blinding speed in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 40% for 5s. Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when under 50 Torrent gauge.
details.notes: When empowered by Torrent, this move will also lower the special defense of those hit by 60% for 3s.
details.upgradedDescription: Lowers the base cooldown of this move by 1s.

uniteMoves.name: Sovereign Slide
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Has the user slide at high speed in the designated direction and form a whirlpool on impact, or when the maximum distance is reached, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them for 1s. The whirlpool remains centered on the user for 7s and applies a 50% slow to opposing Pokémon in the area. The slow lasts 1s when opposing Pokémon leave the area. Empoleon is unstoppable throughout this move. The longer the user slides, the faster the recovery to perform other actions.
details.notes: Increases Torrent gauge by 10/15/20 when the move connects. While the whirlpool is active the amount of Torrent gauge gained per second is increased to 12/18/24.

passives.name: Anticipation
passives.description: When Eevee would be affected by a hindrance, the hindrance is negated and Eevee becomes unstoppable for 0.45s (35s cd).

passives.name: Magic Bounce
passives.description: When Espeon would be affected by a hindrance, the hindrance is negated and Espeon becomes unstoppable for 0.45s while retaliating against the enemy that triggered the ability, dealing damage and applying a 30% slow for 1s (35s cd).

basicAttack.name: Attack - Eevee
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.

variants.name: Attack - Espeon
variants.description: Becomes a boosted attack whenever 5 seconds pass, firing a beam in front of the user. The beam deals increased damage and decreases the movement speed of targets hit by 30% for 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Eevee launches three stars at target location. Stars start in a horizontal line perpendicular to Eevee's facing. Stars continue to fly in the direction once past the target location until the maximum range is reached. When an enemy is hit by a star, subsequent stars deal 70% less damage.

Espeon materializes psychic projectiles and launches them at a designated location; dealing damage to enemies hit by the projectiles and decreasing their movement speed for each projectile hit by 15% for 3s (maximum 75%). Orbs start in a horizontal line perpendicular to Espeon's facing and continue flying in the  designated direction until the maximum range of the move. Targets hit by all five projectiles are stunned for 1.25s. When an enemy is hit by a projectile, subsequent projectiles deal 70% less damage. When Psyshock is enhanced via Future Sight reset, it launches stronger psychic projectiles at a designated location. These projectiles at their point of convergence cause an explosion, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. There is no damage increase.
details.upgradedDescription: Increase the speed at which projectiles travel.

details.detailedDescription: Unleash blasts of psychic power at random enemies within an area; dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed from each projectile hit by 10% for 2s (maximum 50%). Espeon stores one blast of psychic power every 2s (unaffected by cooldown reduction), or after hitting an enemy with a boosted attack (gaining 1 stored blast per enemy hit). Up to five blasts can be stored at once. After this move is used, Espeon's movement speed is increased by 70% for 1.2s. Targets hit by a psychic blast will take 70% less damage from subsequent hits. When Stored Power is enhanced via Future Sight reset, it unleashes an increased number of psychic blasts (8 total) and restores Espeon's HP by 150 per blast.
details.upgradedDescription: Also deals additional damage to enemies below 50% max HP.

details.detailedDescription: Growl at a designated enemy; dealing damage and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s.

Fires a peculiar ray in the designated direction. If the beam hits an enemy, it will then split beyond the first enemy hit and deal damage to other enemies in range. The initial enemy hit and these split rays deal more damage based on the max HP of the first enemy hit by the ray. If the first enemy hit by the ray is slowed or is stunned, those same effects will be applied to the enemies hit by the split rays. The split rays follow Espeons relative facing direction and will refract at a maximum of a 90 degree angle. Distance from initial target to split ray hit is 75% of the max range. Stun copied duration is the maximum duration of the stun causing the initial Pokémon to be stunned.
details.notes: For the split ray, the damage component from the initial target's max HP damage is capped at 1000 against Wild Pokémon and capped at 2000 against Player Pokémon.

damage.label: Damage - Additional
damage.description: 6% max HP of the first enemy hit as additional damage.

details.upgradedDescription: Deals additional damage to enemies that are unable to act. If Psybeam hits an unable to act initial target, the split rays will also deal the additional damage to other enemies hit and leaves them unable to act.
details.upgradedNotes: Against Wild Pokémon: The additional damage from max HP is capped at 1000.

upgradedDamage.label: Damage - Additional (Stunned)
upgradedDamage.description: 5% max HP of the enemy hit as additional damage if the initial target was stunned and if the secondary target can be stunned.

details.detailedDescription: Espeon locks-on to an enemy, dealing damage 2 seconds later in an area centered on the locked-on target. Deal more damage based on the locked-on targets missing HP. While locked-on to an enemy, Espeon's other moves will target that enemy whenever possible. If the center of Psyshock is within the area-of-effect of Future Sight when released, Psyshock will home in on the Future Sight affected target. Each time Espeon deals damage to a Future Sight locked-on target through Psyshock, Stored Power, auto attacks, Future Sight's cooldown is reduced by 0.8 seconds. If the locked-on target is an opponent, and is knocked out by Future Sight or by Espeon, then a single powered-up use of Psyshock or Stored Power becomes available for a short time.
details.notes: Full Heal and other cleanses such as Blissey's Natural cure remove Future Sight. Against Wild Pokémon: The total damage is capped at 1800.
details.upgradedDescription: Espeon deals 15% additional damage to locked-on targets.

uniteMoves.name: Psychic Solare
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Espeon throws enemies in the area of effect into the air and suspends them using psychic power. After a delay, an explosion occurs that deals damage to all enemies in the area of effect and shoves them. Espeon is unstoppable during this move.
The critical-hit modifier of enemies is reduced by 50% when dealing damage to Falinks. Falinks can hold 10 more Aeos Energy than other Pokémon.
details.notes: Falinks is a group comprised of the Brass and five Troopers. Each member of the group has a separate hitbox and counts as a different target. The Brass always takes 10% reduced damage. Troopers will take 90% less damage while attached to the Brass. For attacks or moves that can hit multiple targets, the total damage Falinks can take from a single move or attack is 110% of that move or attack's damage.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, or after the user uses Tackle, Megahorn, or Iron Head. Boosted attacks also apply a 50% slow for 1s to opposing Pokémon they hit.
details.notes: When a boosted attack hits, the cooldown of Tackle, Megahorn, or Iron Head is reduced by 2.5s

details.detailedDescription: Charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and shoving them. The user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
Charge with its horns, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them in the air for 0.25s. Immediately afterward, strike with its horns again and gain a shield for 3.5s.
details.notes: In No Retreat formation: Falinks becomes hindrance resistant and charges power for 1s. It then strikes forward with its horns, dealing additional damage to opposing Pokémon it hits based on their max HP and gaining a shield for 2.5s. This version of the move has a 4s cd that is separate from the column version.

damage.label: Damage (No Retreat Formation)
damage.notes: Deals additional damage equal to 5% of the enemies' max HP. This additional damage is capped at 1000.

damage.label: Damage (Dispatch formation Trooper)
damage.description: Trooper damage becomes additional to Column formation hitting the same target.

details.upgradedDescription: Increases the shield value.

details.detailedDescription: Attacks the designated area with its steel-hard heads, dealing damage and applying 50% slow for 1.5s to opposing Pokémon it hits, as well as granting itself a shield.
details.notes: In No Retreat formation: The move's range is shortened but the area of effect is widened. Pokémon hit in the landing area are also knocked up and briefly stunned for 0.33s. After using this move, for the next 4 attacks, the user can attack while moving with the Brass and Troops all deal damage separately in front of them.
details.upgradedDescription: Iron Head and the Troopers returning deal an additional 2% max hp damage to enemies they hit, capped to 400.

details.detailedDescription: Increases the user's Defense, Special Defense and Attack Speed by 25%, and Attack by 30% for 3s

Switch to No Retreat formation while shoving enemies for 0.4s in front of Falinks and become unstoppable during the formation change for 0.5s. While in No Retreat formation, the user cannot change the direction they're facing, unless they use the other move. Falinks' movement speed when moving backward is slowed by 10%, but Attack is increased by 25% and damage taken from the front is reduced by 30%. If this move is used while the user is in No Retreat formation, the user will switch to Column formation.
details.notes: While in No Retreat formation both the Brass and Troopers take 30% less damage from the front. The Brass' total damage reduction becomes 37%; the Trooper's total damage reduction becomes 93%.

damage.label: Damage - Brass basic attacks under Iron Head Buffs in No Retreat formation
Damage - Brass boosted attacks under Iron Head Buffs in No Retreat formation
Damage - Trooper basic attacks under Iron Head Buffs in No Retreat formation
Damage - Trooper boosted attacks under Iron Head Buffs in No Retreat formation

details.upgradedDescription: Attack increase is increased to 40% and damage reduction from the front is increased to 35%.
details.upgradedNotes: While in No Retreat formation both the Brass and Troopers take 35% less damage from the front. The Brass' total damage reduction becomes 41.5%; the Trooper's total damage reduction becomes 93.6%.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The user then switches to Dispatch formation, sending out two Troopers toward enemies that were hit. The dispatched Troopers will continue to attack enemies, but they will return to the Brass after they either: take a set amount of damage, become separated from the Brass by more than a set distance, or after 5s. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move with a 0.5s cooldown between each use.
details.notes: While in Dispatch formation, the Troopers sent out no longer have any damage resistance nor share damage taken with the Brass. Dispatched Troopers share the same stats as the Brass, except for HP.

damage.label: Damage - Trooper attacks in Dispatch formation

details.upgradedDescription: Also restores HP when this move hits.

uniteMoves.name: Dust Devil Formation
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Has the five troopers run continuously around the Brass at great speed for 5s, dealing damage and slowing enemies hit by 20% for 1s. Falinks is unstoppable during the formation change for 0.25s. While this move is being used, damage taken by the troopers is reduced. While in Dust Devil formation the Troopers take 30% less damage making the Trooper's total damage reduction 93%.
details.notes: Moving counter to the rotation of the troopers will grant more hits against that target, and moving along the rotation will reduce the number of hits.

details.detailedDescription: While this Pokémon's HP is at half or less; reduces move cooldowns by 20% of the max cooldown for future move uses.
The user slashes their claws at opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to them.
details.notes: This Pokémon has no boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Empowers the next basic attack for up to 5s with extra damage, the user bites with its viciously sharp fangs dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon by 35% for 1.5s.

The user cycles between 3 Fangs for up to 5s. When a Fang is chosen; empowers the next basic attack with extra damage, and a variety of effects based on the chosen Fang for up to 5s. After landing the empowered basic attack, the user's attack speed increases by 140% for 5s or 3 hits. After hitting an opposing Pokémon with a Fang, a mark is left for 5s. There are three marks, one for each Fang, the more marks there are the more damage Big Jaw Bite will deal, as well as refreshing the duration of the effects from the Fangs. Future uses of this move will cycle starting from the last effect chosen.
details.notes: Destructive Fangs (Yellow): deals increased damage and reduces the defense of opposing Pokémon by 30% for 5s when landing the empowered basic attack. Gluttonous Fangs (Red): after landing the empowered basic attack, for the next 5s basic attacks restore extra HP once per attack. Clamping Fangs (Purple): after landing the empowered basic attack; slows opposing Pokémon by 80% for 3s, decaying by 15% every 0.25s down to 20%.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes in the designated direction, raking opposing Pokémon with sharp claws dealing damage and stunning them for 0.6s.

The user becomes Hindrance Resistant, gaining a shield for 3s, and begins storming in the designated direction for up to 3s. This move can be manually cancelled, or ended by colliding with a wall. This move will pierce through wild Pokémon, but stops when colliding with Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage and stunning or throwing them depending on how far the user travelled.
details.notes: There are 7 damage thresholds based on how far the user travelled, each one increasing the damage of the point blank hit by 10%. At point blank range the move will stun opposing Pokémon for 0.2s. Travelling a short distance will cause the move to throw opposing Pokémon for 0.45s. Travelling a medium distance will cause the move to throw opposing Pokémon for 0.67s. Travelling a long distance will cause the move to throw opposing Pokémon for 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: The point blank hit will now throw opposing Pokémon for 0.45s.

uniteMoves.name: Big Jaw Bite
uniteMoves.buffs: 50% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable while letting out an intimidating growl, reducing move cooldowns by 40% of the remaining cooldown, and reduces move cooldowns by 40% of the max cooldown for future move uses while this move is active for up to 15s. Additionally the user's tenacity is increased by 30% for 15s.
details.notes: When this move is used again, the user becomes Unstoppable and charges at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and sinks their teeth into them, dealing damage and stunning them for 0.4s. The amount of damage dealt is based on the number of Fang marks applied by Crunch.

passives.name: Rough Skin
passives.description: When struck by a melee attack, a portion of the damage received is reflected back at the attacker.

details.detailedDescription: When damaged by a nearby opposing Melee Pokémon, reflects 12.5% of the damage received back to that opposing Pokémon as Attack-based damage (0.6s CD).

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every fifth attack, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP. Every time a basic attack or move hits an enemy, basic attack speed is increased.

details.detailedDescription: Gains 1 stack toward boosted attacks after hitting an auto attack or move, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, all basic attacks become boosted attacks with increased attack speed and additional 30% lifesteal, dealing increased damage to opposing Pokémon, and dealing an additional 10% remaining HP damage to them. All stacks decay after 4s of not hitting an auto attack or move.
details.notes: Against wild Pokémon: basic attack damage is capped at 1000; boosted attack damage is capped at 1100; additional remaining HP damage is capped at 350.

base.name: Sand Attack
base.description: Hurls sand, narrowing the field of vision of enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time. Also increases movement speed and basic attack speed.
