details.detailedDescription: The user hurls sand in the designated direction, reducing the field of vision of opposing Pokémon by 50% and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s; increasing the user's movement speed by 30% for 2s and auto attack speed by 30% for 3s when this move hits.

options.name: Dig
options.description: Burrow underground and move quickly in the designated direction, jumping out when coming in contact with an enemy or when traveling the maximum distance. This jump deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them.
options.upgradeDescription: Damage received is reduced for a short time after jumping out of the ground.

details.detailedDescription: The user digs underground, becoming untargetable while underground, and dashes quickly forward. The user then jumps out from underground beneath the first opposing Pokémon hit, after traveling max distance, or when coming into contact with an unpassable wall, increasing the user's Defense and Sp. Def for 4s, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and throwing them for 0.6s.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the duration of the throw to 1s.

options.name: Dragon Rush
options.description: Back up to create distance before diving to attack in the designated direction, shoving enemies. The user can use Dragon Claw while creating distance at the start of this move to create a combo attack. (This move can crit)
options.upgradeDescription: Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when they are shoved the maximum distance.

details.detailedDescription: The user jumps back and briefly channels, reducing damage received by 45% for 0.9s, and dives forward, dragging all enemies within a small radius to the designated location, then damaging nearby opposing Pokémon afterward.
details.notes: The user can use Dragon Claw during the first half of the channel to add the Dragon Claw hits as a combo attack. This combo attack scoops up opposing Pokémon, dealing damage with both Dragon Rush and Dragon Claw's first attack and stunning them. If the combo attack hits, the user then throws opposing Pokémon back down with the second Dragon Claw attack, dealing damage with a strengthened slow.
details.upgradedDescription: Becomes unstoppable during this move; this includes the combo attack with Dragon Claw.

base.name: Bulldoze
base.description: Stomp down on the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.

details.detailedDescription: The user stomps down on the ground, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.

options.name: Earthquake
options.description: Jump high into the air and crash forcefully to the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
options.upgradeDescription: Decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time if they are in this move's area of effect.

details.detailedDescription: The user jumps up and crashes forcefully to the ground, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s. Two aftershocks follow the initial crash, dealing less damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the movement speed decrease of opposing Pokémon near the center of the crash to 40%.

options.name: Dragon Claw
options.description: Attack twice in front of itself using its claws. The first attack deals damage to enemies and throws them. The second attack deals increased damage. After the move ends, basic attack speed is increased for a short time. (This move can crit)
options.upgradeDescription: Increase damage dealt.

details.detailedDescription: The user charges in the designated direction viciously and attacks with two claw swipes. The first attack damages opposing Pokémon and shoves them in the designated direction. The second attack deals more damage to opposing Pokémon and decreases their movement speed by 45% for 2s.
details.notes: When this move is used in a combo attack with Dragon Rush, the movement speed decrease on the second attack is strengthened to 60% for 2s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of both attacks.

uniteMoves.name: Livid Outrage
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Has the user unleash a powerful chain attack while dashing forward. The final attack throws enemies but also leaves the user unable to act for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: The user goes berserk, becoming unstoppable and receiving 30% reduced damage for 5s while unleashing five powerful attacks in a row. The user dashes forward and damages opposing Pokémon in a unique designated area with each attack, taking a brief moment after each attack to aim the next dash. Every attack more damage than the last. The fifth attack throws opposing Pokémon hit and decreases their movement speed by 30% for 1s. The user is left confused for 0.5s afterward.

passives.name: Synchronize
passives.description: When an enemy inflicts decreased movement speed or a damge-over-time condition on the Pokémon, the same is inflicted on that opponent. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

details.detailedDescription: When an opposing Pokémon decreases this Pokémon's movement speed, also decreases that opposing Pokémon's movement speed by 40% for 3s; or, when an opposing Pokémon inflicts a damage-over-time status condition on this Pokémon, also inflicts a damage-over time effect on that opposing Pokémon for 3s (8s CD).

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their Sp. Defense by 10% for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their Sp. Def by 10% for 2s.

base.name: Confusion
base.description: Attacks straight in the designated direction.

details.detailedDescription: The user fires a psychic bolt in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and decreasing their movement speed by 35% for 1s.

options.name: Psychic
options.description: After hitting an enemy or traveling its maximum distance, deals damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed and Sp. Defense by 20%, stacking up to 3 times.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduced cooldown.

details.detailedDescription: The user launches a psychic bolt in the designated direction which blasts on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The blast creates a lingering field that slowly moves forward, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 60% for 1s (up to 5 hits). Each time this move hits opposing Pokémon, their Sp. Def is decreased by 27% for 4s (maximum 81%).
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

options.name: Moonblast
options.description: Has the user attack while moving back to create distance. When the move's blast hits, it deals damage to enemies in a cone and leaves the enemy closest to the user unable to act for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Also grants a shield when this move is used.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes back slightly and launches a blast of moonlight in the designated direction which bursts into a cone behind the first opposing Pokémon hit, stunning that opposing Pokémon for 1.6s and damaging all opposing Pokémon in the cone area of effect, including the target.
details.upgradedDescription: Grants the user a shield for 3s when launching the blast.

base.name: Teleport
base.description: Has the user warp to the designated area, increasing the damage dealt by one basic attack after warping.

details.detailedDescription: The user readies a boosted attack and warps forward to the designated location.
details.notes: When this move is learned, passively increases the damage of Synchronize, auto attacks, and Confusion by 15% until this move is replaced.

options.name: Psyshock
options.description: Attacks the designated location three times. This move's cooldown is reduced each time one of these attacks hits an enemy.
options.upgradeDescription: Increase the damage this move deals each time one of its attacks hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user channels at a designated area relative to their position before launching three attacks in succession, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and reducing the user's moves' cooldowns by 15% with each attack that hits.
details.notes: The user is able to attack and move freely while channeling this move.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of the next attack to hit each time an attack hits an opposing Pokémon.

options.name: Future Sight
options.description: Sets a delayed explosion. When the explosion hits an enemy, it reduces this move's cooldown.
options.upgradeDescription: Reset this move's cooldown when the explosion hits an enemy.

details.detailedDescription: The user sets a delayed explosion at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon when the delayed explosion hits. If this move hits a Pokémon from the opposing team, the cooldown of this move is reduced by 75% and the user's movement speed is increased by 40% for 1.5s.
details.upgradedDescription: Resets this move's cooldown when it hits a Pokémon from the opposing team.

uniteMoves.name: Fairy Singularity
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Warps Space in the designated area, drawing in enemies to the center. Shoves and deals damage to enemies the instant the warped space disappears.

details.detailedDescription: The user warps space in the designated area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and pulling them toward the center 4 times. As the warped space disappears, it deals increased damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and shoves them away from the center.

passives.name: Levitate
passives.description: Increases movement speed by 10% when out of combat. (5s after leaving combat)

details.detailedDescription: When this Pokémon has not been in combat for 5s, their movement speed is increased by 20%.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an enemy and dealing damage.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon and dealing increased damage to opposing Pokémon hit.

base.name: Will-o-Wisp
base.description: Shoot multiple sinister flames, dealing damage to enemies and leaving them burned when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user shoots 3 sinister flames in a cone in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and burning them for 4s. The first flame deals full damage to each target hit; subsequent flames deal 50% of the full damage to the same target.
details.notes: The burn deals damage over time every 0.5s for 2s (dealing damage 3 times), and decreases Attack and Sp. Atk by 10% for 4s.

options.name: Shadow Ball
options.description: Hurl a shadowy blob at the target, decreasing the movement speed and Sp. Defense of enemies for a short time when it hits.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: The user hurls a shadowy blob in the designated direction which stops at the first Pokémon from the opposing team hit, damaging opposing Pokémon hit, decreasing their movement speed by 90% for 1s, and decreasing their Sp. Def for 3s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

options.name: Sludge Bomb
options.description: Hurl unsanitary sludge to the designated area, leaving enemies poisoned when it hits.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased poison duration.

details.detailedDescription: The user hurls unsanitary sludge to the designated area, poisoning opposing Pokémon in the path of the hurl or in the designated area for 5s (dealing 1% max HP Sp. Atk-based damage every 0.5s; maximum 10%), and damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect where the sludge lands.
details.notes: Against wild Pokémon: poison damage is capped at 120 per tick.

damage.label: Damage - Poison (10 Ticks)
damage.description: 1% Enemy Max HP every 0.5s (as special damage)

details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens poison duration to 6s (dealing maximum 12% max HP Sp. Atk-based damage).

base.name: Lick
base.description: Attacks with the user's tongue and pulls enemies toward the user.

details.detailedDescription: The user extends their tongue in the designated direction, stopping at the first opposing Pokémon hit, damaging the target and pulling them toward the user's location.
details.notes: The user readies a boosted attack when this move is used.

options.name: Dream Eater
options.description: Puts enemies to sleep when it hits. If used again while a nearby enemy is asleep, the user appears behind the target and attacks, restoring HP and reducing the cooldown of Shadow Ball or Sludge Bomb.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage and HP restored.

details.detailedDescription: The user projects a hypnotic orb in the designated direction, putting the first opposing Pokémon hit to sleep for 1s and applying a Dream Eater marker on them for 5s. If a nearby opposing Pokémon has a Dream Eater marker or else is asleep when the hypnotic orb disappears, this move can be used again within 5s. This second use has the user instantly teleport behind the target, damaging the target, restoring the user's HP, and reducing the cooldown of Will-O-Wisp, Shadow Ball, or Sludge Bomb by 2s.
details.notes: The user readies a boosted attack each time this move is used. If the user knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team, the cooldown of this move is reset.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage dealt and HP restored by this move.

options.name: Hex
options.description: Disappear and move to the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect when the user reappears. If this hits an enemy that is afflicted by a status condition, it deals increased damage and its cooldown is reduced.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes invincible for 0.33s and vanishes, then reappears at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon afflicted by a status condition, the damage dealt to opposing Pokémon is doubled and the cooldown of this move is reduced by 90%.
details.notes: The user readies a boosted attack when this move is used.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

uniteMoves.name: Phantom Ambush
uniteMoves.buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Jump to the designated area and start sneaking with increased movement speed. If this move is used again, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable as they jump forward to the designated location, then enters stealth and increases their movement speed by 30% for 7s. The user exits stealth when they use an attack. If this Unite Move is used again, the user becomes invincible for 0.55s as they jump out to attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1.5s when it hits.
details.notes: The user readies a boosted attack each time this move is used.

passives.name: Run Away
passives.description: When Eevee would be affected by a hindrance, the hindrance is negated and becomes invincible for 1s. This Ability goes on cooldown after it’s triggered (70s cd).

passives.name: Snow Cloak
passives.description: When Glaceon would be affected by a hindrance, the hindrance is negated. Glaceon then starts sneaking and becomes invincible for 0.5s. This Ability goes on cooldown after it’s triggered (70s cd) and is reset after respawning.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and giving Glaceon 2 ice crystals when the boosted attack hits. Ice crystals last 5s and the duration is refreshed upon gaining additional crystals. Glaceon can hold a maximum of 8 ice crystals at a time.

base.name: Swift
base.description: Creates 4 stars around the user. For a short time afterward, each time the user hits an enemy with a basic attack, one of the stars (or 2 stars in the case of a boosted attack) will shoot out and deal additional damage to that enemy.

details.detailedDescription: Creates 4 stars around the user. For a short time afterward, each time the user hits an enemy with a basic attack or boosted attack, one or two of the stars respectively will shoot out and deal additional damage to the target.
details.notes: Upon evolving, the move's effect will immediately expire.

options.name: Icicle Spear
options.description: Has the user launch all of their stored ice crystals in rapid succession at the designated enemy. If no ice crystals are stored when this move is used, 2 ice crystals are instantly created and all crystals are launched. The crystals shatter when they hit the designated target, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. Launched ice crystals can hit enemies on the opposing team that are not the designated target of this move. If this occurs, the ice crystals will still shatter on impact and deal damage in an area in the same way. Ice crystals launched by this move deal increasing damage each time they hit the same enemy. After this move is used, the cooldown of Ice Shard or Freeze-Dry is reduced.
options.upgradeDescription: Each launched ice crystal also deals additional damage to enemies hit, equal to a set percentage of their max HP.

details.detailedDescription: Glaceon launches all of its stored ice crystals in rapid succession at the designated enemy. If Glaceon has no ice crystals when this move is used, 2 ice crystals are instantly created and are launched. Launched ice crystals can hit enemies on the opposing team that are not the designated target of this move. The crystals shatter when they hit any enemy, dealing damage to all enemies in the area. Ice crystals launched by this move deal  5% increased damage each time they hit the same enemy (capped at 35%). When this move is used, Ice Shard's cooldown is reduced by 2s and Freeze Dry's cooldown is reduced by 2.5s. A maximum of 12 ice crystals may be launched.
details.notes: Against wild Pokémon; ice crystals will pass through the Pokémon that are not the designated target, dealing damage but not benefitting from the consecutive hit bonus.
details.upgradedDescription: Each launched ice crystal also deals additional damage to enemies hit equal to 0.5% of their remaining HP.  When crystals pass through wild Pokémon who are not the designated target, this additional damage is not applied.
details.upgradedNotes: Against Wild Pokémon: This additional damage is capped at 300.

options.name: Icy Wind
options.description: Jump a short distance in the designated direction. Glaceon's next basic attack launches all stored ice crystals at an enemy, dealing damage to them. Glaceon then regains the same number of ice crystals that were launched. If Glaceon hits the same enemy with 1 or more ice crystals, that enemies movement speed is decreased for a short time. The more ice crystals that hit that target, the stronger this movement speed-decrease effect. If Glaceon has no ice crystals when this move is used, gain 2 ice crystals.
options.upgradeDescription: Each launched ice crystal also deals additional damage to the enemy hit, equal to a set percentage of their max HP.

details.detailedDescription: Jump a short distance in the designated direction; Glaceon's next auto attack within 5s gains increased range and launches all stored ice crystals at an enemy, dealing damage to them. Glaceon then regains the same number of ice crystals that were launched. If an enemy is hit by 4 or more ice crystals, their movement speed is decreased by 8% per shard (stacking up to 6 times) for 1s. If Glaceon has no ice crystals when this move is used, gain 2 ice crystals.
details.upgradedDescription: Each launched ice crystal also deals additional damage to enemies hit equal to 1.5% of their remaining HP.
details.upgradedNotes: Against Wild Pokémon: This additional damage is capped at 300.

base.name: Tail Whip
base.description: The user wags their tail at an enemy, dealing damage and decreasing their Defense, Sp. Def, and movement speed for a short time. The user's next basic attack after using this move becomes a boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user wag its tail at an enemy, dealing damage and decreasing their Defense and Sp. Def by 30% for 2s, and movement speed by 20% for 1.5s. The user also readies a boosted attack.

options.name: Ice Shard
options.description: Increase movement speed for a short time. Afterward, Glaceon's basic attack speed increases for a short time, and basic attacks change into attacks that hurl chunks of ice. These chunks of ice deal damage to enemies hit and decrease their movement speed for a short time. Every time a chunk of ice hits, the user gains 1 ice crystal. The user gains 2 ice crystals if this move is used while launching ice crystals with Icicle Spear, or if it's used after Icy Wind has been used, but before the user has launched all ice crystals with the next basic attack.
options.upgradeDescription: Also increases basic attack speed for the duration of this move's effect.

details.detailedDescription: Glaceon gains 40% movement speed for 1s and 60% basic attack speed for 2.5s. Basic attacks change into attacks that hurl chunks of ice for 2.5s. These chunks of ice deal damage to enemies they hit and decrease their movement speed by 30% for 1s. Each time a chunk of ice hits, Glaceon gains 2 ice crystals.
details.notes: If this move is used while launching crystals with Icicle Spear, Glaceon will gain 2 ice crystals extending the barrage if used in time, and will be able to use the special basic attacks afterwards if the move still has some duration left. If this move is used after Icy Wind but before launching all crystals with the next auto attack, Glaceon will gain 2 ice crystals.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases basic attack speed further to 100% for 2.5s.

options.name: Freeze Dry
options.description: Glaceon shoots out a freezing burst of air in a forward direction, increasing Sp. Atk for a short time. . This burst explodes upon hitting an enemy or after traveling a set distance; dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. For each enemy hit by the explosion, Glaceon gains 1 ice crystal. The explosion also leaves behind an ice zone. Enemies that enter this ice zone will have their movement speed decreased. If they remain in the ice zone for a set amount of time, they become frozen for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: For each enemy hit by this move's explosions; gain 1 ice crystal.

details.detailedDescription: Shoot out a freezing burst of air in the designated direction. This burst explodes upon hitting an enemy or after traveling a set distance; dealing damage to all enemies in the area. Upon hitting an enemy, increase Glaceon's Sp. Atk by 50% for 4s. For each enemy hit by the explosion, Glaceon gains 2 ice crystals. The explosion also leaves behind an ice zone which slows enemies that enter by 30% for 3s. If they remain in the ice zone for 2.5s, they become frozen for 0.6s.
details.upgradedDescription: For each enemy hit by this move's explosions, Glaceon gains 1 additional ice crystal.

uniteMoves.name: Glacial Stage
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Leap up high, creating an ice zone in front of Glaceon that deals damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. While Glaceon is in the ice zone, movement speed is increased and Glaceon gains 1 ice crystal whenever a set amount of time passes. The movement speed of enemies in the ice zone is decreased.

details.detailedDescription: Glaceon leaps up high in the air, increasing movement speed by 40% for 1s, and creates an ice zone in in the designated direction that deals damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. The zone lasts 6s and while in the ice zone, Glaceon's movement speed is increased by 50%, and gains 1 ice crystal every second. The movement speed of enemies in the ice zone is decreased by 50% for 2s, and is refreshed every 1s.

When this Pokémon is hit by an attack, there is a chance it will spread slime around itself. The slime deals damage to Pokémon, Decreases their attack speed by 50% for 2s and applies a Gooey debuff. The Gooey debuff slows Pokémon by 10% for 6s and can stack up to 4 times per Pokémon. Gooey is a debuff that is applicable to Wild Pokémon and enemy players only.
details.notes: When this Pokémon enters tall grass, it continually recovers HP for up to 3s, until it leaves the tall grass, uses a move, or attacks. When this Pokémon recovers HP due to Gooey, its attack gauge is progressed towards a boosted attack. This HP recovery goes on a 10s cooldown after being triggered.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. Hitting a Pokémon afflicted with a Gooey effect with a basic attack reduces all of this Pokémon's move cooldowns by 1.5s.
details.notes: Boosted attacks spew slime and if the slime hits Pokémon from a distance, a Gooey debuff is applied to those Pokémon and slows by 50% for 0.5s. If the boosted attack is used on a Pokémon in regular attack melee range, the attack deals increased damage.

damage.label: Damage - Additional (Melee)
damage.description: 3% Max HP damage (Capped at 500 on Wild Pokémon)

details.detailedDescription: Cover itself in a bubble, granting it a shield for 3s. When the shield’s effect duration ends or if this move is used again, the bubble shield pops, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

Splashes muddy water around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and applying an effect to them that decreases the amount of damage they deal by 20% for 3s. If the user deals damage to opposing Pokémon with this move, the user’s Defense and Sp. Def are increased for 2s. If Muddy Water is used within 6 seconds, the defense bonus effect is increased in intensity. The defenses bonus effect can stack up to four times.
details.upgradedDescription: Further increases the user’s Defense and Sp. Def when this move deals damage to opposing Pokémon.

details.detailedDescription: Unleashes a shock wave in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon it hits up to 4 times. If the center of the shock wave hits enemy Pokémon, it deals increased damage to them and restores the user’s HP. More HP is restored when the center of the pulse deals damage to enemy Pokémon that have a Gooey slowing effect applied to them.
details.notes: The fourth tick of damage can be animation cancelled by inputs (attack or movement). It is undetermined if this is a bug or not.

damage.label: Damage (Center - per hit up to 4 hits)
Damage (Side - per hit up to 4 hits)
Healing (Per hit up to 4x based on number of Center hits)
Healing (Gooey Center- Per hit up to 4x based on number of Center hits)

details.upgradedDescription: Restores more HP if the center of the shock wave hits Pokémon, and even more on Pokémon that have a Gooey debuff applied to them.

upgradedDamage.label: Healing (Per hit up to 4x based on number of Center hits)
Healing (Gooey Center- Per hit up to 4x based on number of Center hits)

details.detailedDescription: Charges at a Pokémon, dealing damage and throwing it. If this move hits, the user bounces back a short distance.

Lashes out with its horns in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon in the area of effect and slowing them by 80% for 3s, decaying by 15% every 0.5s. If this move hits distant Pokémon, those Pokémon are pulled toward Goodra.
details.upgradedDescription: Also applies a Gooey effect when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: Spits acidic fluid at target Pokémon, dealing damage to Pokémon in an area of effect centered on the target slowing them by 80% for 3s, decaying by 15% every 0.5s. If this move is used again within 5s, Goodra charges in the designated direction and deals damage to opposing Pokémon hit. If this charge hits a Pokémon that has been marked by acidic fluid, that Pokémon is thrown for 0.75s, and damage is also dealt to nearby opposing Pokémon.
details.upgradedDescription: Also applies a Gooey effect to opposing Pokémon that receive damage from either the acidic fluid or the charge.

uniteMoves.name: Right as Rain
uniteMoves.buffs: 40% Max HP Shield, 50% Movement Speed

details.detailedDescription: Causes rain to fall around the user, gradually restoring the user’s HP over 6s. While this move is active, all of the user’s basic attacks become boosted attacks.

passives.name: Cheek Pouch
passives.description: When Greedent eats a berry, recover HP after receiving the effects of the berry. At the same time, Greedent stashes another berry in its tail. Being hit by a single attack or combination of attacks will cause a berry to drop from Greedent's tail.

details.detailedDescription: When Greedent eats any berry, recover HP after receiving the effects of the berry. At the same time, Greedent stashes an Oran berry in its tail. Being hit by a single attack or combination of attacks will cause an Oran berry to drop from Greedent's tail (4.5s cd). Berries stay on the ground for 10s.
details.notes: Oran berry or unite move berry heals Greedent for 1% Max HP + 3x(Lv-1) + 23; Sitrus or Salac berry heals Greedent for 1% Max HP + 0x(Lv-1) + 23. All other players heal from picking up an Oran berry for 2% Max HP + 5x(Level-1) + 45 (level and Max HP scaling is based on the player that ate the Oran berry).

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits and causing one berry to drop from Greedent's tail.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits and causing one Oran berry to drop from Greedent's tail.

base.name: Tackle
base.description: Leap to the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed for a short time. If this move is used while Covet is active, no area can be designated for the user to leap to. Instead, while the user is running, damage is dealt in an area to enemies in front of Greedent. If Greedent has any berries stashed, consume all of them, reducing Tackle's cooldown for each berry consumed.

details.detailedDescription: Leap to the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 1s. If this move is used while Covet is active, no area can be designated for Greedent to leap to. Instead, while running, damage is dealt in an area to enemies in front of Greedent. If Greedent has any Oran berries stashed, consume all of them, reducing Tackle's cooldown by 1s for each berry consumed.

options.name: Bullet Seed
options.description: Spit berry seeds in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed for a short time. The more berries Greedent has stashed, the more damage this move deals.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Spit berry seeds in the designated direction for 6s; dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s. Greedent fires more seeds for each Oran berry stashed.
details.notes: Fires 1 wave of seeds every 0.8s while held down (up to 7.5 waves). Launches 1 seed every 0.1s per wave; fires a minimum of 3 seeds, plus 1 additional seed per Berry stored before a Berry is consumed (up to 5 additional seeds; maximum 8 seeds total per wave).
details.upgradedDescription: Increased damage.

options.name: Belch
options.description: Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed for a short time. If Greedent has any berries stashed, consume all of them, reducing Belch's cooldown for each berry consumed.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed by 40% for 2s, decreasing by 10% every 0.5s. If Greedent has any Oran berries stashed, consume all of them, reducing Belch's cooldown by 1s for each berry consumed (capping at 4s). This move's cooldown cannot be reduced beyond 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased damage.

base.name: Defense Curl
base.description: Grants Greedent a shield for a short time. In addition, a berry will drop in front of Greedent.

details.detailedDescription: Grants Greedent a shield (10% max HP) for 3s. In addition, an Oran berry will drop in front of Greedent.

options.name: Stuff Cheeks
options.description: Greedent drops several berries, which can be eaten to recover HP. Any HP recovered that exceeds Greedent's max HP will be converted to a shield. If Greedent catches sight of a berry while using this move, movement speed is increased for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Increase the number of berries dropped.

details.detailedDescription: Greedent drops 5 Oran berries, which can be eaten to recover HP. Any HP recovered from an Oran berry eaten within 5s that exceeds Greedent's max HP will be converted to a shield for 1.8% max HP per berry (capped at 9% max HP or 5 berries). If Greedent catches sight of a berry while using this move, movement speed is increased by 70% for 6s, but decreasing by 15% every 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increase the number of Oran berries dropped by 1.

options.name: Covet
options.description: Greedent runs with all its might, becoming unstoppable and dealing damage to enemies hit and throwing them. While running, Greedent drops berries. Eating a dropped berry increases movement speed for a short time. The more berries eaten, the more movement speed is increased. In addition, Belch or Bullet Seed can also be used while running.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage dealt and increased frequency of berries dropping.

details.detailedDescription: Greedent runs with all its might for 6s; becoming resistant to hindrances (for 6.1s), dealing damage to enemies hit and throwing them. While running; Greedent drops Oran berries every 1s. Eating a dropped berry increases movement speed by 22% for 1s (stacking up to 5 times). In addition, Tackle, Belch or Bullet Seed can also be used while running and using this move will reset the cooldown of Tackle or Belch.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased damage and increased frequency of Oran berries dropping (8 berries over 6s).

uniteMoves.name: Berry Belly Flop
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Greedent eats a berry to recover HP and then leaps to the designated area, dealing damage and throwing enemies within the area of effect. Greedent then eats a special berry, allowing an unlimited amount of berries to be stored for a short time and resets cooldowns of all moves.

details.detailedDescription: Greedent eats a special berry to recover 15% max HP and then leaps to the designated area; dealing damage and throwing enemies within the area of effect for 1s. Greedent then eats another berry, allowing an unlimited amount of Oran berries to be stored for 8s and resets cooldowns of all moves. Greedent is unstoppable during this move.

passives.name: Torrent
passives.description: While HP is at 50% or less, Attack and movement speed are increased.

details.detailedDescription: While at 50% max HP or below, increases Attack by 5% and movement speed by 12%.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. At long range, a boosted attack deals increased damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time. At close range, a boosted attack deals more damage the lower the enemies remaining HP is.

details.detailedDescription: Auto attacks differ depending on range, and become boosted attacks with every third attack, dealing increased damage. Auto attacks used at long range reduce the cooldown of Bubble, Water Shuriken, or Surf by 0.5s when they hit. Boosted attacks used at long range also decrease the movement speed of the opposing Pokémon hit by 25% for 0.5s.
details.notes: Auto attacks used in close range instead deal a bonus 5% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon hit. Boosted attacks used in close range dash through the target, dealing a bonus 10% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon hit instead. Against wild Pokémon: the missing HP damage of auto attacks used in close range is capped at 500.

base.name: Bubble
base.description: Attack with a spray of bubbles, decreasing the movement speed of enemies when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: Sprays 2 bubbles in the designated direction which pop when they hit an opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed by 25% for 1s when each bubble hits.

options.name: Water Shuriken
options.description: Throw shurikens made of water in quick succession. Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time and restores the user's HP when it hits. Also increases the user's movement speed while using this move.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the number of shurikens thrown.

details.detailedDescription: Increases movement speed by 25% for 3s and throws 4 shurikens made of water in the designated direction which explode when they hit an opposing Pokémon, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed by 35% for 1s when each shuriken hits; and restoring HP for each opposing Pokémon hit.
details.upgradedDescription: Throws 5 shurikens.

options.name: Surf
options.description: Ride a wave, dealing damage to enemies and restoring the user's HP. If this move knocks out an enemy, its cooldown is reset. In addition, this move deals increased damage to enemies with low HP.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the amount of HP restored.

details.detailedDescription: Dashes on a wave forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and restoring HP for each target hit. Deals bonus damage to opposing Pokémon below 50% max HP. If this move hits and the user knocks out an opposing Pokémon before it goes on cooldown, the cooldown of this move is reset.
details.notes: Against wild Pokémon: the damage of the wave is capped at 1200; bonus damage is capped at 600.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the HP restored by this move.

base.name: Substitute
base.description: Leaves behind a substitute doll for the user while it's moving forward.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes invincible and dashes forward, leaving behind a Substitute doll in their place which lasts for 3s.
details.notes: The Substitute doll has the same HP, Defense and Sp. Def as the user; the Substitute doll receives 500% of the damage the user would take.

options.name: Double Team
options.description: Quickly moves the user away from the current position, creating illusory copies of it to aid in battle.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduced cooldown.

details.detailedDescription: Briefly vanishes then becomes unstoppable and dashes forward, sending two illusionary copies diagonally behind which last for 3s.
details.notes: The copies have the same HP, Defense and Sp. Def as Greninja when created, but receive 500% of the damage they would otherwise take. The clones attack nearby opposing Pokémon with Bubble, Water Shuriken, or Surf (whichever move the user has learned), and auto attacks; but deal 15% of the damage they would otherwise deal.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

options.name: Smokescreen
options.description: Creates a smokescreen and has the user roll away from its current location. Immediately afterward, the user begins sneaking and has its movement speed increased for a short time. This also makes its next basic attack a boosted attack.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased attack for a short time when the user stops sneaking.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes unstoppable and dashes forward, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s, entering stealth for 2s, readying a boosted attack that deals increased damage, and leaving behind a cloud of smoke which lasts for 3s. Exits stealth when using an attack.
details.notes: Opposing Pokémon in the cloud of smoke have their field of vision reduced by 60%.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases Attack by 20% for 2s when exiting stealth.

uniteMoves.name: Waterburst Shuriken
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Throw a giant water shuriken toward the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when this move hits. The water shuriken then immediately explodes, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them. Once this move ends, the user may jump in a designated direction.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes unstoppable and leaps up to throw a giant water shuriken toward the designated circular location, damaging opposing Pokémon it hits on the way to the circular area of effect (from beyond the range of the user's close range auto attacks) and decreasing the movement speed of those hit by 50% for 2s. The user then suddenly appears on top of the water shuriken which immediately bursts, damaging opposing Pokémon in the circular area of effect again and throwing them.
details.notes: Leaps off the burst water shuriken and becomes vulnerable to hindrances again as they jump down to the ground in the direction of their choosing.

passives.name: Rattled
passives.description: When damaged, increases movement speed by 5% for 3s (up to 5 times; maximum 25%).

details.detailedDescription: When damaged, increases movement speed by 5% for 3s (up to 5 times; maximum 25%).
details.notes: Increases the effort gauge each time Magikarp uses an auto attack or move, hits with an auto attack or move, scores a goal, knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team or assists in knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team. Once the effort gauge is full, Magikarp evolves into Gyarados.

passives.name: Moxie
passives.description: When knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team or making an assist, reduces current move cooldowns by 30%.

details.detailedDescription: When knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team or making an assist, reduces current move cooldowns by 30%.
details.notes: Gyarados passively gains bonus 1200 HP, 100 Attack, and 40% basic attack speed until the end of the battle; these stats are not affected by boost emblem color bonuses.

variants.name: Attack - Gyarados
variants.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Magikarp has no boosted attack.
details.notes: Magikarp's basic attacks are a set animation length.

details.detailedDescription: Flails on the spot, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon; damage strengthens for every 33% max HP the user is missing.

Exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them for 3s when it hits, decreasing their movement speed and basic attack speed by 30%. If this move hits, gains a buff for 5s; increasing the range and damage of auto attacks; and increasing basic attack speed by a minimum of 30%, strengthening by 10% for each additional opposing Pokémon hit (up to 2 times; maximum 50%).
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage dealt by this move and enhanced auto attacks.

details.detailedDescription: For up to 4s while this move is held; moves slightly in the designated direction then swings a blade of water from their tail in the designated direction (up to 5 times), damaging opposing Pokémon hit with each blade.
details.notes: If at least 3 blades of water hit opposing Pokémon before this move is released or ends, a second stage of this move can be used within 5s; becomes unstoppable and charges for up to 1.5s, then attacks with a large sweep of their tail in a wider area forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. If the second stage is charged for at least 0.5s, increases the range of the area of effect and damage dealt.
details.upgradedDescription: The boosted aqua tail deals an additional 20% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon. Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1000.

details.detailedDescription: Jumps to the designated location forward.
details.notes: A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve, with a 2s cooldown between uses.

details.detailedDescription: Charges forward up to 3 times, damaging opposing Pokémon hit with each charge; waiting for at least 0.07s before dashing forward with the next charge. The first charge is a regular dash forward; the next movement within 2s after the last charge dashes forward with the same effect. Dragon Breath or Aqua Tail can be used within the 2s duration in between charges without interrupting this move's course. Using Dragon Current ends this move early.
details.notes: If two charges hit opposing Pokémon, grants a shield for 2s. If all three charges hit opposing Pokémon, the third charge throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.45s.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduce this move's cooldown by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes unstoppable and charges power for up to 2.4s, becoming fully charged after 0.8s; then bounces to the designated location forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area upon impact. While charging power, increases the range of this move, reaching maximum range when fully charged.
details.notes: If fully charged when released, grants a shield for 5s, and throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.7s. If this move is canceled, it goes on a 2s cooldown.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the value of the shield effect.

uniteMoves.name: Dragon Current
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Becomes untargetable and dives underwater for up to 4s while this Unite Move is held, increasing movement speed by 45%. When released or after 4s, forcefully leaps up and attacks, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. The longer the move is held, the larger the area of effect becomes.
details.notes: If the user stays underwater for at least 1s before releasing the Unite Move, strengthens the movement speed increase to 55%; deals increased damage and creates a whirlpool where they surface, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect (up to 5 times) and decreasing their movement speed for 4s when hit. If underwater for at least 2s, strengthens the movement speed increase to 65%; deals even more damage and creates a waterspout where they surface instead, throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s.

details.detailedDescription: When the Pokémon uses a move, their movement speed increases by 30% for 3s. Each time this Pokémon knocks out an opposing Pokémon, scores a goal, or otherwise makes a contribution in battle, their effort gauge increases. Once the gauge is full, the Pokémon evolves into Gyarados.
This Pokémon decreases the Attack of opposing Pokémon they damage by 30% for 3s.
details.notes: Upon evolving, Gyarados passively gains bonus 1200 HP, 100 Attack, and 40% basic attack speed until the end of the battle; these stats are not affected by boost emblem color bonuses and are maintained when mega evolved.

details.detailedDescription: Gyarados' passive changes upon mega evolving. Gain 10% Atk, 30% Def Penetration, 10% Def, and 10% SpDef.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.
details.notes: Magikarp and Mega Evolved Gyarados do not have a boosted attack. Mega Evolved Gyarados lunges when using a basic attack.

details.detailedDescription: Flails on the spot, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon; damage strengthens for every 33% max HP the user is missing.

Exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them for 3s when it hits, decreasing their movement speed and basic attack speed by 30%. If this move hits, gains a buff for 5s; increasing the range and damage of auto attacks; and increasing basic attack speed by a minimum of 30%, strengthening by 10% for each additional opposing Pokémon hit (up to 2 times; maximum 50%).
details.notes: If the user is mega evolved, instead Mega Gyarados becomes unstoppable then chases down and performs 5 special auto attacks on targets hit by this attack.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage dealt by this move and basic attacks.

details.detailedDescription: Jumps to the designated location forward.
details.notes: A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve, with a 2s cooldown between uses.

details.detailedDescription: Charges forward up to 3 times, damaging opposing Pokémon hit with each charge; waiting for at least 0.07s before dashing forward with the next charge. The first charge is a regular dash forward; the next movement within 2s after the last charge dashes forward with the same effect. Dragon Breath can be used within the 2s duration in between charges without interrupting this move's course. Using Dragon Current ends this move early. This move's cooldown begins when the move ends. If two charges hit opposing Pokémon, grants a shield for 2s. If all three charges hit opposing Pokémon, the third charge throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.45s.
details.notes: If the user is mega evolved, instead the cooldown begins when the move is used. Additionally, the previous shield and throw effects are granted even if the move misses, and the cooldown of the move is reduced by 10% for each dash that hits.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

uniteMoves.name: Dragon Current
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Becomes untargetable and dives underwater for up to 4s while this Unite Move is held, increasing movement speed by 45%. When the button is released, the user leaps up forcefully and attacks. If the user stays underwater for 1s, Gyarados strengthens the movement speed increase to 55% and creates a whirlpool when surfacing, applying a continuous slow to opposing Pokémon hit. If the user stays underwater for 2s, Gyarados strengthens the movement speed increase to 65% and creates a waterspout when surfacing, throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. The longer the move is held, the larger the area of effect becomes.
details.notes: After using this Unite Move, the user Mega Evolves for 15 seconds.

details.detailedDescription: If this Pokémon doesn't take damage from enemy Pokémon (Wild Pokémon do not count) for 3s, it will recover 3% max HP every 2 seconds. Damage to shields will not deactivate Regenerator. Ho-oh additionally recovers 0.3% max HP every 2 seconds.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, shooting out a sweeping flame that deals increased damage and restores HP per enemy Pokémon hit. While firing the sweeping flame Ho-Oh's movement speed is decreased by 30%.
Create a protective field around the user that reduces the next incoming source of damage by 50%. When this field reduces damage from an attack, the user's movement speed is increased by 40% for 3s.

Shoot a mystical fireball at an area, dealing damage to non-allied Pokémon it hits, stunning them for 0.6s, and leaving them burned for 3s, reducing their Attack by 10%. Then fly up high into the air for up to 6s. The next 3 basic attacks are boosted attacks. While flying, the user is able to move freely over walls and its attack is increased by 25% and movement speed is increased by 30%. If this move is used again, the user lands cancelling the attack and movement speed bonuses.
details.notes: Ho-Oh may not interact with objects on the ground such as Berries or Aeos Energy but may score on goal zones.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the Attack reduction of the burn to 20%.

details.detailedDescription: Generate a blazing vortex around yourself and gain a shield. While the vortex is active, Ho-Oh slows itself by 40% and cannot attack. The first time an enemy interacts with the vortex, they receive an 80% movement speed decrease decaying by 10% every 0.5s over 4s. The vortex also deals damage to enemies. If allies are within the vortex, 60% of post-mitigation damage those allies would take is redirected to Ho-Oh as true damage (without ignoring shields).
details.notes: If there is a shield after 4s or if this move is used again while this move's shield is intact, a heat wave is released around the user, dealing damage to enemies, and additional damage equal to the percentage of the damage the shield received. The emitted heat wave additionally stuns non-allied Pokémon it hits for 0.6s,  There is a 1.5s delay before the shield may be detonated from the start of the vortex. If the shield is destroyed before detonation, no damage is dealt.
details.upgradedDescription: When the shield is broken, the heat wave is now automatically released.

details.detailedDescription: Whip up a whirlwind in designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit. The whirlwind then remains on the field for 5s. Allies moving in the same direction as the whirlwind have their movement speed increased by 30% as long as they are in the field and lasting for 0.5s after stepping out of the field. Opposing Pokémon moving against the whirlwind have their movement speed decreased by 30% lasting for 0.5s after stepping out of the field.

Blow flames in a designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit every 0.25s and slowing Ho-Oh's movement speed by 15%. This move may be held for up to 4s to blow flames for longer. This move's cooldown increases the longer flames are blown for. If enemies are hit, the user recovers HP. If enemies are hit thrice, they are burned, refreshing on additional hits of flamethrower.
details.notes: Burned enemies take damage over 3s at 0.5s intervals. Burned enemies also have their movement speed decreased by 15% for 1.5s, their attack decreased by 20% for 2s, and their special attack decreased by 20% for 1.5s. Enemies burned by Flamethrower will leave behind a scorched area. Enemies traversing the scorched area are slowed by 15%. Enemies that touch the area will also receive burns but this burn will not spread the scorched area.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the length of time flames may be blown to 5s.

details.detailedDescription: Ho-Oh spreads their wings and charges in a loop. While charging, deal damage to enemies hit and burn the ground along the flight path for 4.5s. The burning ground deals damage to enemies that touch it every 0.5s and slows them by 30% for 1.5s. If this move is used again or if another move is used mid-charge, then the user stops in place.
details.notes: During the flight, Ho-Oh receives 30% less damage.
details.upgradedDescription: While the Ho-Oh is on burning ground, gradually restore HP.

uniteMoves.name: Rekindling Flame
uniteMoves.buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: When a nearby ally is knocked out, a feather is left in their place until they respawn at base. When Rekindling Flame is used, Ho-oh spreads their wings and consumes all of the Aeos energy held to revive knocked-out allies where their feathers are for 60% of their maximum HP. Rekindling Flame may only be used if there are feathers nearby. The number of available revivals are based on how much Aeos energy is consumed. One ally may be always revived. Up to two allies are revivable if at least 9 energy is consumed. Up to three allies are revivable if at least 17 Aeos energy is consumed. Up to four allies are revivable if at least 25 Aeos energy is consumed.

passives.name: Magician
passives.description: In battles where the map is divided into an ally team side and an opposing team side, this ability creates a hole under one of the berries on the opposing team's side (chosen at random) and warps it in front of Hoopa. If there are no berries, but there is Aeos Energy on the ground, then some energy is warped in front of Hoopa instead. In the event that no berries from the opposing team's side are warped, the cooldown of this ability is reduced.

details.detailedDescription: In battles where the map is divided into an ally team side and an opposing team side, this ability creates a hole under one of the berries on the opposing team's side (chosen at random) and warps it in front of Hoopa (40s cooldown). If there are no berries, but there is Aeos Energy on the ground, then some energy is warped in front of Hoopa instead. In the event that no berries from the opposing team's side are warped, the cooldown of this ability is reduced to 20s. Berries last 30 seconds and take 2 seconds to appear after magician's activation.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies by unleashing a beam of light. When Hoopa is unbound, every attack becomes a boosted attack and deals damage to up to 2 additional nearby enemies.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies by unleashing a beam of light.

base.name: Astonish
base.description: Deals damage to enemies in the designated area of effect, leaving them unable to act for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Deals damage to enemies in the designated area of effect, leaving them unable to act for .75s.

options.name: Phantom Force
options.description: Hoopa creates a portal ring under itself and warps to a designated location, dealing damage to nearby enemies at that location and shoving them. Hoopa then shoots two sinister flames that deal damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed for a short time. This move can be used a second time within a set amount of time. If used a second time, Hoopa can return to the initial location they warped from. When using this move, if there is a nearby ally that is linked by Trick, that ally can also warp to the initial ring's location. The ally that warps in this way will recover HP.
options.upgradeDescription: Become invincible for a short time when this move is used.

details.detailedDescription: Hoopa creates a portal ring under themself and warps to a designated location, dealing damage to nearby enemies at that location and shoving them. Hoopa then shoots two sinister flames that deal damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed by 40% for 2s. This move can be activated a second time within 3.5s and if activated, Hoopa can return to the initial ring's location. If there is a nearby ally that is also linked by Trick, that ally can warp to the initial ring's location and recover 15% max HP.
details.upgradedDescription: Become invincible for .6s when this move is used.

options.name: Shadow Ball
options.description: Unleash a shadowy blob in front of Hoopa, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed and Sp. Def for a short time. If Hoopa then hits the same enemy with a move or boosted attack within a set amount of time, it deals additional damage and leaves the enemy unable to act for a short time. When using this move, if there is a nearby ally linked by Trick, this move will also unleash a shadowy blob at the same target from that ally's location.
options.upgradeDescription: The shadowy blob will now explode before disappearing. Enemies hit by the explosion are affected as if they were hit by the shadowy blob itself.

details.detailedDescription: Unleash a shadowy blob in front of Hoopa, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1s and Sp. Defense by 30% for 3s. If Hoopa then hits the same enemy with a move or boosted attack within 4s, deal additional damage and leave the enemy unable to act for .8s. When using this move, if there is a nearby ally linked by Trick, this move will also unleash a shadowy blob at the same target from that ally's location.
details.upgradedDescription: The shadowy blob will now explode before disappearing. Enemies hit by the explosion are affected as if they were hit by the shadowy blob itself.

base.name: Confusion
base.description: Unleash a telekinetic force in the designated direction, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. The telekinetic force clings to that enemy and then causes a delayed explosion. The explosion deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Unleash a telekinetic force in the designated direction, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. The telekinetic force clings to that enemy and then causes a delayed explosion. The explosion deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed by 50% for 0.5s.

options.name: Hyperspace Hole
options.description: Hoopa creates a large ring at the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. After a set amount of time, Hoopa and any allies in the area of effect will return to their base, and their movement speed will be increased for a short time. These allies can also warp back to where the ring was created. An intact ally forward goal zone can also be designated as the location where the ring is created. Creating the ring on this forward goal zone of the top path will also create a ring on the forward goal zone of the bottom path, and vice versa. All allies, including Hoopa, can use these rings to warp between the two goal zones, and their movement speed will be increased for a short time after warping. After an ally warps, there is a set cooldown before that ally can use these rings again. If a path's forward goal zone is destroyed, the middle goal zone on the same path will take its place. This move cannot be used on base goal zones.
options.upgradeDescription: Also increases the movement speed of allies near the ring when they are heading towards it.

details.detailedDescription: Hoopa creates a large ring at the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. After 3s, Hoopa and any allies in the area of effect will return to their base, and their movement speed will be increased for a short time. These allies can also manually warp back to where the ring was created within 3s. An intact ally forwardmost goal zone can also be designated as the location where the ring is created. Creating a ring on the goal zone of the top path will also create a ring on the forwardmost goal zone of the bottom path for 6.5s, and vice versa. All allies (including Hoopa) can use these rings to manually warp between the two goal zones, and their movement speed will be increased for a short time after warping. After an ally or Hoopa warps, there is a 10s cooldown before that Pokémon can manually warp again. If a path's forwardmost goal zone is destroyed, the middle goal zone on the same path will take its place. This move cannot be used on base goal zones. Hyperspace Hole's portal usage cooldown applies only to Hyperspace Hole teleports, and is reset upon usage of Unite Move. If there are multiple effects that would allow you to teleport (ie Phantom Force and Rings Unbound), Rings Unbound will take priority. Hyperspace Holes can be seen by enemies on the minimap.
details.upgradedDescription: Also increases movement speed by 70% for allies near the ring when they are heading towards it.

options.name: Trick
options.description: Hoopa creates a link between itself and an ally using a ring, increasing both of their movement speeds and granting them each a shield for a short time. When Hoopa uses Shadow Ball or performs a basic attack, the ring on the linked ally also unleashes the same move or attack. Hoopa can also use this move on themself, increasing movement speed and granting a shield for a short time. Additionally, it increases the damage dealt by Shadow Ball.
options.upgradeDescription: Also restores the linked ally Pokémon's HP when it deals damage to enemies.

details.detailedDescription: Hoopa creates a link between itself and an ally, increasing both of their movement speeds by 60% for 3s, decaying 10% per second down to 40% increased movement speed, and granting them each a shield for 3s. For the next 7s, when Hoopa uses Shadow Ball or performs an auto attack, the ring on the linked ally also unleashes the same move or attack and if both attacks hit the same target, the second deals 50% damage. Hoopa can also use this move on themself, increasing movement speed and granting a shield for a short time. Additionally, increase the damage dealt by Shadow Ball while Trick is active.
details.upgradedDescription: Hoopa and the linked ally each heal for 10% of their own damage dealt. This effect lasts for 3s.

uniteMoves.name: Rings Unbound
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Transforms Hoopa into Hoopa Unbound for a short time, increasing max HP and creating a ring at the designated location. Each ally can warp to the ring's location one time. As Hoopa Unbound, moves change to Hyperspace Fury and Psybeam. Hoopa Unbound cannot score goals or activate the Magician ability.

details.detailedDescription: Hoopa becomes invincible for 0.6s while transforming into Hoopa Unbound, then becomes unstoppable for 0.3s as it opens a large portal ring at a designated location. Hoopa Unbound lasts for 15s, increasing max HP by 40% and changes Hoopa's regular moves to Hyperspace Fury and Psybeam. Hoopa Unbound cannot score goals or activate the Magician ability.
details.notes: The portal ring created stays open for 10s, and allies can warp to that location once within the duration of the ring. This portal is indicated on the mini map where all players may see where it is.

details.detailedDescription: Basic attacks change and become boosted attacks that deal damage to up to 2 nearby enemies. If only one target is in range then both beams hit the same target, but 1 beam deals 50% damage.
Unleash 7 attacks in the designated area with Hoopa Unbound's many arms, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leave them unable to act for 1s. (7s cooldown).
Fire a peculiar ray in front of Hoopa in a horizontal sweeping motion, dealing damage to enemies hit. Hoopa Unbound becomes immune to hindrances while using this move. (9s cooldown).

passives.name: Sniper
passives.description: When this Pokémon stays near a wall for 1s it becomes camouflaged, making opposing Pokémon unable to target it, and starts gaining critical counters (up to a maximum of 3). A critical counter is gained as soon as Inteleon is camouflaged, with a new counter gained every 3s while camouflaged. Hitting any Pokémon prevents Inteleon from becoming camouflaged for 3s. When a critical counter is consumed, Inteleon's next attack or move that can critically strike is guaranteed to be a critical hit.

details.detailedDescription: When this Pokémon stays near a wall for 1s it becomes camouflaged, making opposing Pokémon unable to target it, and starts gaining critical counters. Sobble may only hold one critical counter. Drizzile may hold two. Inteleon may hold three. While camouflaged, Inteleon is slowed by 10%. A critical counter is gained as soon as Inteleon is camouflaged, with a new counter gained every 3s while camouflaged. Dealing or receiving damage breaks the camouflage and prevents Inteleon from starting to camouflage for 3s. When a critical counter is consumed, Inteleon's next attack or move that can critically strike is guaranteed to be a critical hit.
details.notes: Critical hits deal 250% rather than 200% damage.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage with an increased critical-hit rate.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage with 20% increased critical-hit rate.

base.name: Tearful Look
base.description: Decreases the Attack and Sp. Atk of the target Pokémon by 20% for 3s. Inteleon gains a critical counter and increases its movement speed.

details.detailedDescription: Decreases the Attack and Sp. Atk of the target Pokémon by 20% for 3s. Inteleon gains a critical counter and increases its movement speed by 40% for 3s (decreasing over time).

Inteleon fires a sharp stinger in the designated direction. The stinger stops at the first Pokémon hit or when it reaches a wall. Inteleon gains two critical counters if either a Pokémon is hit or a wall is hit. If it hits a Pokémon it deals damage. If it hits a wall, this move's cooldown is reduced by half and Inteleon is pulled to the wall and starts camouflaging.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Inteleon glides in the designated direction. If it hits a Pokémon or a wall, it can glide in a designated direction a second time. If Inteleon hits a Pokémon while gliding, Inteleon deals damage to it and decreases its movement speed by 30% for 2s. Every time Inteleon glides in a designated direction, it gains a critical counter. If Inteleon bounces off a wall or Pokémon, Liquidation's current cooldown is reduced by 40%.
details.notes: This move can also be used while attacking with Liquidation.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the first glide's travel distance.

details.detailedDescription: Inteleon squirts water, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits.

Inteleon aims for up to 6s and then fires, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits while partially ignoring their Sp. Def. by 15%/20%/25% depending on distance (close, mid, far respectively). Aiming reduces the possible spread of the shot, reaching maximum precision after aiming for 1.25s. The farther away the user is from the Pokémon it hits, the more damage it does. A maximum of three uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 1.5s cooldown between uses.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces the cooldown for charges by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Inteleon starts firing water projectiles at the designated Pokémon. Inteleon fires a total of 8 projectiles in 1.7s and is slowed by 40% while firing. Water projectiles can hit targets other than the designated Pokémon and only deal damage to the first Pokémon they hit. If this move hits the same Pokémon 5 times in a short time, Inteleon will deal 20% increased damage to this Pokémon for 3s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the number of projectiles shot during the duration to 10.

uniteMoves.name: Azure Spy Vision
uniteMoves.buffs: 20% Max HP Shield, 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed

details.detailedDescription: For 10.5s, Inteleon can see nearby Pokémon that are in stealth or hiding in tall grass.
details.notes: While active, also doubles Inteleon's critical-hit rate, and gives 1 critical counter per second.

details.detailedDescription: If Lapras would take a single instance of damage that would be greater than 10% of Lapras's maximum HP, this damage will be reduced by 25%.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, shooting water through the target and dealing increased damage to Pokémon hit by the spray. The boosted attack also heals Lapras.

Create a whirlpool centered on Lapras that lasts for 3s, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The time between hits is shorter the farther opposing Pokémon are from the whirlpool’s center.

Release a pulse of water centered on itself that spreads out, dealing damage to Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. For each opposing Pokémon hit by a pulse from this move, an additional pulse will be released the next time this move is used within 8 seconds, up to a total of 3 pulses. If the first pulse after activating this move hits a Pokémon, the user’s next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the maximum number of pulses to 4.

details.detailedDescription: Sing an eerie melody that echoes around yourself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. This move can be used up to three times consecutively within 5s of its last use. Pokémon hit all three times take additional damage equal to one Perish Song hit. If the additional damage would bring an enemy Pokémon below 10% of their max HP, that enemy Pokémon will take 40% of their maximum HP as True Damage.
details.upgradedDescription: The next basic attack after using this move becomes a boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Hurl 5 chunks of ice in a forward direction, dealing damage to Pokémon they hit and leaving them frozen for 0.6s. If this move hits a Pokémon that is already frozen, it deals damage to it and shoves in the direction of the ice shards for 0.4s.

Create a bubble shield on Lapras for up to 4s or until the shield is broken, then spray 5 bubbles with a beam in the designated direction. Pokémon hit by the bubbles take damage and are enveloped by it, leaving them unable to act for 1s. After the bubbles fly a set distance, they slowly float for 3s. Pokémon hit by a floating bubble are enveloped by it and left unable to act for 1s, but will not be damaged.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the strength of the shield granted by this move.

details.detailedDescription: Unleash an icy-cold beam of energy in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon hit and freezing the ground for 3s. Pokémon on the frozen ground take damage every 0.4s they remain on it and have their movement speed decreased by 15% for 2s stacking up to 6 times. Pokémon become frozen for 1s if they remain on the frozen ground for 3 ticks. When Lapras is on the frozen ground, Lapras's movement speed is increased by 40%, lingering for 0.5s if Lapras leaves the frozen ground.
details.upgradedDescription: Increase the duration Pokémon are Frozen for to 1.5s.

uniteMoves.name: Lapras Express
uniteMoves.buffs: 20% Max HP Shield on activation, 40% Max HP shield and 30% Movement speed after stopping.

details.detailedDescription: Ride a wave quickly and continuously forward becoming Unstoppable for up to 15s. Lapras’s movement speed increases every second while riding but decreases if the user hits an obstacle. If this move is used again, the user stops and launches a wave that continues moving forward, dealing damage to Pokémon it hits and throwing them for 1.5s. If the user hits an enemy Pokémon while still riding, the user stops in place, dealing damage to and throwing the opposing Pokémon for 1.5s. While the user is riding the wave, one nearby ally Pokémon of the user’s choice within range may be picked up and can ride on its back. Ally Pokémon riding on the user’s back can dismount whenever they choose.
After using a move: increases movement speed by 50% for 2s (decaying by 5% every 0.25s).
details.notes: Increases movement speed by 10% while near an ally Latios. When not in combat, this Ability can be used to fly to an allied Latios. This Ability goes on cooldown for 90s after it's triggered for both Latios and Latias. While channeling this ability the user can move around, once the 2s channel is completed the user becomes unstoppable and flies to where Latios was when this ability was activated. If Latios is at the home base, the cooldown of Levitate goes down twice as fast for Latias.

details.detailedDescription: Shoots a psychic projectile at an opposing Pokémon, damaging them.
details.notes: Latias has no boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Releases a weak telekinetic force in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s.

Releases a mist-like flurry of down in the designated direction. When used again or after 0.9s pass: the flurry of down bursts, creating a zone of mist in the area of effect dealing damage up to 2 more times. This move then goes on cooldown. The projectile and area of effect damages opposing Pokémon in it, decreases their movement speed by 40% for 2s, and marks them for 2s.
details.notes: Marked opposing Pokémon deal 25% decreased damage. If either Latias or Latios deals damage to marked opposing Pokémon: increases the duration of the mark by 1s. This duration extension can be continued indefinitely.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased mark base duration to 3s.

details.detailedDescription: Rallies the designated ally Pokémon, granting a shield for 3s and extra damage for the next hit up to 3s: if the user targeted themself, the user will gain the shield and the extra damage. If an ally was targeted, the ally will gain the shield and the extra damage, while the user only gains the shield. The move can the be recasted within 3s, the recast must target an ally other than the user. When used, the ally will gain the shield and the extra damage, while the user will only gain the extra damage. If the designated ally is Latios, then Latios will additionally gain 20% movement speed for 2s.
details.notes: When this move is recast; Latias will fly towards the designated ally. This move's cooldown begins once the recast is used or expires. The damage increase is based on the rallied Pokémon's level.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased the strength of the shield.

details.detailedDescription: Shoots star-shaped rays in a large area in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.

After learning this move: Latias gains 2 Eon power for knocking out a wild Pokémon; or 2 Eon power per Pokémon from the opposing team hit by this move. When this move is used: Latias generates a beam in the designated direction, sweeping in a cone shape, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and restoring the user's HP once. While firing the beam, Latias moves 60% slower.
details.notes: This move gains 2 telekinetic projectiles at 25 and 100 Eon power, and gains 1 projectile at 50 and 75 Eon power for a total of 6 projectiles. Subsequent projectiles hitting the same target deal 15% less damage; further decreasing with each projectile to a maximum of 75% less damage. For every 1 Eon power accumulated beyond 100; the projectile damage increases by 0.5% (Eon power caps at 1099).
details.upgradedDescription: The beam now slows opposing Pokémon by 30% for 2s.

details.detailedDescription: After learning this move: Latias gains 2 Eon power for knocking out a wild Pokémon; or 3 Eon power per Pokémon from the opposing team hit by this move. When this move is used: Latias exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit, slowing them by 30% for 3s and decreasing their Sp. Def by 30% for 3s.
details.notes: This move gains increased range at 31 and 61 Eon Power. For every 1 Eon power accumulated beyond 60; the damage increases by 0.5% (Eon power caps at 1059).
details.upgradedDescription: The slow is increased to 40% for 3s.

uniteMoves.name: Mist Blast
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Aims at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and charges power for 1.8s before releasing a pulse, damaging all opposing Pokémon hit. Resets move cooldowns immediately after releasing the pulse, and increases cooldown reduction by 20% for 9.5s.
