details.notes: If Latios is also aiming its Unite Move at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, the pulses stack and explode, dealing extra damage around the target as well.

damage.label: Damage - Area (If paired with Eon Blast)

details.detailedDescription: After using a move: increases movement speed by 50% for 2s (decaying by 5% every 0.25s).
details.notes: Increases movement speed by 10% while near an ally Latias. When not in combat, this Ability can be used to fly to an allied Latias. This Ability goes on cooldown for 90s after it's triggered for both Latios and Latias. details.detailedDescription: When the user is at 50% max HP or less, if they would take damage they instead disappear into leaves, becoming invisible for 1.5s or until attacking (60s CD). This effect also increases the user's movement speed by 15%, damage by 15% and heals by 15% of the damage dealt for 4s.
Gains a boosted attack every 5 seconds that leaps towards the target dealing additional damage.
Launch 4 leaves that deal damage to enemies hit and decrease their movement speed by 50% for 2.5s. When an enemy is hit by a leaf, subsequent leaves deal 20% reduced damage.

Attach a flower bomb to an enemy that lasts up to 5s. This move can be used again to detonate the flower bomb at will. When it explodes it deals damage and additional damage equal to 18% of the target's missing HP. Against Wild Pokémon: The additional damage from missing HP is capped at 1000. If an enemy that has a flower bomb attached to them is damaged by Meowscarada, the explosion's area of effect and damage are increased. If the explosion knocks out an enemy player with this move, the move's cooldown is reset.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the range of application and explosion's area of effect. Also increases movement speed when planting the seed by 30% for 3s diminishing by 10% every 1s.

The HP recovery works in a cycle of 3 basic attacks; the first attack will heal 100% of the value, the second 50% and the third 20%, then the fourth will heal 100% again.

details.detailedDescription: Dash in a designated direction while sharpening claws, increasing attack speed by 80% and increasing the damage of the next three basic attacks for 3s.

If this move is used again, the user swaps places with the illusory copy, dispelling the copy and creating an explosion of petals at both the clone and Meowscarada's positions that deal damage and leave enemies hit unable to act for 0.8s. Enemies may only take damage from one petal explosion. If the clone's HP were to reach 0 before a swap, the same type of petal explosion occurs at the clone's location only. If Meowscarada hits enemies with this move, Meowscarada's basic attack speed is increased by 100% for 4s and movement speed is increased by 60% for 4s diminishing by 5% every 0.5s down to minimum of 35%. When used from tall grass, this move's leap range increases. If Meowscarada knocks out an enemy player or makes an assist, this move's cooldown is reset.

While using this move, the user cannot use other attacks or change directions without the use of Eject Button, and the move can be stopped if it is used again. The copied item temporarily functions as the user’s battle item, without replacing or affecting the user’s original item. Once an item is copied, this ability will go on cooldown for 30s.

details.detailedDescription: The user applies a coin mark on opposing Pokémon they hit, the coin mark has up to 5 stacks and lasts for 5s. passives.name: Synchronize
passives.description: Each time Mew uses a move, Mew and nearby allies have their movement speed increased by 15% for 2s.

During the lock-on animation Mew can use moves. The further the ball travels, the more damage it deals (4% more damage per threshold, stacking additively). This ball pierces through wild Pokémon, but will stop traveling upon contact with the first enemy player.

Hurl an electric orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect and leaving them paralyzed (40% slow, 10% attack speed reduction) for 2s. This move deals more damage the lower the enemies' remaining HP is.

Def by an additional 10%, its max HP by 10% and its movement speed by 5%.

uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user gains hindrance resistance and calls down up to 5 meteorites in a row, each at a designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon hit by each meteorite. If a meteorite hits an opposing Pokémon, it increases the damage of subsequent meteorites that hit by an additional 20% (up to 80% additional increased damage for the final meteorite if all preceding meteorites hit). The final meteorite damages opposing Pokémon in a wider area of effect and throws them for 1s when it hits.
details.notes: All effects related to Unite Move use activate when the first meteorite is called down. This Unite Move ends when released, consuming 10% of the Unite Move gauge. Each meteorite called down consumes at most 30% of the Unite Move gauge.

details.detailedDescription: Whenever the user deals damage with a Basic Attack, Boosted Attack, Wing Attack, or Sky Attack, the target is left with a burn and a burn counter that caps at 5 stacks. The burn and burn counter lasts 4s and deals damage every 0.5s.
details.notes: If Incinerate or Heat Wave are used, the burn is cleansed and the burn counter is consumed, increasing the damage of those moves by 10% per burn counter stack.

details.detailedDescription: Moltres strikes opponents with their beak. Becomes a boosted attack every fourth attack, swiping with their flaming wing. Once a boosted attack hits a target, the user gains one free move use for 3s. After this move is used or the duration expires, Moltres gains 600 unite energy. This unite energy can be boosted by Energy Amp and other similar effects.
The user dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage along the path.
The user dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage along the path. Each hit increases the user's Def and SpDef by 10% for 4s, stacking up to 5 times.
details.upgradedDescription: Grants a shield on a successful hit for 3s.

details.detailedDescription: The user hurls a fiery orb in the designated direction, dealing damage to all opponents hit.
The user exhales hot breath in the designated direction, dealing damage and granting health regeneration. This health regeneration lasts 2s and ticks every 0.5s.
details.upgradedDescription: Lowers the cooldown of this move by 1s for each Pokémon from the opposing team hit.

uniteMoves.name: Firebird Inferno
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable and soars upwards before unleashing a blazing orb towards the designated area, dealing damage, applying 5 ticks of burn damage instantly, and 5 stacks of burn counter to all enemies hit.
details.notes: For 20s afterwards, a modest area around the opposing team's goal zones are revealed.

details.detailedDescription: Morpeko changes form based on the hunger meter. When the meter reaches 0, the user transforms into Hangry mode. When the meter reaches 6, the user transforms into Full Belly mode.
details.notes: When transforming into Full Belly mode: the cooldowns of Thundershock and Spark are reset, and the user restores some health. While in Full Belly mode, the hunger meter decreases every 12s or when a move is used. When transforming into Hangry mode: the cooldowns of Power Trip and Assurance are reset, and the user inflicts fear onto nearby opposing Pokémon for 1s. While in Hangry mode, the user gains 20% movement speed, and the hunger meter increases every 3s. Eating berries increases the hunger meter by 1 in either form.

details.detailedDescription: The user punches at opposing Pokémon, becoming a boosted attack every third attack, increasing the user's movement speed by 50% for 2s, decaying by 10% every 0.5s, when it lands.

The user attacks the designated target with a jolt of electricity, dealing damage in a small area and paralyzing opponents for 1s. This paralysis lowers movement speed by 30% and attack speed by a flat 10%.

The user attacks the designated target with a spark, marking the designated target with a bolt mark for 5s, dealing damage in a small area, and paralyzing opponents for 4s. This paralysis lowers movement speed by 30% and attack speed by a flat 10%.
details.notes: While in Full Belly mode: The move's cooldown is lowered by 50% of the max cooldown, and a recast becomes available for 2.5s. When recast the user charges towards the marked Pokémon and deals increased damage in an area. While in Hangry mode: all opposing Pokémon that were damaged are also marked.
details.upgradedDescription: When the recast is used, the user gains a shield for 6s.

details.detailedDescription: The user charges in the designated direction, dealing damage and readying a boosted attack.
The user charges in the designated direction, dealing damage. Additional damage is dealt if the target was paralyzed by the user.
details.notes: While in Hangry mode: If this move hits a Pokémon with a bolt mark, the cooldown is reset and the mark is consumed.
details.upgradedDescription: Readies a guaranteed critical hit boosted attack when this move is used.

uniteMoves.name: Hungry Supercharge Wheel
uniteMoves.buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and attacks by charging with an electric wheel in the designated direction, dealing damage and stunning opposing Pokémon for 1s.
details.notes: While in Full Belly mode: the move also paralyzes opposing Pokémon hit for 4s. This paralysis lowers movement speed by 30% and attack speed by 10%. While in Hangry mode: this move deals increased damage and marks opposing Pokémon hit with a bolt mark for 5s.

passives.name: Filter
passives.description: Reduced damage received for a short time after using a move.

details.detailedDescription: Upon casting a Move, Mr. Mime takes 10% less damage for 2s.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and throwing enemies when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: Gains a Boosted Attack every 5s, dealing increased damage and throwing enemies in the air for 0.5s.

base.name: Fake Out
base.description: Slap its hands together, shoving enemies in front of it.

details.detailedDescription: Mr. Mime claps, damaging and knocking back enemies hit for 0.4s.

options.name: Confusion
options.description: Attacks straight in front of the user, dealing damage to enemies and shoving them. If an enemy shoved by this move hits an obstacle, it receives increased damage from this move and is left unable to act for a short time. If the enemy is currently guard-swapped, it is not shoved but receives increased damage from this move and is left unable to act for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Mr. Mime fires a wave of psychic energy, damaging and knocking enemies back. Enemies hit into a wall take bonus damage and are stunned for 1.5s. Enemies debuffed by Power Swap take bonus damage and are stunned for 0.7s, but are not knocked back.
details.notes: Normal damage will apply to targets that are unstoppable or unstunnable. (Example: Drednaw & Zapdos)
details.upgradedDescription: Increased damage.

options.name: Psychic
options.description: Centers one telekinetic blast each on the user, any guard-swapped enemies, and any Light Screen or Barrier walls created by the user, damaging all enemies caught in the blasts and lowering their Sp. Defense for a short time. If an enemy is hit by multiple overlapping blasts, that enemy is also left unable to act for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Mr. Mime pulses energy, dealing damage in an area around themself, any target affected by Power Swap, and any Barriers or Light Screens. After three pulses, a final pulse will damage enemies and stun them for 1s. Enemies hit by the pulses have their SpDef lowered by 5% for 3s with each hit (maximum 8 stacks).
details.upgradedDescription: Enemies hit by the pulses are additionally slowed by 30%.

base.name: Light Screen
base.description: Create a wall of light in the designated area that prevents enemies from passing.

details.detailedDescription: Mr. Mime creates a wall that prevents enemies from passing. If an enemy is near the location where the wall is created, they are shoved and left unable to act for 0.5s.

options.name: Barrier
options.description: Create a translucent wall in the designated location that prevents enemies from passing. A maximum of two uses can be kept in reserve for this move and cannot be used more than once every 2s.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the max number of uses that can be kept in reserve.

details.detailedDescription: Mr. Mime creates a wall that prevents enemies from passing. If an enemy is near the location where the wall is created, they are shoved and left unable to act for 0.5s. Holds 2 uses in reserve and cannot be used more than once every 2s.
details.upgradedDescription: Stores 3 uses in reserve instead.

options.name: Power Swap
options.description: Swaps the user's Defense and Sp. Defense stats with those of another Pokémon for a short time when it hits. Swapping with an enemy deals damage over time and decreases their movement speed while increasing the user's movement speed for a short time. Swapping with an ally increases the movement speed of that ally and the user for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: Also continually restores the HP of the user and the ally while this move is in effect.

details.detailedDescription: Creates a link between Mr. Mime and the target this move hits. While the link holds, Mr. Mime's movement speed increases by 10% and their HP is continually restored. The link will continue to hold for as long as the linked target stays in range or until another target is Power Swapped. Damage and healing ticks at a rate of 0.5s.
details.notes: If the linked target is an ally, this move increases their movement speed by 8%, increases the amount of damage they deal by 15%, and continually restores their HP. If the linked target is an enemy, this move decreases their movement speed by 8%, decreases the amount of damage they deal by 15% and deals damage over time to them. Power Swap can be cleansed.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the amount of damage dealt by allies to 20% and decreases the amount of damage dealt by enemies to 20%.

uniteMoves.name: Showtime
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Jump to the designated location and start a pantomime performance, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Mr. Mime leaps forward and begins a performance; stunning enemies for 0.5s, dealing damage in a large area around him 4 times, and becomes unstoppable for the duration. The final hit deals double damage and stuns enemies for 1s.

passives.name: Snow Warning
passives.description: Causes snow to fall on an enemy, dealing damage to it and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for .75s. Boosted attacks, Snow Warning, and all moves (except Aurora Veil) sling snow; hitting the same target with snow 4 times will freeze them for 1s. This ability has an 8s cooldown.

details.detailedDescription: Causes snow to fall on an enemy, dealing damage to it and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for .75s. This ability has a 4s cooldown. Boosted attacks, Snow Warning, and all moves (except Aurora Veil) sling snow; hitting the same target with snow 4 times will freeze them for 1s.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to nearby enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to nearby enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

base.name: Powder Snow
base.description: Attack with a chilly gust of powdery snow, decreasing the movement speed of enemies for a short time when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: Ninetales attacks with a chilly gust of powdery snow; dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1s.

options.name: Avalanche
options.description: Attack with a gush of chilly ice toward the designated area. The ice forms a wall that cannot be passed through on land. After a short time this wall melts and collapses, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
options.upgradeDescription: Also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: Ninetales attacks with a gust of chilly ice toward the designated direction. The ice damages enemies and forms a wall that can't be walked through. After a short time, this wall melts and collapses; further damaging enemies in a radius around the wall.
details.upgradedDescription: Also decreases the movement speed of enemies by 50% for 1s when this move hits.

options.name: Dazzling Gleam
options.description: Attack with a powerful cone of blinding light, leaving enemies unable to act when this move hits.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage dealt and stun duration.

details.detailedDescription: Ninetales attacks with a powerful cone of blinding light; damaging and stunning enemies hit for .8s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased damage and stun duration to 1s.

base.name: Icy Wind
base.description: Attack with a gust of freezing air, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: Attacks with a gust of freezing air; damaging, and slowing Pokémon hit by 20% for 1s. Icy Wind shoves Pokémon hit in the direction of the wind for a short distance unless they are already at the maximum range of the move.

options.name: Blizzard
options.description: Summons a howling blizzard in two blasts in front of the user. The first blast deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time. The second blast deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and shoves them. If the second blast hits an obstacle, it also deals damage to enemies near the point of impact.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Ninetales blasts twice in a line. The first blast penetrates walls and slows enemies. The second blast deals double damage, shoves enemies back, and if it hits a wall it creates a frost area at the impact location for 4s; dealing damage every 0.5s and slowing enemies in the area by 35% for 1s on each tick.

damage.label: Damage - Second Hit
damage.description: Deals twice the damage of the first hit.

upgradedDamage.label: Damage - Second Hit
upgradedDamage.description: Deals twice the damage of the first hit.

options.name: Aurora Veil
options.description: Create an aurora around the user, reducing damage received by the user and nearby allies in the area of effect. While the user is inside the aurora, its movement speed is increased and its basic attacks become boosted attacks.
options.upgradeDescription: Further reduces damage allies receive.

details.detailedDescription: Ninetales dashes a short distance and creates an aurora centered on their position for 5s; reducing damage received by Ninetales and allies within the veil by 35%, healing Ninetales with each boosted attack, and increasing Attack Speed by 15%. While Ninetales is inside the aurora, movement speed is increased by 10% and all auto attacks are boosted.
details.upgradedDescription: Damage reduction increased to 40% and cooldown reduced by 2s.

uniteMoves.name: Snow Globe
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Attacks with a chilly blast of snow and ice, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect when it hits. Deals increased damage to enemies that are frozen.

details.detailedDescription: Attack with a chilly blast of snow and ice; dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect around Ninetales when it hits. Deals increased damage to enemies that are frozen. Ninetales is unstoppable during the cast.

When the user deals damage with moves, gain a pressure stack for 5s up to a maximum of 3 stacks.  The next auto attack consumes all of the pressure stacks inflicting additional damage and healing the user per pressure stack.
The user slashes at opposing Pokémon with claws. Becomes a boosted attack after 9s pass, dealing increased damage and stunning Pokémon on the opposing team for 1s.
details.notes: Against wild Pokémon, the boosted attack is not used, instead basic attack damage is increased by 10% when the boosted attack is available.

details.detailedDescription: The user summons a ring of water around themself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon, and activating a healing effect if the move hits.
details.notes: The healing effect lasts 3s, healing every 1s up to 4 times.

details.detailedDescription: The user lets loose a sphere of aura power in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon, and marking them for 4s.
details.notes: The next time the user deals damage to a marked Pokémon, additional damage is dealt, the user is healed, and the mark is consumed.
details.upgradedDescription: Applies a 60% slow  for 4s to opposing Pokémon hit, decaying by 15% every 0.5s to a minimum of 15%.

details.detailedDescription: The user charges towards the designated area, dealing damage, before slashing in the area dealing damage again.
The user teleports to the designated area before slashing, dealing damage in the area. This move can be recast within 4s, the user slashes in the designated direction dealing increased damage.

damage.label: Damage - Second Hit
damage.notes: Against wild Pokémon: the additional damage is capped at 500

details.upgradedDescription: Damaging Pokémon on the opposing team with the first hit increases the user's Def and SpDef by 10% for 5s per target, up to a maximum of 3.

uniteMoves.name: Multi Dimensional Rend
uniteMoves.buffs: 15% Movement Speed, 15% CDR, 10% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes Invincible for up to 3s and disappears into a spacial rift, able to travel freely for up to 2s with 80% increased movement speed. When this move is recast within 2s, or the duration expires, the user reappears in the designated area and unleashes 3 multilayered slashes before shattering the space with a final hit. When this move is learned, the user can gain up to 4 dimensional stacks by dealing damage to Pokémon on the opposing team, increasing the amount of multilayered slashes to a maximum of 7 hits. These dimensional stacks last up to 10s. If the move is used with 4 dimensional stacks, the cooldowns of the user's moves are reset.
details.notes: Palkia gains 2400 energy per second instead of the usual 900.

details.detailedDescription: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP.
details.notes: Fighter Mode: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced. The user lunges towards the target Pokémon, dealing increased damage and increasing the user's attack speed by 30% for 8 seconds. This effect can stack up to 2 times and the duration refreshes when gaining another stack.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon and dealing increased damage.

The user nuzzles their electrified cheeks against the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and leaving them paralyzed. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 30% for 2s and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s.
Unleash an electrified punch in the designated direction, dealing damage, slowing opposing Pokémon hit by 40% and reducing their attack speed by 10% for 2s.
details.notes: Fighter Mode: This move has a shorter range and no longer applies a slowing effect, but instead deals increased damage.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage dealt by this move.

details.detailedDescription: The user charges up receiving 30% less damage and becomes unstoppable, then dives toward the designated area after releasing, gaining a shield for 3.5s, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon hit by 30% for 2s. If this move misses, the user takes 3% of their remaining HP as damage instead. When this move hits, the move can be used again; when used a second time, the user unleashes a punch in front of themself, dealing damage and shoving opposing Pokémon hit.
details.notes: Fighter Mode: The first stage of this move no longer applies a slowing effect and the area of effect is decreased, but this move deals increased damage and no longer has a charge time.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the slowing effect to 40% for 2s.
details.upgradedNotes: Fighter Mode: Further increases damage dealt by this move.

details.detailedDescription: The user attacks a designated opposing Pokémon with sharp claws, dealing damage.
The user cloaks themself in electricity and dashes at an opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and moving behind them. For a short time after using this move, this move can be used once more.
details.notes: Fighter Mode: This move cannot be used more than once before going on cooldown, but the user's movement speed is increased by 40% for 3s instead.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduce this move's cooldown by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Dash at blinding speed towards the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon, shoving them, and leaving them unable to act for 0.6s. This move's cooldown is reduced by 0.5s every time a basic attack hits.
details.notes: Fighter Mode: This move no longer shoves or leaves opposing Pokémon unable to act, but the number of attacks for this move is increased to 3 hits.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the length of time opposing Pokémon are left unable to act to 1s.
details.upgradedNotes: Fighter Mode: Increases damage dealt by this move.

uniteMoves.name: Zip Zap Full-Charge Spark
uniteMoves.buffs: 50% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Charge toward the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage to the target and nearby opposing Pokémon. After using this move, the user enters Fighter Mode for 8s and resets the cooldown of all other moves. The Unite Move gauge will only charge when the user's basic attacks and moves hit opposing Pokémon. Basic Attacks against Pokémon from the opposing team increase Unite Move gauge by 4% and moves increase the gauge by 8%. Basic Attacks against wild Pokémon increase Unite Move gauge by 1% and moves increase the gauge by 2%.
details.notes: Fighter Mode: Basic attacks and move effects change, and the Unite Move gauge does not charge. Gain 30% omni-vamp while Fighter Mode is active.

passives.name: Static
passives.description: Paralyzes all enemies nearby for a short time when receiving damage. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

details.detailedDescription: When damaged, paralyzes nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD).
details.notes: The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this Ability is decreased by 30% for 2.5s and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s.

basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also paralyzes enemies for a short time when it hits.

details.notes: The movement speed of the opposing Pokémon paralyzed by boosted attacks is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 1s.

base.name: Thunder Shock
base.description: Release electricity, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also paralyzes enemies for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them when it hits.
details.notes: The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s.

options.name: Electro Ball
options.description: Hurl an electric orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them paralyzed for a short time. This move's damage increases the lower the enemies remaining HP is.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Hurls an electric orb at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, dealing additional missing HP damage, and paralyzing them when it hits.
details.notes: The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 50% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s.

damage.label: Damage - Additional
damage.notes: Against Wild Pokémon: the additional damage is capped at 1200.

details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

upgradedDamage.label: Damage - Additional
upgradedDamage.notes: Against Wild Pokémon: the additional damage is capped at 1200.

options.name: Thunder
options.description: Drop wicked thunderbolts, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the number of times this move attacks.

details.detailedDescription: Drops wicked thunderbolts at the designated area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s over 2.5s (up to 5 times).
details.upgradedDescription: Deals damage over time more frequently, hitting opposing Pokémon in the area of effect up to 7 times over 2.5s.

base.name: Electroweb
base.description: Attacks and captures enemies using an electric net, leaving them unable to move.

details.detailedDescription: Launches an electric net at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target and immobilizing them for 1.5s when the net captures them.

options.name: Volt Tackle
options.description: Has the user electrify itself and charge ahead, throwing opposing Pokémon.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduced cooldown.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes unstoppable and dashes at the designated target, damaging them 5 times and throwing them in the air for 1.4s if the first hit wasn't blocked by unstoppable or hindrance resistance effects; then leaps a set distance back, increasing movement speed by 60% for 2s (decaying by 10% every 0.5s; minimum 30% for 0.5s) after the leap.
details.notes: Pikachu can initiate moves and use basic attacks while leaping backwards. Using a boosted attack will cut the leap short.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 2s.

options.name: Thunderbolt
options.description: Attack with a strong electric blast, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Strikes with a strong electric blast at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and stunning them for 1.25s when it hits.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

uniteMoves.name: Thunderstorm
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Attacks enemies near the user with tremendous bolts of lightning.

details.detailedDescription: Pikachu leaps into the air becoming unstoppable for 0.65s, calling down bolts of lightning 4 times over 3s in a radius around Pikachu. The first cast targets all Pokémon on the opposing team in range with single target bolts. The following 3 casts target up to 2 random Pokémon from the opposing team in range with area of effect bolts. Opposing Pokémon in range of overlapping bolts only take damage once.
details.notes: Pikachu can initiate moves and use auto attacks while casting this move.

details.detailedDescription: When damaged by a Pokémon from the opposing team; increases movement speed by 40% for 2s, decaying by 10% every 0.5s (minimum 25% increased movement speed) (10s CD).
details.notes: This Pokémon's headache gauge increases by 1% for every 0.5% max HP damage received by Psyduck or nearby ally Pokémon from Pokémon on the opposing team. This gauge fills at a rate of 30% per 1s (requiring a total of 3.33s to fully charge). When the headache gauge is full, a mysterious power is triggered, interrupting Psyduck from casting moves, cleansing status conditions on themself, becoming unstoppable and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s; then shoving nearby opposing Pokémon away for 0.8s, and resetting this Pokémon's move cooldowns. The mysterious power stays active for 10s, boosting moves and giving them 20% cooldown reduction. When the mysterious power ends, Psyduck cannot use moves or attacks, or charge their headache gauge for 2.5s.

details.detailedDescription: Attacks with a shot of water.
details.notes: Psyduck has no boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: Releases a weak telekinetic force in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon and stunning them for 1s when it hits.
details.notes: While the mysterious power is active, deals increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: Creates a wave in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2.5s when it hits; if opposing Pokémon already have their movement speed decreased when this move hits, they are also shoved for 0.5s. Rides the wave for at least 0.6s and until this move is used again or for up to 5s, moving forward and increasing movement speed by 30%; the user can use basic attacks and moves while riding the wave. Ally Pokémon who touch the wave while Psyduck is riding it have their movement speed increased by 70% for 3s (decaying by 10% every 0.5s over 2s; minimum 30%). When this move is used again, stops in place and creates another wave in the designated direction.
details.notes: While the mysterious power is active, creates two waves in the designated direction each time this move is used.
details.upgradedDescription: Decreases the damage dealt by opposing Pokémon hit by this move by 25% for 2.5s.

details.detailedDescription: Forcefully ejects a spray of bubbles in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and attaching a mark with 3 bubbles to those hit for 5s. When a teammate damages opposing Pokémon with bubbles attached to them with auto attacks, a bubble bursts, damaging the target. When all bubbles on a target burst from auto attack damage, they are stunned for 0.5s and their movement speed is decreased by 30% for 2s.
details.notes: While the mysterious power is active, strengthens the damage dealt when bubbles burst.
details.upgradedDescription: Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by the beam by 30% for 2s.

details.detailedDescription: Wags their tail at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging them and decreasing their movement speed by 30% and their Sp. Def by 20% for 2s.
details.notes: While the mysterious power is active, strengthens the Sp. Def decrease to 30%.

details.detailedDescription: Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target and stunning them for 0.2s. Opposing Pokémon hit by the electricity from this use of the move have a mark applied to them for 5s which has a disabling effect tied to it; the disabling effect increases the cooldown of the last move used by a marked target by 2s, or the next move used if no move is on cooldown (once only). When the disabling effect occurs, the target's movement speed is also decreased by 30% for 2s. The electricity spreads to a nearby opposing Pokémon up to 4 times; the electricity can only spread to the same target up to 2 times.
details.notes: While the mysterious power is active, the electricity can spread up to 6 times; the electricity can spread to the same target up to 2 times.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the stun duration to 0.5s.

details.detailedDescription: Decreases movement speed by 10% and releases a strong telekinetic force in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and stunning them for 0.6s when it hits. Continues to release a telekinetic force at the Pokémon from the opposing team closest to the center of the area of effect when this move hits, marking them for 2s. If this move is used again or after 2s and the user is in range of the marked target, pulls the target a set distance in the designated direction (pulling them toward the user's location if no direction is designated), stunning them for 0.85s during the pull.
details.notes: While the mysterious power is active, stuns the target marked by this move for 0.2s after being pulled.
details.upgradedDescription: Decreases the Sp. Def of opposing Pokémon hit by the area of effect by 25% for 2s.

uniteMoves.name: Full-Power Psy-ay-ay!
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Releases three mysterious psychic waves around themself, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing the damage dealt by them by 30% for 3s when hit.
details.notes: After using this Unite Move, increases the headache gauge by 50% as a consequence of Psyduck unleashing their full power.

details.detailedDescription: When the user deals damage with auto attacks or moves, vibes increase, which increase Attack by 5% per stack up to 3. If no vibes are gained within 3s, they are lost, along with the user's boosted gauge.
details.notes: After evolving into Quaquaval, the next auto attack when vibes are maxed becomes Spinning Edge. Each time Spinning Edge hits opposing Pokémon, the user's movement speed is increased by 15% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.

details.detailedDescription: The user kicks at opposing Pokémon dealing damage. Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, with the user stepping in for a kick with increased damage.
details.notes: Spinning Edge deals damage 3 times in an area around the user over time, before rapidly dealing damage 3 more times. If Low Sweep was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will do increased damage. If Liquidation was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will grant a shield on use. If Carnival Splash was used preceding Spinning Edge, it will gain both effects.

details.detailedDescription: The user pounds the area, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon by 30% for 2s.

The user unleashes three swift kicks in the designated direction, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon by 60% for 1s, decaying by 15% every 0.25s. The third kick can be aimed, launching the user in that direction before unleashing the kick.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move, and Spinning Edge when this move precedes it.

details.detailedDescription: The user lunges in the designated direction dealing damage, and gaining a shield for 3s on hit.
The user charges in the designated direction, dealing damage, lowering the defense of opposing Pokémon by 30% for 3s, and restoring the user's HP.
details.notes: Two uses can be kept in reserve, with a 0.5s cooldown between uses.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the amount of health this move restores, and increases Spinning Edge's shield when this move precedes it.

uniteMoves.name: Carnival Splash
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable while dancing in place, gaining a shield and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon up to 3 times. The third hit will pull in opposing Pokémon towards the user, stunning them for 1s. Each opposing Pokémon pulled in grants the user a shield, up to 3 times.
details.notes: The third hit of this move will not affect wild Pokémon.

details.detailedDescription: Upon receiving damage: paralyzes all nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD).
details.notes: Paralysis from Static decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

details.detailedDescription: Alolan Raichu can use basic attacks while moving but is slowed by 30% when using basic attacks, Electro Ball or Thunderbolt.
details.notes: After using a move or a boosted attack: dashes in the direction of movement.

variants.name: Attack - Raichu
variants.description: After hitting 4 basic attacks or moves, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. Boosted attacks release electricity at the target that can chain to other nearby opposing Pokémon, dealing increased damage to up to 5 opposing Pokémon.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the opposing Pokémon hit.
details.notes: Paralysis from Pikachu's boosted attacks decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

details.detailedDescription: Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon; damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing those hit.
details.notes: Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

details.detailedDescription: Increases auto attack speed by 45% and empowers the next 6 auto attacks for 5s.
details.notes: Each empowered auto attack also launches a star-shaped electric blast at the target, dealing additional damage. This move goes on cooldown after all 6 electric blasts have been launched or after 5s.
details.upgradedDescription: The electric blasts also decrease the target's Sp. Def by 8% for 3s (up to 3 times; maximum 24%).

details.detailedDescription: Hurls an electric orb toward the designated location, where it remains for up to 30s if it doesn't hit an opposing Pokémon on the way. When an electric orb and an opposing Pokémon touch; the orb releases its electricity and damages nearby opposing Pokémon.
details.notes: A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve, with a 0.5s cooldown between uses. A maximum of 3 orbs can be on the map at a given time.
details.upgradedDescription: Deals damage every 0.5s over 3.5s (8 times) to opposing Pokémon hit by this move.

details.detailedDescription: Discharges a weak jolt of electricity in the designated direction; damaging nearby opposing Pokémon and paralyzing those hit.
details.notes: Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

details.detailedDescription: Channels for 0.5s then releases a strong electric blast in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, and paralyzing them when it hits. Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.
details.notes: If this move hits an electric orb created by Electro Ball; the orb releases its electricity, dealing increased damage to nearby opposing Pokémon.
details.upgradedDescription: Immobilizes opposing Pokémon hit for 1s instead of paralyzing them.

details.detailedDescription: Releases a strong telekinetic force in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and applying a debuff which decreases their movement speed by 23% for 3s when it hits. If the user hits debuffed opposing Pokémon with an auto attack, it deals additional damage.
details.notes: If this move hits an electric orb created by Electro Ball; the orb is pulled to the center of this move's area of effect. This does not extend the duration the electric orb remains.
details.upgradedDescription: Creates a damage-over-time area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon inside the area every 0.5s over 2s (up to 5 times).

uniteMoves.name: Thunderstorm Aerial
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Creates a star-shaped zone of electricity in the designated area for 4s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when created, then damaging opposing Pokémon over time (up to 5 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 60% while in the zone.
details.notes: If the user hits an opposing Pokémon that is in the zone with an auto attack, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: The Pokémon's psychic counter charges based on the distance they run (up to 10 times). When the counter is full, the Pokémon is granted a shield, becoming hindrance resistant while the shield remains.
details.notes: When the Pokémon reaches an additional movement speed threshold, the damage dealt by moves is increased by 5/20/35/50/60%. The increased damage based on movement speed is calculated before dealing damage with moves.

details.detailedDescription: Shoots energy from their horn, damaging the opposing Pokémon hit.

The user releases a telekinetic force around themself, increasing their movement speed by 33% per opposing Pokémon hit for 5.5s (up to 2 times; maximum 66%) before damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when it hits.

The user emits a powerful flash around themself after a delay, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when it hits. The user gains 1 stack of 11% increased movement speed per wild Pokémon hit by the outer edge of the flash, or 2 stacks per Pokémon from the opposing team hit for 5.5s (up to 9 stacks; maximum 99% increased movement speed) before damaging them. If the outer edge of the flash hits Pokémon from the opposing team, the cooldown of Tackle, Smart Strike, or Agility is reduced by 30% of its current cooldown, successively with each target hit.
details.notes: Against wild Pokémon: Dazzling Gleam damage is capped at 2500.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the cooldown reduction of Smart Strike or Agility to 50% of its current cooldown successively per Pokémon from the opposing team hit by the outer edge.

details.detailedDescription: The user jumps to the designated location then stirs up a fairy wind when they land, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. This move can be used again, up to 2 times total.
details.notes: If it's used 2 times, the third attack deals increased damage and throws opposing Pokémon for 0.8s when it hits.
details.upgradedDescription: Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 20% for 2s with each use.

details.detailedDescription: The user charges at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging them and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s when it hits.

The user charges at the designated opposing Pokémon and stabs them with their sharp horn, dealing damage when it hits. The user then leaps in a chosen direction, shoving the target in the opposite direction and stunning them for 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: Charges the user's psychic counter by 5 when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user's movement speed increases by 20% when this move is used, increasing by an additional 7.5% every 0.5s over 3s (maximum 80% increased movement speed).
details.notes: This move's duration increases by 1.5s if the user moves or hits opposing Pokémon with moves (up to 5 times for an additional 7.5s; maximum 10.5s duration).
details.upgradedDescription: Also restores 2% of the user's missing HP every 0.5s while their movement speed is increased by this move.

uniteMoves.name: Triad Blitz
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and charges at the designated opposing Pokémon, shoving opposing Pokémon in the way and stunning them for 0.8s when hit. When the charge ends, a mysterious triangular space is created around the designated opposing Pokémon if the user hits them. That Pokémon cannot leave that space.
details.notes: When the mysterious space is created, this move can be used again up to 3 times within 5.5s. With each additional use, the user runs at high speed forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path. If the path of a dash starts or ends in the mysterious space, this move can be used again immediately afterward.

details.detailedDescription: Reshiram launches a blazing blue fireball at a target, dealing damage and removing 50% of remaining shields (20s cd).
The user spits flame at the target dealing damage. Becomes a boosted attack every third attack or after a move, dealing increased damage in an area.
details.notes: When a boosted attack hits, the current charge of Flames That Bring Lightning is reduced by 10% of its remaining cooldown.

details.detailedDescription: The user exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, dealing damage and paralyzing opposing Pokémon for 2s. This paralysis lowers movement speed by 15% and attack speed by a flat 15%.
Reshiram unleashes intense beautiful blue flames in the designated direction, dealing damage, and burning targets hit for 4s, lowering their movement speed by 30% and attack speed by a flat 30%.
details.upgradedDescription: Improves the movement speed and attack speed debuffs to 40%.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes in the designated direction.
The user gains a shield for 6s and dashes in the designated direction, afterwards SpA is increased by 10% for 3s.
details.upgradedDescription: Improves the SpA increase to 20%.

uniteMoves.name: Flames That Bring Lightning
uniteMoves.buffs: 15% Movement Speed, 10% CDR, 10% Max HP Shield. The cooldown of Energy Amplifier is increased to 30s, and the cooldown of Buddy Barrier is increased to 60s.

details.detailedDescription: The user launches a massive flame in the designated direction, exploding against the first target, or after traveling a set distance, dealing damage in an area. Every third use of this move will empower it, launching a more explosive flame that also stuns targets for 0.9s, afterwards Zekrom assists by calling down lightning on that area dealing additional damage. 3 uses of this move can be kept in reserve, with a 0.6s cooldown between uses, and this move benefits from cdr.
details.notes: Unite buffs will only be applied with the empowered cast.

passives.name: Prankster
passives.description: When Sableye is outside the visual range of Pokémon from the opposing team, it enters stealth and its movement speed increases. When Sableye enters the visual range of a Pokémon from the opposing team, it does not immediately become visible but instead remains in stealth for a short time. This stealth lasts longer when approaching enemy Pokémon from behind. The Pokémon with this Ability exits stealth when it attacks.

details.detailedDescription: When Sableye is outside the visual range of enemy players, Sableye enters stealth and gains 10% increased movement speed. When Sableye enters the visual range of enemy players or enemy goal zones, Sableye does not immediately become visible but instead remains in stealth for 1.7s. Sableye exits stealth when attacking.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If Sableye is in stealth when it hits an opposing Pokémon with a boosted attack, it will deal damage and apply a fear effect. Opposing Pokémon affected by fear will be forced to move away from Sableye. When the user enters stealth, it will charge boosted attack immediately and hold it.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s. If Sableye is in stealth when hitting an enemy with a boosted attack, Sableye will deal damage and apply a fear effect for 1s. Enemies affected by fear will be forced to move away from Sableye with 40% reduced movement speed. When Sableye enters stealth, they will ready a boosted attack immediately and hold it.

base.name: Thief
base.description: Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to any Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If this move hits an enemy Pokémon, it steals a small amount of their Aeos energy. If those Pokémon do not have any Aeos energy, they will be left unable to act for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to any Pokémon hit and slowing 20% for 2s. If this move hits an enemy, Sableye receives 5 energy and removes up to 5 energy from the enemies hit. If those enemies did not have any Aeos energy, they will be left unable to act for 0.5s.

options.name: Knock Off
options.description: Dashes in the designated direction and then back again while attacking around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit by the attacks and leaving them unable to act for a short time. For a short time afterward, this move can be used again. If it is, the user attacks in front of itself with its claws, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them. When either the first or second stage of this move hits opposing Pokémon, those Pokémon will drop some of their collected Aeos energy, and for a short time, they’ll be unable to pick up Aeos energy. When either stage of this move hits opposing Pokémon that do not have Aeos energy, those Pokémon will be left unable to act—and for a longer duration. While using this move, the user receives reduced damage.
options.upgradeDescription: For a short time after this move is used, the next time the user picks up Aeos energy, the user recovers HP and has its movement speed increased.

details.detailedDescription: When either activation of this move hits enemies that do not have Aeos energy (or are wild Pokémon), those enemies will be left unable to act for longer periods of time. Sableye dashes in the designated direction and then back again while attacking around themself, dealing damage to enemies hit and leaving them unable to act for 0.4s or 0.6s if they have no Aeos energy. This move can be used again within 6s attacking in front of Sableye with their claws, dealing damage to enemies hit, pushing them away and leaving them unable to act for 0.6s or 1s if they have no Aeos energy. When either the first or second activation of this move hits an enemy, they will drop 5 Aeos energy (total 15: 10 from first activation, 5 from second) and be left unable to pick up Aeos energy for 4s. While using this move, Sableye receives 40% reduced damage.
details.upgradedDescription: Aeos energy picked up within 5s of using this move recovers 9% Max HP (one time per activation) and increases movement speed by 40% for 2s.

options.name: Shadow Sneak
options.description: For a short time, increases the user’s movement speed and has it enter stealth. While this move is active, the user’s next boosted basic attack deals additional damage. While this move is active, if the user exits stealth and is not immobilized by a hindrance, it will be able to enter stealth again.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the duration of this move’s effects. While this move is active and the user is in stealth, it will also gradually recover HP.

details.detailedDescription: Apply a 6.5s duration buff that stealths Sableye after 1.5s increasing Sableye's movement speed by 10%. If the initial stealthing is interrupted by a hindrance, Sableye will not enter stealth. When the buff first stealth's Sableye, Sableye is granted a readied boosted attack that deals additional damage. While the buff is still active, if Sableye exits stealth and is not immobilized or incapacitated by a hindrance, they will enter stealth again after 2s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the duration of this move’s effects to 7.5s. While this move is active and Sableye is in stealth, Sableye will also restore 1% max HP every 0.5s.

base.name: Astonish
base.description: Attacks in a cone in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If this move hits opposing Pokémon from behind, it deals increased damage and applies a greater decrease in movement speed.

details.detailedDescription: Sableye attacks in a cone in front of themself, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. If this move hits enemies from behind, this move deals increased damage and applies a greater decrease in movement speed to 60%.

options.name: Feint Attack
options.description: Has the user throw dummy Aeos energy to a designated location. While dummy Aeos energy remains at a location, that location and the area around it will be visible to the user. Dummy Aeos energy can remain at up to five locations at a time. If an opposing Pokémon picks up dummy Aeos energy, that energy explodes, dealing damage over time to that Pokémon and decreasing its movement speed for a short time. A maximum of three uses can be kept in reserve for this move.
options.upgradeDescription: If an opposing Pokémon is knocked out while taking damage over time from this move, it will drop more Aeos energy than it normally would.

details.detailedDescription: Throw dummy Aeos energy to a designated location. While dummy Aeos energy remains at a location, that location and the area around it will be visible to the user. Dummy Aeos energy can remain at up to five locations at a time. If an enemy walks on top of dummy Aeos energy, that energy explodes, dealing damage-over-time 9 times over 4s in an area and decreases the movement speed of enemies hit for 4s by 70% decaying by 20% every 0.5s to a minimum of 10%. Holds 3 uses in reserve and cannot be used more than once every 1s.
details.notes: Note: Placing the dummy energy does not break stealth. Stealth is only broken when an enemy takes damage from the dummy energy.
details.upgradedDescription: If an enemy is knocked out while affected by this move, they will drop more Aeos energy than they normally would.

options.name: Confuse Ray
options.description: Fires a sinister ray in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. If this move hits Pokémon from the opposing team, it also leaves them confused. While confused, Pokémon are left unable to act and start continuously attacking nearby Pokémon with basic attacks. Confused Pokémon will target nearby Pokémon in the following order of priority: first, their ally Pokémon; then, wild Pokémon; last, Pokémon on Sableye's team.
options.upgradeDescription: Also increases the movement speed and basic attack speed of Pokémon from the opposing team while this move has left them confused.

details.detailedDescription: Fires a sinister ray in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. If this move hits enemy players, they are also left confused for 2s. While confused, enemies are  unable to act and continuously attack nearby enemies with basic attacks. Confused enemies will target nearby enemies in the following order of priority: first, their allies; then, wild Pokémon; last, Pokémon on Sableye's team. Knock outs for wild Pokémon will be attributed to Sableye, stealing the effects of the wild Pokémon being knocked out as well as the Aeos energy.
details.notes: While confused, outgoing damage is decreased for auto attacks and move 1 by 50%. If the confused target knocks out a Wild Pokémon, Sableye receives the KO.
details.upgradedDescription: Also increases target's movement speed by 30% and attack speed by 50% while confused from this move.

uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Shoot light from both eyes, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in an cone in front of itself. Pokémon from the opposing team hit by this move who are facing the user are left unable to act and start preparing to return to base. If they take damage before returning to base, the return effect is cancelled, and they are left unable to act for a short time. Opposing Pokémon hit by this move who are not facing the user have their movement speed decreased for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Sableye becomes unstoppable for 1.2s and shoots light from both eyes, dealing damage to enemies in a cone in front of themself. Enemy players hit by this move who are facing Sableye are left unable to act for 3s and start preparing to return to base. If they take damage before returning to base, the return effect is cancelled, and they are left unable to act for 1.5s. Enemies hit by this move who are not facing Sableye have their movement speed decreased by 50% for 2s.

passives.name: Technician
passives.description: After using a move, the next basic attack will change to deal 2 attacks instead. The second attack deals reduced damage.

If Bullet Punch is used again within 8s, the number of punches increases. The number of punches increases from 3 to a maximum of 5.
details.upgradedDescription: Also grants a shield for 3s if this move hits an enemy.

details.notes: If a marked enemy is knocked out, all of the user's move cooldowns are reset. The mark may be cleansed.

If a copy hits a non targetted enemy while dashing out, it deals damage, decreases that enemy's movement speed by 40% for 3s, then disappears. If untouched, the illusory copy will remain on the battlefield for 8 seconds. Enemies that come in contact with an illusary copy will detonate the copy, having damage dealt to them an slowing them for 40% for 3s. For 8s after activation, this move may be used again, dashing in a designated direction dealing damage to enemies hit. The enemies hit are also grabbed and carried while Scizor continues dashing. At the end of the dash, Scizor punches the ground dealing damage in an area-of-effect. If the grabbed enemy hits an illusory copy during the shove, they will be dealt damage and be left incapacitated for 2s.

Copies deal damage to enemies they make contact with and apply a mark to them for 5s. After 5s, the copies return to Scyther, dealing damage to enemies they make contact with and healing Scyther for each hit. This move may be used again within 5s of activating as a dash in a designated direction dealing damage to enemies hit. The copies then dash to the end location of the user's dash. Tenacity is increased by 50% while the user has a shield. When the user hits an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack or move, the user's critical-hit rate increases by 5% up to 5 times for a maximum of 25%. This enhanced critical-hit rate remains for up to 8s after the user last dealt damage with a basic attack or move.
details.notes: As a Farfetch'd, the user will gain 10 Exp. Points when landing critical hits. This Exp. can trigger evolution. Critical hits deal 160% damage rather than 200%.

details.detailedDescription: The user attacks by slashing with a leek.
details.notes: This Pokémon has no boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: The user slashes in the designated direction, if the first hit lands then the user can use this move again within 5s to slam the leek in the designated spot.

The user unleashes a flurry of jabs in the designated direction, with the damage increasing by 3% each time the move deals damage up to 2 times (6% max). The final hit stuns opposing Pokémon for 0.75s.
details.notes: Sirfetch'd can move while unleashing the flurry of jabs. If the move is interrupted, 50% of the remaining cooldown is refunded.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

details.notes: If the first hit of this move misses, the cooldown is instead 2s.

The user throws the leek-leaf shield in an arc, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit. When the leek-leaf shield returns the user gains a shield for 4s. While the leek-leaf shield is mid-flight it can continuously inflict damage to the same opponent every 0.5s.
details.notes: Alternatively, this move can be used again within 1.5s while the leek-leaf shield is mid-flight causing the user to leap to where the shield is and slam it into the ground dealing damage in an area, applying a 70% slow for 3s, and granting the user a shield for 4s.
details.upgradedDescription: Improves the strength of the shield.

details.detailedDescription: Has the user ready the leek-leaf shield while the move button is held down, for 0.6s the user is Impervious, negating damage received, afterwards the user instead reduces damage received by 30% for up to 2.4s. When the move button is released the user dashes in the designated direction dealing damage.
details.notes: If the user blocks an attack, the second stage of the move will apply a 50% slow for 2.5s, and grant a shield for 4s. If an attack is blocked while the user is Impervious, the cooldowns for Fury Cutter and Leaf Blade are reduced by 50% of their max cooldown.

If this move does damage near the end of the dash an explosion occurs dealing double damage and stunning opponents in the area for 0.4s.
details.notes: This move can go through walls if there is enough distance left.

details.detailedDescription: The user's next move is granted 35% SpDef Pierce (15s CD).
The user shoots a small flame at the designated target.
details.notes: Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, dealing increased damage in a small area.

details.detailedDescription: The user lets out a charming cry in the designated direction, dealing damage.
details.notes: When the move hits, an additional sound wave occurs in a small cone behind the initial target dealing slightly increased damage to opposing Pokémon.
