details.notes: When the move hits, the vibrations travel further, become slightly wider, and deal slightly increased damage.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

details.detailedDescription: The user lets out a mighty roar in the designated direction dealing damage and applying a fear effect for 1s. Pokémon under the fear effect walk towards the center edge of the cone.
details.notes: When this move hits, the range is extended.

details.detailedDescription: The user snarls incessantly, dealing damage and applying a fear effect for 0.7s. Pokémon under the fear effect walk away from the user's position. For 2.5s opposing Pokémon hit by this move deal 20% less damage to the user.
details.notes: When this move hits, the range is extended.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage debuff to 30%.

uniteMoves.name: Rousing Symphony
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: The user vitalizes nearby allies and themself, increasing their damage by 15% for 6s. Afterward, the user unleashes a fiery bird in the designated direction, the range of which stretches across the whole arena.
details.notes: This move can be aimed for up to 10s before it needs to be reselected. While aiming the field of view is increased greatly.

passives.name: Oblivious
passives.description: When Slowbro receives damage, the HP loss is gradual. When damaging an opponent with a move, restore some of the remaining gradual HP loss and decrease the target's Sp. Defense.

details.detailedDescription: Slowbro stores up lost HP for a short time (blue HP). Slowbro's Oblivious health remains for 6s and then decreases by 3% max HP every second. When dealing damage to an enemy with Water Gun, Scald, Surf, or Slowbeam - decrease their Sp. Def by 4% for 5s, stacking up to 5 times.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, deal damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and decrease their movement speed.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, deal damage to nearby enemies and decrease their movement speed by 30% for 1s.

base.name: Water Gun
base.description: Slowbro channels a fierce stream of water which deals damage and lowers movement speed. Increase the area of effect and damage the longer this move is channeled.

details.detailedDescription: Slowbro fires a stream of water, damaging and slowing enemies hit by 35% for 1s. This move can be channeled to increase its range and damage. Slowbro's movement speed is reduced by 30% while channeling. Restore 10% of Slowbro's Oblivious health (blue HP) once, after hitting an enemy.

options.name: Scald
options.description: Deal damage to opposing Pokémon and create steam when it hits. Opposing Pokémon inside the steam's area are left burned and have their movement speed decreased.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased area of effect.

details.detailedDescription: Slowbro fires a stream of boiling water; damaging enemies hit, slowing them by 80% for 0.5s and creating a cloud of steam centered on the first enemy hit, which slows by 30% for 3s and applies a burn to all enemies inside. This burn reduces Attack by 60% for 3s. Restore 10% of Slowbro's Oblivious health (blue HP) once per stream instance after hitting an enemy (maximum 3 times).
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the size of the steam cloud.

options.name: Surf
options.description: Charge forward on a wave, dealing damage in an area and knock opponents back. This is followed by two more waves that deal damage and decrease enemy movement speed.
options.upgradeDescription: The second and third waves become larger and also knock enemies back like the first wave.

details.detailedDescription: Slowbro rides on a wave, damaging, knocking enemies back, and throwing them in the air for .4s. Two more waves follow after the first, damaging and slowing enemies by 30% for 1s. Restore 10% of Slowbro's Oblivious health (blue HP) per wave, when hitting at least one enemy (maximum 3 times).
details.upgradedDescription: The first and second wave will knock up enemies in the direction of the wave for 0.2s each, and the third wave will throw enemies in the air for 0.4s.

base.name: Slack Off
base.description: Lay down and take a rest, continuously regaining health. Damage taken will reduce the recovery effect.

details.detailedDescription: Slowbro begins channeling a nap and gains a heal over time, healing 2% max HP every 0.5s for 3s. While Slowbro remains channeling its nap, all self-healing is doubled (including Slack Off healing). Slowbro can be manually or forcibly woken up from their nap.

options.name: Amnesia
options.description: Nullify some damage before it takes effect. For a short time after using this move, become immune to hindrances and gain increased defense. Also increase the damage dealt by the next use of Scald or Surf.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases Sp. Attack.

details.detailedDescription: Slowbro briefly becomes unstoppable, gaining +250 Defense for 4s and restoring 17.5% of Slowbro's Oblivious health (blue HP) every second for 4s.
details.upgradedDescription: Also increases Slowbro's Sp. Defense by 125.

options.name: Telekinesis
options.description: Make opposing Pokémon float with psychic power. If used again, pull the opposing Pokémon toward the user.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased range and firing speed.

details.detailedDescription: Slowbro shoots a beam, causing the first enemy hit to float in the air for 2.3s, restoring 15% of Slowbro's Oblivious health (blue HP) every second for 5s. Slowbro can reactivate the ability to pull the enemy to themself, but otherwise cannot act for the duration.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the range and speed of the beam.

uniteMoves.name: Slowbeam
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Stare at an enemy and attack continually, dealing damage and rooting them. Grants a shield and makes the user immune to hindrances while using this move.

details.detailedDescription: Stare at an enemy and attack continually, dealing damage every .5 seconds for 3s and applying 'Bound' to them. This ability counters Unstoppable. Grants a shield (10% max HP) and makes Slowbro unstoppable while using this move.

passives.name: Gluttony
passives.description: Increases the effects gained from eating Berries.

details.detailedDescription: When facing nearby Berries or food, increases movement speed by 25%.
details.notes: Doubles the HP restored from eating Sitrus Berries. Restores an additional 1% max HP + 0 x (Lv. - 1) + 23 HP from eating Oran Berries (from Greedent Cheek Pouch). Alcremie's Recover heals 10% more HP than usual.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to nearby enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, belly flopping forward to deal increased damage to opposing Pokémon and decrease their movement speed by 20% for 1s when it hits.

base.name: Tackle
base.description: Charge forward belly first, dealing damage when it hits and shoving the first enemy it comes in contact with. After this move, the user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.

details.detailedDescription: The user readies a boosted attack and dashes belly first forward, damaging opposing Pokémon and shoving the first opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. The boosted attack from this move remains readied until used.

options.name: Heavy Slam
options.description: Has the user slam its heavy body down, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throwing them.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: The user jumps up and slams down at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

options.name: Flail
options.description: Has the user flail about, increasing the user's basic attack damage the lower the user's HP is.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage. If the user has low HP while using this move, its basic attacks that hit enemies will restore the user's HP.

details.detailedDescription: The user increases their movement speed by 80% for 3s (decaying by 10% every 0.5s over 2s; minimum 40% for 1s before this buff ends) and decreases the movement speed of nearby opposing Pokémon by 50% for 1.5s, and starts flailing about for 5s.
details.notes: While flailing about, auto attacks deal increased damage, with damage strengthening for every 20% max HP the user is missing. Basic attacks used while flailing about also decrease the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 20% for 1s; boosted attacks decrease movement speed by 50% for 1s.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage dealt by auto attacks used while flailing about.
details.upgradedNotes: When the user is below 40% max HP, auto attacks also restore the user's HP for 30% of damage dealt.

base.name: Rest
base.description: Has the user fall asleep on the spot and restores its HP. Blocks the movement of all enemies while this move is in effect.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and falls asleep on the spot for 3s, restoring 8% max HP every 1s over 3s (maximum 24% max HP). While using this move, opposing Pokémon cannot pass through Snorlax.
details.notes: This move cannot be used within an opposing Miraidon's Electric Terrain.

options.name: Block
options.description: Has the user spread its arms wide to create a wall and grants it a shield. Prevents enemies from passing through the wall and shoves them if they run into it.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduces the damage the user receives while this move is in effect.

details.detailedDescription: The user gains a shield for 3.5s; becomes unstoppable, decreases their movement speed by 30% and creates a wall with their arms spread wide in the designated direction for up to 4s. Opposing Pokémon cannot pass through the wall from behind, and those that contact the wall from the front are shoved and stunned for 0.45s; targets cannot be shoved more than once every 1s (maximum 4 times).
details.notes: The user can use this move again to drop the wall early, becoming vulnerable to hindrances and returning to normal movement speed. This move's cooldown begins when the wall ends.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 35% while holding up the wall. Shoves opposing Pokémon contacting the wall from the front not more than once every 0.5s (maximum 8 times).

options.name: Yawn
options.description: Has the user let loose a huge yawn that lulls enemies into a sleepy haze, putting enemies hit by this move to sleep.
options.upgradeDescription: Decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user lets out a huge yawn in the designated direction, putting opposing Pokémon in the area of effect to a deep sleep for up to 2.5s.
details.notes: Targets that are hit after their deep sleep is halfway through wake up immediately.
details.upgradedDescription: Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon waking up from a full deep sleep by 35% for 3s.

uniteMoves.name: Power Nap
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Go to sleep and begin snoring, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and throw them. While sleeping, become immune to hindrances and continually restore HP.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and slams onto their back fast asleep, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 1s; then continues to sleep for up to 4s afterward. The user starts snoring for the remainder of the Unite Move, restoring 10% max HP over time while fast asleep (up to 9 times; maximum 90%), damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect with a huge snore every 1.5s and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s when hit. This Unite Move can be used again before the user snores a second time to flip over in the designated sideways direction and slam the ground, dealing an extra instance of snore damage in the area of effect and throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. While the user is fast asleep, opposing Pokémon cannot pass through Snorlax.
details.notes: After the user flips over or snores a second time, the user can use this Unite Move again to stop sleeping early, becoming vulnerable to hindrances and returning to normal.

damage.label: Damage - DoT (3 Ticks)
damage.description: Deals 50% of the initial damage, 3 times.

passives.name: Unaware
passives.description: Reduces physical and special type damage by 30%. True type damage will bypass this.

passives.name: Sturdy
passives.description: The user has 30% damage reduction. If Cosmoem were to be KO'd, Cosmoem is instead left with 1 HP and becomes Invincible for 1s. This effect has a 100s cooldown.

passives.name: Full Metal Body
passives.description: Solgaleo's Attack stat cannot be lowered through debuffs.

basicAttack.name: Attack - Cosmog
basicAttack.description: Cosmog shoots an orb of energy. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack.

variants.name: Attack - Cosmoem
variants.description: Cosmoem shoots an orb of energy. When a move is used, gain one boosted charge, up to a max of 3 can be stored for up to 5s. Boosted attacks spray cosmic energy in a cone, dealing damage 3 times.

variants.name: Attack - Solgaleo
variants.description: When fully evolved, Solgaleo's basic attacks become melee ranged. The user swipes with sharp claws, increasing critical-hit rate by 8% for 3s up to 5 times. When a move is used gain a boosted charge, up to 2 can be held for up to 5s and both are consumed to perform a boosted attack dealing a guaranteed critical hit in an area in front of the user.

details.detailedDescription: The user instantly teleports to the designated location, and readies a boosted attack.
The user charges in the designated direction, dealing damage and shoving opposing Pokémon for 0.5s. If the move hits, a follow up becomes available for 2s.
details.notes: When recast; the user leaps forward, an opposing Pokémon hit by the attack is barraged with 4 attacks, each stunning for 0.2s for up to a 0.8s duration, and restoring the user's health by 40% of the damage dealt. Against targets that cannot be stunned, only one instance of increased damage is dealt. This barrage will end early if the user inputs movement.
details.upgradedDescription: A fifth hit is added to the barrage, increasing the total stun duration to up to 1s. Against targets that cannot be stunned, the damage is increased.

details.detailedDescription: Increases the user's Def and SpDef by 30% for 5s, and readies a boosted attack.

The user begins charging psychic power for up to 4s, granting 30% damage reduction and becoming Hindrance Resistant for the first 2s. Additionally, the user's movement speed is increased by 13%, further increasing by 13% every 0.5s to a max of 78% until the move ends. When the move is unleashed, damage is dealt in an area around the user, increasing with charge level, and opposing Pokémon are thrown for 0.3/0.4/0.45/0.55s based on the charge level. If this move hits, a follow up becomes available for 5s. If the move is fully charged until it wears off, the cooldown of the move is instead 5s.
details.notes: When recast; the user slashes in the designated direction, dealing damage twice, applying a 40% slow for 3s, and healing the user. If this follow up hits, a second recast becomes available, performing the same attack.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the healing of the claw swipes.

uniteMoves.name: Shining Meteor Crush
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Solgaleo becomes Unstoppable and unleashes immense power, entering Radiant Sun phase, before charging towards the designated Pokémon and dealing damage in the area. Radiant Sun phase lasts 10s. Ally Pokémon who are KO'd nearby grant 10000 energy.
details.notes: While in Radiant Sun phase, Solagaleo can see hidden Pokémon, and Solgaleo's auto attacks and moves deal True type damage.

details.detailedDescription: Damaging a Pokémon from the opposing team below 10% max HP and frozen by Suicune deals an additional 15% max HP as true damage to the target (sufficient damage reduction can prevent the target from being knocked out). Using a move grants a shield for 5s (up to 2 times); separately increases the crystal gauge by 1 for 5s (becoming full when increased 2 times).
details.notes: Flooded areas created by Whirlpool or Surf remain for 5s; opposing Pokémon in a flooded area are marked as drenched for 3s. Freezing a flooded area with a regular move (not Unite Move) also freezes opposing Pokémon in that flooded area for 1s. Freezing an opposing Pokémon marked as drenched removes the mark; targets frozen by a regular move or by a frozen area cannot be marked as drenched for 3s afterward. Deals bonus damage when freezing opposing Pokémon with a regular move or by being in a frozen area.

details.detailedDescription: When the crystal gauge is full, readies a boosted attack for 5s as the crystal gauge decays to 0; increasing the crystal gauge refills it to full.
details.notes: Boosted attacks shoot water forward, damaging opposing Pokémon every 0.25s over 1s (up to 4 times), dealing bonus damage to frozen opposing Pokémon with each hit.

details.detailedDescription: Fires a pulse of water in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon and shoving them for 0.5s when it hits.
details.notes: Marks targets as drenched for 3s when it hits.

details.detailedDescription: Generates a vortex of water at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 1s over 4s (up to 4 times), pulling them toward the center with each hit, and slowing enemies by 20% for 0.5s (refreshing on each hit). If used again within 4s, moves the vortex in the designated direction, flooding the area it passes through.
details.notes: Marks targets as drenched for 3s when hit.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Prepares an area for a big wave to pass through, then creates the wave and sends it in the designated direction after 0.75s, damaging opposing Pokémon hit by the wave and shoving them. The prepared area becomes flooded after the wave passes through it.
details.notes: Marks targets hit by the wave as drenched for 3s. Hitting a pillar of ice created by Icy Wind with the wave shatters it, damaging opposing Pokémon hit.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

details.detailedDescription: Creates snow to fall at the designated area for 1.5s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect (up to 3 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s when hit. After 1.5s, drops a clump of snow at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon again.
details.notes: The clump of snow freezes drenched targets for 1s when it hits; freezes flooded areas it drops on after 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Fires an icy-cold beam of energy in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s when it hits.
details.notes: This move freezes drenched targets for 1s when it hits; freezes flooded areas it hits after 1s. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve, with a 0.5s cooldown between uses.
details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the movement speed decrease to 30%.

details.detailedDescription: Builds up a gust of freezing air at the designated area for 0.5s, decreasing the movement speed of opposing Pokémon in the area of effect by 30% for 3s; then forms a pillar of ice, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 3s once fully formed. The pillar of ice shatters after 4s, damaging opposing Pokémon again.
details.notes: This move freezes drenched targets for 1s when the pillar of ice forms or when it shatters. Forming a pillar of ice on a flooded area freezes that area after 1s. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve, with a 0.5s cooldown between uses.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

uniteMoves.name: Endless Ice Spikes
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield

details.detailedDescription: Cleanses the user of status condition; then creates ice spikes in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and freezing those hit for 2s. After 2s, the ice spikes explode, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect again. This Unite Move does not directly interact with drench marks, nor does it freeze flooded areas.
details.notes: Suicune can be stunned after cleansing themself and before creating the ice spikes, canceling the Unite Move and refunding 90% of the Unite Move gauge.

passives.name: Adaptability
passives.description: Every time Eevee deals or receives damage, increase Sp. Attack by 5% for 1.5s, stacking up to 4 times.

details.detailedDescription: Every time Eevee deals or receives damage, increase Sp. Attack by 5% for 1.5s, stacking up to 4 times.

passives.name: Pixilate
passives.description: Every time Sylveon deals or receives damage, increase Sp. Atk and Sp. Defense by 5% for 1.5s, stacking up to 4 times.

basicAttack.name: Attack - Eevee
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.

variants.name: Attack - Sylveon
variants.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. In addition, increase movement speed by 75% for 1s when this boosted attack hits.

base.name: Swift
base.description: Shoots star-shaped rays at enemies, dealing damage to them.

details.detailedDescription: Shoots 4 star-shaped rays at enemies, dealing damage to them.

options.name: Mystical Fire
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the number of flames by one.

details.detailedDescription: Create four small flames while leaping in the designated direction. These flames shoot towards enemies one by one, dealing damage and decreasing their Sp. Attack by 15% for 1s, stacking up to 4 times. Each time a flame hits, reduce the cooldown of this move by 12% of the current cooldown. After the first flame hits, subsequent flames on the same target deal 28% damage. Wild Pokémon will only be prioritized if no enemy players are in range.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the number of flames by one.

options.name: Hyper Voice
options.description: Unleashes an attack of multiple sound waves that deal damage when they hit. The damage dealt increases the farther the target is from Sylveon. Every time a sound wave hits, enemy Sp. Defense is reduced by 50 and the next sound wave's damage increases.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the number of sound waves by one.

details.detailedDescription: Unleashes an attack of multiple sound waves that deal damage when they hit. The damage dealt increases the farther the target is from Sylveon. Every sound wave reduces enemy Sp. Defense by 20% for 1.5s (capping at 80%).
details.upgradedDescription: Pokémon hit are slowed by 30%

base.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
base.description: Stare at an enemy with baby-doll eyes, dealing damage and decreasing their Attack and movement speed for a short time when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: Stare at an enemy with baby-doll eyes, dealing damage and decreasing their Attack by 15% for 1s and decreasing their movement speed by 60% for 1s for a short time when this move hits.

options.name: Draining Kiss
options.description: Blow a kiss at an enemy that goes back and forth between Sylveon and the target multiple times. When the kiss touches Sylveon, restore  HP. When it hits the enemy, deal damage and decrease their movement speed for a short time. If Sylveon and the enemy move too far away from each other, the kiss will disappear faster than normal.
options.upgradeDescription: Increases the amount of HP this move restores.

details.detailedDescription: Blow a kiss at an enemy that goes back and forth between Sylveon and the target multiple times. When the kiss touches Sylveon, restore HP. When it hits the enemy, deal damage and decrease their movement speed by 50% for 1s on each kiss hit. This movement speed decrease decays by 15% after 0.5s If Sylveon and the enemy move too far away from each other, the kiss will disappear. The closer Sylveon and the target is, the faster the damage and healing occur.
details.upgradedDescription: Increased healing.

options.name: Calm Mind
options.description: Sylveon quietly focuses their mind and calms their spirit, increasing movement speed, Sp. Attack by 40% and Sp. Defense by 10% for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: One time only while using this move, if Sylveon is hit by an Enemy's move, the damage is completely nulliffied and Sylveon is granted a shield.

details.detailedDescription: Sylveon quietly focuses their mind and calms their spirit, increasing movement speed by 30%, Sp. Attack by 40% and Sp. Defense by 10%. All buffs last for 3s.
details.upgradedDescription: For up to 3s after using Calm Mind+ Sylveon can block one move (auto attacks will not be blocked), negating the first instance of damage and granting a shield for 3s. Hinderances and status effects will still be applied.

uniteMoves.name: Fairy Frolic
uniteMoves.buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Jump into the air and become briefly invincible. The moment Sylveon lands, deal damage to enemies in the area of effect and restore Sylveon's HP. For 10s afterward, 50% of damage dealt by Sylveon is converted into HP (basic attacks are excluded).

details.detailedDescription: Jump into the air, removing most statuses and becoming invincible. The moment Sylveon lands, lose invincibility and immediately gain Fairy Frolic buff, while dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and healing for 60% of the damage dealt. Fairy Frolic buff: for 10s, 50% of the damage dealt by Sylveon is converted into HP. No HP is recovered if the damage is dealt to shields.
details.notes: Against Wild Pokémon: Damage is capped at 2000.

passives.name: Gale Wings
passives.description: While at high HP, movement speed is increased.

details.detailedDescription: While at 85% max HP or above, this Pokémon's movement speed is increased by 15%.

basicAttack.name: Attack
basicAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied even after leaving combat for a prolonged period of time.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind around the user and damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied until used.
details.notes: Basic and boosted attacks lunge at the target opposing Pokémon.

base.name: Peck
base.description: Fly toward an enemy and attack 3 times.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes at the designated opposing Pokémon then pecks three times, damaging opposing Pokémon hit.

options.name: Flame Charge
options.description: Fly in the designated direction while cloaked in flame, attacking enemies in the path. This also increases the movement speed for a short time.
options.upgradeDescription: For a short time after this move hits, Talonflame's abilities and basic attacks partially ignore the enemies defense.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes forward cloaked in flame, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and increasing the user's movement speed by 30% for 2.5s if it hits.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the user's Defense penetration for 3s and reduces the movement speed of opposing Pokémon in the user's path by 30% for 5s if this move hits.

options.name: Aerial Ace
options.description: Fly at the designated enemy, dealing damage. Also makes the next basic attack a boosted attack.
options.upgradeDescription: Increased damage.

details.detailedDescription: The user readies a boosted attack and dashes through the designated opposing Pokémon with a swift attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect around the user and restoring the user's HP when it hits.
details.upgradedDescription: Increases the damage of this move.

base.name: Acrobatics
base.description: Fly toward the designated area and attack multiple times. Escape in a direction of your choice after using this move.

details.detailedDescription: The user dashes toward the designated location then attacks the area around them three times, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon.
details.notes: The user can choose to dash in the direction of movement afterward.

options.name: Fly
options.description: Fly up into the sky. Using this move again will cause you to dive to the designated area and attack, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Your next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. This move's cooldown is reduced by 40% if it hits an enemy.
options.upgradeDescription: Also throws enemies when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user readies a boosted attack and flies up into the sky for up to 3s, becoming untargetable and increasing their movement speed by 65%. When this move is used again, or after 3s, the user dives at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.
details.notes: If this move hits a Pokémon from the opposing team, the current cooldown of this move is reduced by 40%.
details.upgradedDescription: Throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.4s.

options.name: Brave Bird
options.description: Dive to the designated location while cloaked in flame, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also deals recoil damage to the user when it hits. Performing a boosted attack within a set amount of time after this move hits will reset the cooldown of Flame Charge or Aerial Ace.
options.upgradeDescription: Deals less recoil damage when this move hits.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and dives at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when they land and receiving 5% remaining HP recoil damage if it hits.
details.notes: Opposing Pokémon hit by this move are marked for 4s. If the user hits a marked target with a boosted attack, the cooldown of Flame Charge or Aerial Ace is reset and the mark on the first target hit is removed.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces damage received by 25% per opposing Pokémon hit for 5s (up to 3 times; maximum 75%).

uniteMoves.name: Flame Sweep
uniteMoves.buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
uniteMoves.description: Perform an aerial somersault before charging forawrd, dealing damage to enemies in this move's path and shoving them.

details.detailedDescription: The user performs an aerial somersault and sweeps forward, becoming unstoppable, receiving 50% reduced damage, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and shoving them toward the end of the sweep, then damaging opposing Pokémon again. This Unite Move cannot go through walls.
When damaging an opposing Pokémon with an active shield effect, 30% of the damage dealt to the shield is dealt as additional damage to the target's HP.
details.notes: This Pokémon's hammer strengthens every time they hit Pokémon from the opposing team with boosted attacks or moves, increasing this Pokémon's Attack by 0.5% per target hit (up to 100 times; maximum 50% Attack). After the hammer is strengthened 20, 40, and 60 times; Rock Smash, Gigaton Hammer, and Smack Down gain increased range.

details.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack after 12s, swinging the user's hammer in a circle around them, dealing increased damage and restoring 24% of the user's missing HP when it hits. This boosted attack remains readied until used. The time until the next boosted attack is readied is reduced faster when hit by opposing Pokémon's auto attacks.
details.notes: The hammer's size and basic attack range increase upon evolving into Tinkatuff and into Tinkaton.

details.detailedDescription: The user swings down their hammer with rock-crushing force, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and stunning them for 0.15s when hit.
details.notes: The stronger the hammer, the larger this move's area of effect.

details.detailedDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and decreases their movement speed by 50% as they charge power for up to 1.95s, becoming fully charged after 1s, before swinging down their hammer in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them when hit. This move deals more damage and the throw duration is strengthened the longer it is charged.
details.notes: The stronger the hammer, the larger this move's area of effect.
details.upgradedDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

Atk by 15% for 2.5s.

If this Thief empowered basic attack hits a Pokémon from the opposing team, the user gains a Thief buff for 5s, increasing their Defense and Sp. Def by 10% per target hit (up to 5 times; maximum 50%). While the user has the Thief buff, the movement speed increases remain in effect; the user readies boosted attacks after 2s, and the time until the next boosted attack is reduced significantly when hit by opposing Pokémon's auto attacks.

details.upgradedDescription: Strengthens the Defense and Sp. Def decrease on targets hit by the empowered auto attack to 25%; strengthens the Defense and Sp. Def increases on the user to 25% per target hit (maximum 125%).

details.detailedDescription: When Trevenant deals or receives damage while at or below 35% max HP, a continuous HP recovery effect is triggered every 0.5s for 4s. This effect also reduces the cooldowns of Trevenant's moves by 1s every 1s. When this HP recovery effect ends, there is a 100s cooldown. However, this cooldown is reduced by 1s each time one of Trevenant's moves damage an enemy. This cooldown reduction cannot be triggered more than once every 0.5s.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage to enemies and heal for 5% max HP when this boosted attack hits.

Shoot 3 sinister flames in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and leaving them burned for 3s. This burn reduces enemy Attack by 10% and Sp. Attack by 5% for 3s. The first wisp to hit a target deals full damage, and subsequent flame hits deal 50% damage.

Trevenant pulls back its arms and attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and pulls them in front of Trevenant, leaving them unable to act for 0.5s. If this attack deals damage to at least one enemy, a follow-up attack will be available for 5s. This follow-up attack slams down a giant wooden hammer in front of Trevenant, dealing damage to any enemy it hits, and leaving them unable to act. The lower Trevenant's HP, the longer the enemy will be left unable to act. Every time this move is used, it consumes 5% of Trevenant's current HP.
details.upgradedDescription: If an enemy is hit by the second hammer, the damage they deal is reduced by 20% for 3s.

details.detailedDescription: Trevenant creates a cursed zone in exchange for 2% max HP per second for 6s, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect every 0.5s for 6s and decreasing their movement speed for 1s, refreshing with each tick. The lower Trevenant's HP is, the greater the decrease in movement speed. While using this move, Trevenant builds up Curse gauge every time it deals or receives damage. Curse will deal additional damage to enemies in the area of effect when the Curse releases at the end of 6s or by manually detonating the Curse. If the Curse gauge is at maximum when it’s released, the cooldowns of Branch Poke, Horn Leech, and Pain Split are reset and opponents hit are unable to act for 0.6s.

At the end of the charge, enemies that were shoved are dealt additional damage and then thrown for 0.75s. Colliding with an enemy while charging recovers Trevenant's HP 3 times, and the lower Trevenant's remaining HP the more HP that is recovered. After this move hits an enemy, Trevenant's next three auto attacks deal more damage and reduce this move’s cooldown by 0.5s when they hit.
details.upgradedDescription: After using this move, Trevenant's movement speed is increased by 30% for 1.5s.

details.detailedDescription: Creates a link between Trevenant and a designated enemy for 6s. While the link holds, a percentage of damage that Trevenant would take is mitigated and instead redirected to the linked enemy as True damage. The lower Trevenant's remaining HP, the greater the percentage of damage that is redirected. If Trevenant's percentage of remaining HP is lower than the linked enemy, this move continuously deals damage and recovers Trevenant's HP every 0.5s. If Trevenant and the linked enemy are too far apart, the link will disappear. Using this move increases Trevenant's movement speed by 35% for 2s decaying by 7.5% per half second.

details.detailedDescription: If the goal scoring button is held down, Zacian charges its sword  with Aeos energy. For a short time, its basic attacks become boosted attacks. This Ability goes on an 8s cooldown after it’s triggered.
details.notes: Minimum 5 energy is required to charge with a maximum of 10 (except for Unite Move). Duration for buff window is 3s for 5 energy, 6s for 8 energy, 10s for 10 energy. Charging occurs at a rate of 1 energy per 0.1s.

details.detailedDescription: Dashes forward. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon; latches onto the target, and becomes untargetable to unleash a combo of at least 3 attacks, damaging the target with each attack (switching to the closest opposing Pokémon if the target is out of range or unable to be attacked for the next attack). Receives 1% remaining HP recoil damage per attack; the initial hit deals 2 instances of recoil damage. Opposing Pokémon hit by one of these attacks receive 50% reduced damage from subsequent attacks from Wild Charge for 5s.
details.notes: Hitting an opposing Pokémon with boosted attacks, Volt Switch, or Spark applies 1 stack of a Wild Charge buff for 5s (up to 3 stacks); each stack of the buff adds 1 additional attack to the next use of Wild Charge (for up to 6 total hits). Zeraora is untargetable while attacking; for 1.2s at 0 stacks, 1.5s at 1 stack, 1.8s at 2 stacks and 2s at 3 stacks from this buff.
details.upgradedDescription: Deals 50% reduced damage to other nearby opposing Pokémon with each attack.

details.notes: Creates a circular zone of plasma centered on the target's location for 5s when it hits; paralyzing opposing Pokémon inside it for 3s. While in the zone, also increases the user's auto attack range, and auto attack damage by 20%.

details.detailedDescription: When this Ability is used: cleanses status conditions and becomes unstoppable for 0.33s (15s CD); and takes the form of the nearest opposing Pokémon for up to 15s, prioritizing Pokémon from the opposing team. Returns to their original form earlier when damaged, using an auto attack or move, attempting to score, or returning to base.
details.notes: The target of the illusion does not need to be in vision to take their form.

options.name: Night Slash
options.description: For a short time, change the user’s normal movement to dash attacks. After performing a dash attack, the user’s next auto attack changes to a special auto attack. During this move’s effect duration, whenever Zoroark hits an enemy with other moves or special auto attacks, this move’s effect duration increases and the user is able to use Night Slash again. This move’s effect duration ends if the user moves when it’s unable to use Night Slash. During this move’s effect duration, if Zoroark hits enemies with a total of six moves and/or special auto attacks, Zoroark will jump into the air and then while landing, slash a set area-of-effect, dealing damage to enemies. Zoroark recovers HP if they hit enemies with this slashing attack. While jumping, the user is able to use Shadow Claw or Cut to move a set distance.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Gains the Night Slash buff for 2.5s, changing the next movement to a dash attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path. If the dash attack hits: changes the next auto attack to a unique boosted attack with increased range. If Zoroark hits opposing Pokémon with Slash, Shadow Claw, Cut, or unique boosted attacks: resets the Night Slash buff duration to 2.5s, repeating this chain of attacks. This move ends if the user moves when they're unable to use the Night Slash dash attack.
details.notes: If Zoroark hits opposing Pokémon with a total of 6 valid attacks: cleanses status conditions and becomes invincible for 1.4s,  jumping into the air then landing after 1.2s. When the user lands: slashes a cross-shaped area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon with two diagonal slashes, and dealing additional missing HP damage when it hits; restores HP once for each of the two diagonal areas of the cross slash that hits an opposing Pokémon (up to 2 times if both slashes hit).  This cross-shaped attack deals move damage if triggered by a final move hit, or auto attack damage if triggered by a final unique boosted attack. While jumping, the user is able to use Slash, Shadow Claw, or Cut to move a set distance.

options.name: Feint Attack
options.description: Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies and reducing all of the user’s move cooldowns. If this move hits an enemy, for a short time, the location where the dash started is marked, and the user is able to use this move again; returning to the marked location and dealing damage to enemies. A new mark is left where the dash started. As long as there is a mark, if the user uses another move, the mark will move to where the move was used. If the user hits enemies four times with either Feint Attack or other moves without interrupting the chain of marking, the next use of Feint Attack changes. If this changed form of Feint Attack is used, Zoroark leaps at the designated enemy and deals damage to them before landing in the designated direction.
options.upgradeDescription: Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

details.detailedDescription: Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and resetting move cooldowns when it hits. If this move hits, the location where the dash started is marked for 3s, and this move can be used again to return to the marked location with the same effects as the first dash. As long as there is a mark, using Slash, Shadow Claw, or Cut moves the mark to where that move started.
details.notes: If Zoroark hits opposing Pokémon 4 times with either Feint Attack or other normal moves without interrupting the chain of marking: changes the next use of Feint Attack for 3s. When used again: becomes unstoppable for 0.5s and leaps at the designated opposing Pokémon; then bounces in the designated direction forward off the target to perform a slashing attack, damaging the target and opposing Pokémon in the path, dealing additional missing HP damage to those hit.
